description: Role Overview We are looking for a highly detailed, proactive, and results-driven Google Business Profile (GBP) & Local SEO Specialist to join our growing digital marketing agency. Onboarding & Profile Optimization (30%) Set up and claim new Google Business Profiles, ensuring correct verification steps are followed. Conduct keyword and competitor research to select the optimal Primary Category and relevant Additional Categories to avoid category dilution. Geotag and optimize client-provided photos before uploading them to the profile to signal geographic relevance to Google’s algorithm. 3. Weekly Maintenance & Engagement (35%) Create and schedule 1 to 2 localized Google Posts per week using relevant offers, updates, and natural keywords. Regularly upload fresh, high-quality images of client work, staff, and office locations to keep the profile active. Monitor, manage, and draft professional, keyword-rich replies to all customer reviews (both positive and negative) within 24–48 hours. Implement review acquisition campaigns through SMS and Email tools to steadily grow client review counts safely and in compliance with Google's updated terms. Monitor profiles for malicious competitor edits (suggested name changes, fake reviews) and handle the official Google redressal/flagging process. 4. Reporting & Analytics (15%) Run monthly Local Dominator GeoGrid tracking scans to monitor spatial ranking progress. Analyze monthly search traffic, click-to-call, and direction request metrics using BrightLocal. Package reports into easy-to-read client updates showing actual ranking growth and phone call increases. Required Skills & Experience Experience: At least 1-2 years of active experience specifically managing and ranking Google Business Profiles (Local SEO). Tools: Direct experience with BrightLocal and Local Dominator (or similar tools like Local Falcon, Geogrid, Whitespark) is highly preferred. Algorithm Knowledge: Deep understanding of Google Map pack ranking factors (Proximity, Relevance, Prominence) and local SEO guidelines. Problem-Solving: Proven experience handling suspended listings, requesting reinstatements, and appealing rejected reviews. Organization: Ability to manage 15-20 profiles simultaneously without missing weekly tasks. Communication: Strong, clear written English skills for writing posts and responding to client reviews professionally.

job_title: VSL Video Editor (Paid Per Minute) — Direct-Response E-Commerce

We provide the ingredients, you cook the meal. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Edit 2–4 VSLs per week (starting with 2, scaling based on results) - Cut and assemble the full VSL from provided voiceover, script, and reference material - Add word-by-word animated captions - Source and place B-roll, stock footage, or simple motion graphics where needed - Add sound design, music, pacing, and visual hooks that hold attention - Match the style of the reference VSLs we provide - Iterate fast when we ask for variations on winning ads MUST-HAVE (non-negotiable) - You have ACTUALLY CUT AND EDITED VSLs before — show us in your portfolio. Social media edits, YouTube videos, or montages do NOT count. We need direct-response VSL experience. - Strong skills in CapCut (primary editing tool) - Experience with ElevenLabs or similar AI voiceover tools - Animated / word-by-word captions (CapCut auto-captions or Submagic) - Strong sense of pacing, retention, and hook structure for direct-response ads - Fluent English (all communication is in English) NICE-TO-HAVE (big plus) - Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects for advanced cuts or motion graphics - B-roll sourcing experience (Storyblocks, Artgrid, etc.) - Understanding German (our audience is German-speaking women 50+) - Experience editing for health, wellness, or 50+ audiences - Experience with multiple DTC / e-commerce brands TOOLS WE USE CapCut, ElevenLabs, Submagic, Google Drive, Meta Ads, Slack PAY STRUCTURE $5 to $7 per finished minute of VSL. Example: A 5-minute VSL at $6/min = $30 per VSL. At 2 VSLs per week, that's ~$240/month. At 4 VSLs per week with top rate, significantly more. WORK STYLE High-performance, fast-moving e-commerce environment. We value editors who think about WHY an ad converts, not just where to cut. Deadlines are firm, but workload is flexible and grows with results. HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY — this is our first filter) Applications missing any of these will be ignored: 1) Your portfolio including: - Which brands you have edited VSLs for, and FOR HOW LONG - What your exact role was at each - At least 1 full VSL or a cut-down sample of a VSL you personally edited (not a team project — YOUR edit) 2) Answer in writing: "What is the single biggest mistake you see editors make when cutting a direct-response VSL — and how do you avoid it?" 3) A 60-second Loom video where you: - Briefly introduce yourself - Walk us through ONE specific editing decision you made in a past VSL and explain WHY it improved the ad's performance We are looking for an editor who has done this before, delivers fast, and understands what makes a VSL convert. title: Financial Controller
description: Company Overview FetchMe LLC is an Atlanta-based restaurant technology platform—the “Shopify for Restaurants”—powering ~200 merchants across 30 metros with an integrated delivery and catering operations layer. Currently at $3M ARR and actively raising a Series A, we are moving fast to build the best restaurant operating system while keeping costs low for our merchants. Our mission focuses on helping independent restaurants reclaim revenue from high-fee aggregators by giving them the tools to run their own high-margin delivery and catering channels. Our finance operations span multi-market driver pay, complex merchant payment reconciliation, and the high-level reporting discipline required to be investor-ready. We run lean, move fast, and value operational efficiency. Position Summary: Type: Full-time, 40 hours/week Location: Remote (Philippines) Hours: U.S. Business Hours (significant CST overlap required; exact schedule has flexibility, but core availability during peak U.S. morning/afternoon hours is necessary for team alignment). Reports to: Co-Founder / Chief Growth Officer (dotted line to CEO, Atlanta) Compensation: $13–$17/hr, commensurate with experience (FTE ~$27K–$35K/year) The Financial Controller is a hands-on role dedicated to owning the day-to-day accounting close and bringing extreme rigor to a high-transaction-volume, multi-market operation. This is an ownership seat for the books, reconciliations, and the strict controls required to keep them flawless. You will work directly with the founding team and have a highly visible impact on our Series A diligence readiness. Core Responsibilities 1. Financial Reporting & Month-End Close Full Close Ownership: Run the entire month-end close cycle, including journal entries, accruals, and GL reconciliation. Reporting Packages: Deliver a clean, accurate, and on-time monthly financial package. Diligence Support: Prepare financial schedules and reconciliations that feed directly into board reporting and investor diligence. 2. High-Volume Reconciliation & Spend Management Stripe / Payment Processing: Reconcile payments, refunds, and disputes across a growing merchant base (currently ~50 active merchants). Investigate and resolve all variances to zero. Driver Payroll: Tie out our multi-market driver pay infrastructure (hourly guarantees and catering workbooks) before payroll runs through Everee. Enforce a strict zero-variance tie-out prior to platform upload. Merchant Payouts: Reconcile merchant-level revenue, platform fees, and final payouts across all active markets; flag and resolve discrepancies immediately. Corporate Spend Ownership: Manage and optimize our Ramp spend management platform—overseeing corporate card workflows, expense auto-coding, receipt compliance, and bill pay mapping. 3. Treasury, AP/AR, & Internal Controls Cash Management: Maintain routine cash position reporting and assist the founders in tracking burn-rate metrics. AP/AR: Manage vendor invoicing, corporate expenses, and receivables tracking. Controls & Documentation: Build, maintain, and improve internal controls and process documentation to ensure the close process is repeatable and audit-ready. Process Automation: Document manual workflows and actively look for opportunities to make them AI-enabled or automated, ensuring that money-movement steps always require human approval. Candidate Qualifications Must-Have Requirements Experience: 3+ years in accounting/controller roles, ideally supporting a U.S.-based company. GL Ownership: Demonstrated experience running an entire month-end close cycle independently, not just supporting it. Software Proficiencies: Advanced, hands-on proficiency with QuickBooks Online (QBO), Ramp (or a closely comparable spend management / AP platform), and Advanced Excel (comfortable managing complex, multi-tab workbooks using advanced formulas, flags, and tie-out logic). Transaction Volume: Proven experience managing high-volume data reconciliation (e.g., payment processors, payroll platforms, or gig-economy settlement systems). AI Fluency: Actively leverages tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar to accelerate analysis, formula building, and reporting—while maintaining strong judgment around AI limitations and the need for human oversight on financial data. Communication: C1/C2 level English with exceptional written and verbal skills for seamless collaboration with a U.S. founding team. Infrastructure: A stable remote workspace with reliable internet and consistent availability for required U.S. CST overlap. Nice-to-Have Attributes Tech Stack Experience: Direct experience with Stripe, Everee (or similar payroll disbursement platforms), and Notion (where our core operational infrastructure lives). ERP & Scaling: Exposure to NetSuite or similar ERPs, helpful for future migration as the company scales. Automation Skills: Experience designing AI-assisted or automated workflows, prompt-driven reporting, or light scripting to eliminate manual close tasks. Industry Background: Prior experience in high-growth SaaS, marketplaces, gig-economy platforms, logistics, or restaurant technology. Benefits & Perks Performance Bonus: Eligibility for performance-based bonuses tied to milestones like successful close cycles, audit readiness, and process efficiency. Paid Time Off: Comprehensive PTO package aligned with observed US and PH holidays to ensure a balanced schedule. Professional Development: Dedicated annual budget for accounting certifications, advanced software training, or technical workshops. Schedule Flexibility: Enjoy some autonomy over your daily calendar, provided significant core CST collaboration hours are maintained. What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days) Day 30: Fully up to speed on the internal Stripe, Everee, Ramp, and driver-pay workbooks. Successfully shadowing and taking over weekly reconciliations. Day 60: Running the month-end close with minimal oversight and executing flawless, zero-variance driver pay tie-outs on every cycle. Day 90: Fully owning the close process independently, delivering the financial package strictly on the calendar, and having proposed at least two concrete process improvements to existing controls. How to Apply Please submit your résumé along with a cover letter detailing your most relevant, high-volume data reconciliation experience. Note: Strong candidates will be invited to complete a short, paid reconciliation exercise to demonstrate proficiency.

title: Faceless YouTube Tutorial Video Editor
description: ## Job Title Faceless YouTube Tutorial Video Editor — How-To Videos Based on Search Demand ## Job Description I’m looking for a reliable video editor to help create faceless tutorial videos for YouTube, Facebook , TikTok, and Instagram Reels. The videos will be based on “how-to” topics people are already searching for online. This is not limited to one category. Topics may include apps, websites, online tools, business setup, real estate websites, social media, AI tools, productivity tools, personal finance tools, home projects, and everyday step-by-step tutorials. The main goal is to create clean, helpful, advertiser-friendly tutorial videos that teach viewers how to solve a specific problem. These videos will not require anyone to be on camera. The editor will use screen recordings, stock footage, images, captions, text overlays, zoom-ins, arrows, callouts, music, and simple graphics. ## Main Type of Videos The focus is faceless “how-to” tutorial videos. Examples: * How to post a video on Facebook * How to use YouTube search to find video ideas * How to use Canva to create a thumbnail * How to use Google Sheets to track expenses * How to check if an LLC is active * How to use Redfin or Zillow * How to create a Facebook business page * How to use online tools step by step * How to complete simple online forms * How to use beginner software or websites The topic may change, but the format will stay the same: clear, step-by-step, beginner-friendly tutorials. ## Video Length Most videos will be **5–8 minutes** for YouTube. I may also need **30–60 second short-form versions** created from the same video for: * YouTube Shorts * TikTok * Facebook Reels * Instagram Reels ## Responsibilities You will be responsible for: * Editing faceless tutorial videos * Making screen recordings easy to follow * Adding captions/subtitles * Adding zoom-ins, arrows, highlights, circles, and callouts * Removing pauses, mistakes, and dead space * Adding clean text overlays * Adding background music and simple sound effects * Adding stock footage or images when helpful * Creating short-form versions for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Facebook , and Instagram Reels * Creating longer YouTube versions when needed * Following instructions and making revisions ## Video Style I want the videos to be: * Clean * Simple * Professional * Beginner-friendly * Advertiser-friendly * Easy to follow * Not overly flashy * Not confusing * Not full of random effects The viewer should understand exactly what to do after watching the video. ## Important These videos need to be safe for advertisers. No profanity, no misleading claims, no clickbait scams, no copyrighted music, no shocking images, no aggressive hype, and no low-quality recycled content. I want useful tutorial videos that look trustworthy and professional. ## Required Skills Please apply only if you have experience with: * YouTube video editing * Screen recording tutorials * Captions/subtitles * Text overlays * Zoom-ins and highlights * CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Camtasia, or similar software * Good English understanding * Editing educational or tutorial-style videos ## Bonus Skills Helpful but not required: * YouTube Shorts editing * Canva * Thumbnail design * Motion graphics * Basic YouTube SEO * Finding stock footage * Editing AI/tool/software tutorials ## Application Instructions Please include: 1. Your video editing experience 2. Links to 3 tutorial-style videos you edited 3. What editing software you use 4. Whether you can edit screen recordings 5. Whether you can find stock footage and images 6. How many hours per week you are available 7. Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary 8. Put the word HOWTO at the top of your application so I know you read this post ## Test Task Before hiring, I may ask you to complete a short paid test video. The test will be a 30–60 second faceless tutorial video. I will provide the topic or instructions. You will edit it with captions, zoom-ins, arrows, highlights, music, and clean pacing. ## Pay Pay depends on experience. This can start part-time and may become long-term full-time work for the right person. ## Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is reliable, detail-oriented, creative, and good at following instructions. I need someone who can take a simple “how-to” topic and turn it into a clean, useful video that people would actually watch.

title: Senior Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Expert
description: Summary Introduction: We are a fast-growing e-commerce company specializing in drop shipping, with a strong foothold in the European market and ambitious plans to expand into the USA. To drive growth and maximize performance, we are looking for a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Expert. To join our team full-time. This role is vital in optimizing our sales funnels, testing offers, and improving the overall customer journey to achieve more conversions and grow sales. We are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Expert to join our team full-time. This is a pivotal role where you will take charge of crafting strategies, analyzing data, and leading our funnel-building team to drive measurable improvements in performance. Your work will directly impact key metrics such as ROAS, CPA, and AOV, making you a key contributor to the company’s growth. Responsibilities: 1. Strategy and Testing: Develop a comprehensive strategy for the initial testing phase of funnels and implement split tests for ongoing optimization. Test and analyze different strategies to identify the most effective methods for driving conversions and increasing revenue (offers/pricing/designs etc.) 2. Leadership and Management: Lead and manage the funnel-building team, ensuring seamless implementation and alignment with company goals. Oversee the creation and optimization of sales funnels on Funnelish or similar tools. Train the funnel-building team and creative staff on CRO best practices and strategies. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing. 3. Creative Alignment: Collaborate closely with the creative team to ensure ad creatives are aligned with funnel designs and marketing angles. Provide feedback and insights to adjust creatives based on funnel performance. 4. Data Analysis and Reporting: Analyze customer behavior and performance data using tools like Funnelish Analytics, Google Analytics, Hotjar, and heatmaps to identify friction points and areas for improvement. Create detailed weekly/monthly reports on key metrics Develop actionable recommendations based on data insights and test results. 5. Funnel and UX Optimization: Optimize landing pages for better user experience (UX) and higher conversion rates by addressing design, speed, and clarity. Identify and eliminate customer journey friction points. 6. Checkout Process and Retention Optimization: Implement post-purchase upsell and cross-sell strategies to drive higher Average Order Value (AOV). Develop retention strategies, including email and SMS re-engagement campaigns and loyalty programs. 7. Competitor and Market Analysis: Regularly analyze competitors’ pricing, offers, and funnel strategies to identify gaps and opportunities. Skills and Qualifications: Proven experience in conversion rate optimization within an e-commerce or drop shipping environment for 2+ years Strong understanding of funnel-building platforms (e.g., Funnelish, ClickFunnels) and analytics tools (Google Analytics, Hotjar). Demonstrated ability to develop and execute data-driven CRO strategies. Experience in testing offers, pricing models, and A/B testing for digital funnels. Exceptional analytical skills and proficiency with data visualization tools. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working cross-functionally with creative and marketing teams. Proactive problem-solving skills and a results-driven mindset. Compensation & Growth: Base salary of $1.000 - 1,500/month. Performance-based bonuses are tied to funnel performance metrics such as improved conversion rates and profits Opportunities for professional development and growth within a dynamic and fast-growing company. We are looking for a strategic, data-driven CRO Expert who is passionate about optimizing customer journeys and driving measurable results. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a proven track record in improving funnel performance, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please answer the following questions in detail AND share your resume and a portfolio showcasing your CRO achievements, along with a brief explanation of your testing and optimization approach. 1. Can you describe your experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) for e-commerce or drop shipping businesses? 2. Have you worked with sales funnels before? If so, which platforms (e.g., Funnelish, ClickFunnels)? 3. Can you provide an example of an A/B or split test you conducted? What were the results, and what did you learn? 4. What tools do you use for data analysis? 5. What is your current occupation, and are you available for full-time work and able to commit to daily CRO tasks? 6. Can you provide a portfolio or examples of past work, highlighting successful optimization projects?

Responsibilities Your main responsibilities will include: Editing raw podcast recordings into polished final episodes. Cleaning background noise, clicks, mouth sounds, hum, echo, and other distractions. Balancing host and guest audio levels. Removing long pauses, repeated phrases, major filler words, false starts, and mistakes. Improving pacing and flow while keeping the conversation natural. Adding intro music, outro music, and any provided audio segments. Mastering final audio to professional podcast loudness standards. Exporting final files in MP3 and WAV format. Organizing files clearly in Google Drive. Communicating updates and questions clearly. Making revisions based on feedback. Optional: creating short audio/video clips, show notes, episode titles, or YouTube podcast edits if you have those skills. What We’re Looking For We are looking for someone who: Has experience editing podcasts, interviews, sermons, coaching content, educational content, or long-form conversations. Has strong English listening comprehension. Understands pacing, storytelling, and listener retention. Can make audio sound clean without making it robotic or over-processed. Knows when to remove filler words and when to leave natural speech alone. Can work independently without needing constant supervision. Is organized, reliable, and deadline-driven. Is open to feedback and willing to learn our show style. Can work asynchronously with a team based in New Jersey, USA, Eastern Time. Required Skills You should be comfortable with at least one of the following tools: Adobe Audition Reaper Audacity Logic Pro Pro Tools Descript DaVinci Resolve Adobe Premiere Pro Audio skills should include: Noise reduction EQ Compression De-essing Breath and mouth-click cleanup Volume leveling Multitrack editing Intro/outro music placement Final mastering/export Experience with iZotope RX, Auphonic, Descript, Riverside, or video podcast editing is a plus. Content Style Our content has two main styles: 1. Faith / personal development / motivational content For this type of episode, the edit should preserve emotion, conviction, pauses, and impact. We do not want the conversation over-edited or made to sound unnatural. 2. Health / performance / clinical / informational content For this type of episode, the edit should prioritize clarity, clean structure, and easy listener understanding. Repetition and rambling should be tightened while preserving the meaning of what was said. The right editor should understand the difference between these two styles. Typical Episode Details Average raw episode length: 45–60 minutes Speakers: Usually 1 host + 1 guest Turnaround target: 48–72 hours per episode Work type: Part-time to start, with potential for long-term ongoing work Timezone: We are based in New Jersey, USA, Eastern Time Collaboration style: Mostly async using Google Drive, Loom, and messaging Pay We are open to either per-episode pay or a monthly arrangement after a trial period. Possible monthly arrangement after trial: depending on workload, speed, quality, and deliverables. Higher pay is possible for someone who can also handle video podcast editing, short-form clips, show notes, or publishing support. Paid Test Project Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid test edit using a 10–15 minute raw podcast segment. The test will help us evaluate: Audio quality Pacing Naturalness of the edit Ability to remove distractions without over-editing Communication File delivery Deadline reliability Please do not apply if you are not willing to complete a paid test project. How to Apply Please start your application with this exact phrase: “I edit for listener retention.” Then answer the following questions: What podcast editing software do you use? How many podcasts or long-form episodes have you edited? Please send 2–3 samples of podcast episodes you edited. Do you have any before-and-after samples? What is your typical turnaround time for a 45–60 minute raw episode? What is your rate per episode? Are you available for ongoing weekly work? How do you d ---------- what to cut and what to keep in a conversation? Have you edited faith-based, motivational, coaching, health, medical, or educational content before? What are your normal working hours in Philippine time? Who This Role Is Not For This role is not for someone who: Only runs AI noise cleanup and exports the file. Has no podcast editing samples. Over-edits conversations until they sound unnatural. Cannot follow instructions. Misses deadlines without communication. Does not understand English well enough to edit for meaning and flow. Only focuses on technical cleanup and does not care about the listener experience. Final Note We are looking for a reliable long-term editor who can grow with our content brands. If you are skilled, organized, thoughtful, and care about creating high-quality podcast episodes, we would love to hear from you.

title: Ecommerce Finance Analyst / Fractional CFO for 8 Figure DTC Brand
job_title: Ecommerce Finance Analyst / Fractional CFO for 8 Figure DTC Brand
description: Summary Chief Financial Officer (CFO) — Polar Haircare Location: Remote | Type: Full-time contractor | Compensation: $2,000 per month About Polar Haircare We're a fast-scaling direct-to-consumer haircare brand built around one breakout product: Instant Dye Shampoo — a 2-in-1 shampoo and gray-coverage dye that works in 10 minutes and lasts up to six weeks. Our customers are women aged 40–65 who are done with messy, damaging box dye and want something faster and cleaner. We sell across Shopify (DTC), Amazon FBA, Walmart and TikTok Shop, run meaningful paid media across Meta, Applovin and Google/YouTube, and operate a lean global team with a dual-warehouse (China + US) supply chain and a stack of specialist agencies. We're profitable, growing, and building the business with a potential acquisition in mind. The Role This is a hands-on, builder CFO — not a figurehead who manages a finance department. For a business our size, the CFO does the work: builds the models, closes the books with the bookkeeper, reconciles the vendors, runs the payments, and turns raw exports into decisions the founder can act on the same day. You will own every dollar that flows in and out of Polar Haircare. You'll know exactly where money is coming from and exactly where it's going — and you'll find the leaks before anyone has to ask. Your north star is structural margin: accurate unit economics, ruthless cost control, and reporting that makes the business easier to run and more valuable to sell. If you think in contribution margin, get uncomfortable when a number can't be traced to source, and enjoy finding the $40k/year nobody noticed was bleeding out — this is your role. What You'll Own Daily Close, Reporting & Performance -Own the daily financial close: prepare consolidated and channel-level P&Ls (Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop), including ad spend from every platform, all revenue streams, and operating expenses. -Deliver daily performance dashboards covering ROAS, MER, agency fees, indirect expenses, cashback, and the other levers that drive profitability — built for fast decisions. -Calculate and validate daily COGS on every item sold so margin reporting is always accurate. -Maintain weekly and monthly P&Ls for leadership with commentary on what moved and why. Unit Economics & Margin -Build and maintain landed COGS per unit and fully loaded cost per unit (product, freight, duties, packaging, pick/pack, last-mile). -Track gross, contribution, and net margin, and present a clean margin waterfall (Revenue ? Gross Profit ? Contribution ? EBITDA ? Net) at every reporting cycle. -Maintain channel-specific unit economics — especially Amazon (referral fees, FBA fees, storage, PPC) — never blended unless that's the point. -Set and recalibrate break-even and target ROAS as cost inputs change. Marketing & Agency Efficiency -Track total and channel-level ad spend, blended ROAS, MER, CAC, and CAC payback. -Measure each agency's fees as a % of the revenue or savings they manage and flag any that aren't earning their keep. -Surface the most and least efficient spend buckets and feed targets back to the media buyers. Cash Flow, Payments & Working Capital -Lead cash flow management and working-capital planning to keep operations liquid and funds working efficiently. -Run end-to-end payment execution for vendors, suppliers, employees, and subscriptions — on time, every time, no penalties or service interruptions. -Maintain optimal bank balances and manage credit-card funding, top-ups, and utilization. -Maximize credit-card cashback by tracking agreements and eligibility, and optimize banking/payment platform plans (Airwallex, Wise, etc.) against actual usage. -Deploy excess cash into short-term treasury options where it makes sense, within agreed risk limits. -Prepare bi-weekly cash flow reports highlighting inflows/outflows, runway, and key risks. Vendor & Inventory Control -Maintain real-time supplier ledgers: PO-wise commitments, payments made, and delivery status. -Run vendor reconciliations — verify balances, resolve discrepancies, and keep relationships and payables clean. -Maintain vendor registers and compliance documentation with key suppliers to support smooth operations and audits. -Perform periodic inventory valuation and flag slow-moving SKUs or overstock. Expense Governance & OpEx Control -Categorize every operating cost (payroll/contractors, software, agencies, fulfillment, processing fees, insurance, legal, misc.) and track OpEx as a % of revenue. -Own a live Subscription Master — every recurring charge, its owner, and its justification. -Produce periodic deep-dives (salaries, subscriptions, indirect expenses) with 3- and 6-month trend comparisons to surface savings and efficiency opportunities. Payroll & Bookkeeping Support -Execute payroll processing — accurate calculations, on-time disbursements. -Hand the bookkeeper/accountant complete documentation for accurate recording, timely reconciliations, and clean month-end closes (inventory, vendor balances, expense classification). Exit-Readiness & Strategic Support Our US accountant prepares the formal diligence/exit document pack. This role keeps the live operating picture that feeds it — so the story the books tell is accurate, current, and defensible. -Track SDE/EBITDA with clearly documented add-backs, plus trailing-12-month revenue, profit, and growth. -Monitor revenue concentration, repeat-purchase rate, LTV, and LTV:CAC. -Proactively flag "hair on the deal" — margin compression, single-supplier risk, revenue volatility, anything a buyer would question — before it surfaces in diligence. -Turn around ad-hoc, decision-critical analysis on short notice. What Success Looks Like -First 30 days: You can trace every line on the P&L to its source. You've found and documented where current reporting understates costs. -First 90 days: Daily/weekly/monthly reporting runs on a repeatable cadence with minimal manual effort. Accurate per-unit and per-channel economics are live, and break-even/target ROAS are set off real numbers. -First year: OpEx and agency spend are measurably tighter, cash flow is predictable, and the books are clean enough to drop into a data room without a scramble. Who You Are -Proven DTC / e-commerce finance experience — you've owned the numbers for a multi-channel consumer brand (Shopify + Amazon at minimum). -Fluent in the language of paid-media-driven brands: ROAS, MER, CAC, contribution margin, LTV, blended vs. channel-level economics. -Genuinely hands-on — you build the models and run the close yourself, not just review someone else's. -Elite with spreadsheets/financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets); comfortable pulling and parsing raw exports (CSV/PDF) from Shopify, Amazon, banks, and ad platforms. -Rigorous about accuracy — you flag uncertainty, never present a shaky number as fact, and reconcile rather than defend. -Comfortable owning treasury, AP, payroll, and vendor management, not just FP&A. -Clear, direct communicator — you lead with the headline and the dollar impact, then show the math. Bonus Points -Experience preparing a business for sale / acquisition diligence. -Familiarity with multi-entity structures and cross-border operations/FX. -Working knowledge of accounting tools (QuickBooks/Xero) and banking platforms (Airwallex, Wise, Revolut). -Marketplace finance depth (Amazon FBA fee structures, TikTok Shop). In your application, tell us about a time you found a meaningful cost leak or margin opportunity in a business — what the number was, how you found it, and what changed. Looking forward to hearing from you!

What I want is someone who can take a script and a hook and actually turn it into a finished, edited, posted, and repurposed piece of content without needing their hand held through it. Editing through AI tools first, and stepping in by hand only where AI can't get it there. Posting on schedule, automated where it makes sense, manual where it doesn't. Repurposing everything that goes out on YouTube or Instagram into TikTok, LinkedIn, and Facebook versions. Flagging anything in the calendar that needs a second look, and looping me in on the numbers — we go through those together. . description: # Job Title YouTube Video Assembler — Python Pipeline + CapCut (Ongoing, Paid Per Video) # Job Description I run a YouTube channel that produces educational videos using a Python-based content pipeline. The real requirement is a fast computer that can handle AI and video rendering without crawling to a halt. ## The Workflow For each video, I'll send you a script and background music. You will: 1. Run the voiceover Python script 2. Run the image generation Python script 3. Run the video segment Python script 4. Import everything into CapCut -  Background music, Caption, Export Once you've done a few rounds, this becomes a fast, repeatable process. ## What You Need - A powerful computer — a MacBook Pro M4 (or similar Apple Silicon Mac, or an equally fast Windows machine with a strong CPU/GPU) is required. The Python scripts are resource-intensive; underpowered laptops will struggle and slow down delivery. - CapCut installed (pro version) - Comfort running terminal commands / Python scripts (copy-paste level, no coding skills required) - Basic video editing sense — clean cuts, readable captions, music that doesn't drown out the voiceover - Reliable internet and the ability to hit weekly deadlines ## Volume & Pay - Starting at 7 videos per week - Potential to scale to 14 videos per week based on performance and reliability - $5 per completed, exported video - Paid weekly or monthly ## Time Commitment Each video should take a modest amount of hands-on time once you're set up (mostly waiting on scripts to run, then a quick CapCut assembly). This is a great fit for someone looking for steady part-time, repeatable work rather than a single project. ## How to Apply Please include in your application: 1. What computer/laptop you'll be using (model and specs) 2. Confirmation you have or can install CapCut 3. Any experience running scripts via terminal/command line (even basic) 4. Your availability per week 5. Strong plus Luxury or high-end residential experience — the comping logic, lot value, and builder-buyer dynamics are different at this tier. Familiarity with the wholesale assignment model and JV deal structures. Experience with teardown and new-construction lot economics. Comfort with comping and deal tools (Zillow, MLS access, PropStream, etc.) and Google Workspace. title: DTC / E-commerce Ad Video Editor
description: Performance-focused · AI-augmented · Long-term We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets — and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how. This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land — who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading. The basics Type: Full-time Location: Remote Compensation: 900–1,100 USD/month Start: ASAP Output: 3–4 finished edits per day What you'll own Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok — fast, punchy, conversion-oriented Choose and sequence B-roll with intent — every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull Build visual hooks that stop the scroll — you know the first 1–2 seconds are the entire game Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook ? Problem ? Mechanism ? CTA) Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools — realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences Non-negotiables Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal — not just aesthetics. Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either. Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption — without leaning on the script to carry it. Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training — but you need a real foundation to build on. Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why. Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction. Nice to have VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar) Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika) Working knowledge of Meta ad structure — formats, ratios, placements Who fits here You think like a marketer, not just a creative — you care about what converts You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle You ship final-ready work, not "almost there" Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down You're driven and you work hard — you take pride in output and don't need to be chased You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer — you communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you You're honest and loyal — we'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same What we offer This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us: Access to a premium AI tool stack — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more, all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks — you'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else A real growth path — clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself A team that values honesty and loyalty — we're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us How to apply Read this part carefully — applications without a portfolio won't be reviewed. Portfolio. Link 3–5 ad edits you're proud of. DTC/e-commerce strongly preferred. If something ran and performed, tell us the result. Your workflow. Walk us through how you go from brief to final cut. What do you ask for? What do you need? How do you handle unclear direction? Your AI work. Include at least one example where you generated or integrated AI video. Higgsfield examples are a bonus. Logistics. Your availability and timezone. The trial task This role comes with a paid-style trial task — and it's where you really win it. If you're hungry for this, don't wait to be asked: complete it, edit the result, and send it in with your application. Trial task: ---------- If the edit is strong, we'll hire you on the spot. This is your chance to show us — not tell us — that you're the editor we're describing.

title: Brand Social Media Manager – (Instagram + Facebook)
description: Social Media Manager - Job Duties Sheet (Instagram + Facebook ) Role Summary Manage and grow the brand’s presence on Instagram and Facebook through content planning, creation, publishing, community management, influencer outreach, and performance reporting. Ensure consistent brand voice, visual identity, and measurable growth in engagement, traffic, and sales/leads (as applicable). Core Responsibilities 1) Strategy + Planning • Build and maintain a weekly/monthly content calendar for Instagram and Facebook . • Align content themes with brand goals (awareness, engagement, lead gen, sales, launches). • Research audience insights, competitors, and platform trends to guide content decisions. • Recommend campaign ideas, hooks, and creative angles based on performance data. 2) Content Creation + Production • Write captions in the brand voice (short-form, long-form, and CTA-driven). • Create post-ready assets: Reels, Stories, carousels, static posts, and Facebook posts. • Source and organize UGC, testimonials, product shots, and lifestyle content. • Coordinate creative requests (photo/video briefs) and ensure assets match brand guidelines. • Basic editing: cropping, sizing, subtitles, light retouching, simple motion graphics (as needed). 3) Publishing + Scheduling • Schedule and publish content using approved tools (e.g., Meta Business Suite). • Ensure correct formatting, hashtags/keywords, tagging, and location usage where relevant. • Maintain posting consistency and timing based on best-performing windows. • Manage link placement strategy (link in bio, story links, pinned posts, etc.). 4) Community Management • Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, and post replies within agreed response times. • Engage proactively with followers and relevant accounts (likes, comments, story replies). • Escalate customer service issues, sensitive comments, or PR risks to the appropriate team. • Moderate spam and enforce community guidelines. 5) Growth + Engagement • Optimize hashtags/keywords and content structure for discoverability. • Support collaborations (creator outreach coordination, giveaways, collab posts). • Track and improve KPIs: follower growth, reach, engagement rate, saves/shares, clicks. • Test and iterate: formats, hooks, CTA styles, posting times, and creatives. Influencer Discovery + Outreach (Required) 6) Identify Influencers / Creators • Build and maintain an influencer list aligned with the brand audience and niche. • Source creators across tiers (nano, micro, mid-tier, macro) and formats (UGC, lifestyle, review, tutorial). • Evaluate fit using audience match, engagement rate and comment quality, content quality/brand safety, and prior partnerships. • Refresh lists weekly and prioritize new prospects for outreach. 7) Collect Influencer Contact Info + Key Details • For each creator, document and verify public contact points: email (bio/contact button), IG handle/link, Facebook Page (if applicable), management/agency contact (if listed), website/contact form link, and media kit link (if available). • Maintain a tracking sheet/CRM with: name + handle, platforms, follower counts, recent engagement estimate, location/time zone (if known), content tags, notes on fit, outreach status, and pricing/gifted-only notes (if known). 8) Outreach + Relationship Management • Draft and send outreach messages (email + DM) using brand-approved templates. • Coordinate deliverables: posting dates, content requirements, FTC disclosures, and usage rights. • Negotiate basics when permitted (rates, timeline, concepts) and escalate for final approval. • Maintain follow-up cadence and keep the outreach pipeline updated. • Track results per creator (views, engagement, clicks, conversions) and recommend who to re-hire. Facebook Groups (Required) 9) Find & Vet Facebook Groups • Identify relevant Facebook Groups where the target audience is active. • Vet each group before engaging: member count and activity level, group rules (promo/links policy), audience fit/sentiment, and approval requirements. 10) Maintain Facebook Group Targets List • Build a database of groups with: group name + link, niche/category, member count + activity notes, posting rules summary, admin/mod contact (if publicly available), recommended content angles, and status (not joined/joined/approved/active posting schedule). 11) Group Engagement (Value-First) • Participate consistently with helpful, non-spam engagement (answer questions, provide tips, share educational content). • Mention the brand only when allowed and relevant; request admin approval for promos when needed. • Report which groups drive the best engagement/traffic and double down. Meta Tools + Admin • Manage Facebook Page updates (bio, buttons, pinned posts, featured content). • Support Meta Business Suite tasks (inbox, scheduling, Page roles if applicable). • Maintain an organized asset library with clear naming conventions and folders. Reporting + Optimization • Deliver weekly or monthly reports with insights and next-step actions. • Report on top-performing content and replicate what’s working. • Track influencer outreach metrics: creators sourced, creators contacted, reply rate, cost per deliverable, performance by creator. • Track group engagement outcomes: posts made, engagement, and clicks/leads/sales if tracked. Deliverables (Typical) • Content calendar: weekly or monthly. • Posting cadence: ___ posts/week (IG), ___ stories/week, ___ posts/week (FB). • Influencer list: ___ new creators/week added + outreach updates. • Facebook group list: ___ new groups/week identified + engagement log. • Community responses: within ___ hours. • Monthly report: metrics + insights + next month action plan. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) • Engagement rate (likes, comments, saves, shares). • Reach and impressions. • Follower growth and profile visits. • Link clicks / traffic. • Leads or sales attributed (if tracked). • Response time + community sentiment. • Influencer outreach: reply rate, cost per result, performance per creator. • Group participation: engagement + traffic/leads from compliant posts. Success Standards • On-brand, consistent content and voice across Instagram and Facebook . • Reliable execution of posting schedule and inbox coverage. • Active influencer pipeline with documented contact info and outcomes. • Active, compliant Facebook group participation that drives measurable lift. • Clear reporting with actionable insights.

consistent visual brand style • Helping organize content into themes or series • Finding ways to make educational content feel emotionally powerful and engaging • Helping turn my ideas into content that is clear, visually appealing, and easy for the audience to understand Required Skills The ideal candidate should have experience with: • YouTube video editing • Faceless YouTube video creation • Instagram Reels • TikTok videos • Facebook Reels • YouTube Shorts • Canva • CapCut • Basic graphic design • Social media posting and scheduling • Caption writing • Hashtag research • Basic SEO for YouTube and social media • Content repurposing • Finding royalty-free images, music, and video clips • Following brand guidelines • Organizing files and content calendars Experience with any of the following is a plus: • Pinterest • Wix • Blog formatting • Email newsletters • Digital product design • Workbooks or downloadable PDF creation • AI tools for content creation • Wellness, women’s health, coaching, psychology, or medical content Important Qualities I am looking for someone who is: • Creative • Detail-oriented • Reliable • Organized • Able to follow instructions clearly • Able to work independently after receiving direction • Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear • Good at meeting deadlines • Interested in storytelling and emotional wellness content • Able to understand sensitive topics and communicate them respectfully • Able to make content that feels warm, human, and visually appealing • Able to manage more than one project or topic at a time Brand Voice The content should feel: • Warm • Compassionate • Physician-guided • Emotionally intelligent • Honest • Supportive • Thoughtful • Empowering • Gentle but powerful • Educational without sounding description: E-commerce Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online) — Multi-Platform Payout Reconciliation JOB TYPE: Full-time SALARY: $2,500/month LOCATION: Remote JOB DESCRIPTION: We're a US-based bookkeeping practice serving e-commerce and retail clients, and we're looking for a senior bookkeeper who already understands the part of this work that trips most people up: reconciling what a sales platform reports against what actually hits the bank. This is not a data-entry role. You'll own client books independently and review work done by others, so you need to genuinely understand why a payout never matches gross sales — fees, refunds, chargebacks, sales tax, held funds, and platform financing repayments that live in a separate report from the sales data. What you'll do: Own monthly close for multiple e-commerce clients in QuickBooks Online — categorization, reconciliation, and clean financials. Reconcile platform payouts to bank deposits, correctly separating gross sales, processing fees, refunds, and sales tax rather than booking the net deposit as revenue. Set up and maintain clearing accounts so sales, fees, and payouts flow correctly. Handle platform financing (e.g., Square Loans / Capital, Shopify Capital, PayPal Working Capital): book the funding as a liability, split repayments into principal vs. fee, and reconcile the liability against the platform's own loan/balance report each month. Account for cash sales, owner draws, and tender-type differences. Review junior bookkeepers' work and catch reconciliation errors before they reach the client. Required: 3+ years ecommerce bookkeeping, with strong QuickBooks Online expertise. Hands-on experience reconciling at least two of these: Square, Shopify, Stripe, Amazon, PayPal, Etsy. A real understanding of the payout-vs-sales gap and how to use a platform's reports to explain it. Strong written English and reliable overlap with US business hours (some hours between 9am–5pm Pacific Time). Accuracy, discretion with financial data, and the ability to work independently. Nice to have: Experience across several of the platforms above. Familiarity with platform financing products and how their repayments are reported. QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification. **Screening — to apply, complete all of these:** Send the following to our WhatsApp at ---------- : 1. Start your application with the word PAYOUT so we know you read this post in full. 2. Answer this in 3–5 sentences: A client's Square sales report shows $10,000 in gross sales for the month, but only $8,900 was deposited to their bank, and they have an active Square Loan. Walk us through what makes up that $1,100 difference and which report you'd pull to confirm the loan portion. 3. Your resume (PDF) 4. A 1–2 minute video introduction telling us about your e-commerce bookkeeping experience and which platforms you've reconciled. Applications without the keyword, a real answer to the question, and a WhatsApp submission (resume + video) will not be reviewed.

title: Sourcing Analyst/Buyer
description: The Sourcing Analyst will support the Ampol Cleaning Consumables Sourcing Review by conducting detailed market research, supplier benchmarking and product validation across 88 consumable lines covering cleaning chemicals, washroom consumables, bin liners, gloves, hand care products, janitorial equipment and specialty cleaning items. Analysts are required to prioritise sourcing through key wholesale partners including Bunzl, ABCO and the RapidClean network before investigating manufacturer-direct or alternative supply channels. description: Graphic Designer / AI Static Ad Production Specialist We're an established meta ads marketing agency looking for a high-volume Graphic Designer / AI Static Ad Production Specialist who can create direct-response static ad creatives for paid social campaigns. This is not a slow branding role. This is a fast-paced, production-based creative role for someone who can move quickly, follow briefs, use AI tools, and produce a high volume of clean, usable ad creatives every day. We work with fast-growing brands and move quickly as a team. We care deeply about client results, clear communication, strong execution, and high standards. We want someone who takes ownership of their work, stays organized, communicates proactively, and does not wait to be told what to do when something is unclear or needs to be fixed. You will be responsible for producing 100 static ad creatives per day, Monday through Friday, using assigned briefs, templates, hooks, offers, client assets, and creative direction. We use Asana for project management and Slack for daily team communication. What You’ll Do In this role, you will create high-volume static ad creatives for Facebook and Instagram campaigns. Your work will be used for direct-response testing, so the goal is not just to make things look good. The goal is to create clean, readable, launch-ready ads that clearly communicate the hook, offer, and message. You will be expected to: •Create 100 static ad creatives per day. •Design Facebook and Instagram static ads. •Use AI tools to speed up creative production. •Follow assigned creative briefs inside Asana. •Create variations of hooks, headlines, offers, layouts, and visual concepts. •Organize files by client, campaign, date, and angle. •Communicate daily progress, blockers, and completed work in Slack. •Make revisions quickly based on feedback. •Maintain a high standard of usable, launch-ready creative. •Work collaboratively with creative strategists, media buyers, and account managers. •Pay attention to what is being tested and why, so creative output improves over time. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for someone who is fast, organized, creative, coachable, and comfortable with high-volume production. You do not need to be the world’s fanciest designer. You do need to be reliable, detail-oriented, and able to create ads that are clear enough to test. You should understand that paid social creative needs to sell, not just look pretty. You should have experience with: Area What We Expect Design tools Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or similar tools. AI creative tools ChatGPT, Midjourney, Higgsfield, OpenAI image tools, or similar. Paid social creative Experience creating Facebook and Instagram static ad creatives. Direct-response design Ability to create ads with clear hooks, strong hierarchy, readable text, and obvious offers. Workflow tools Comfortable working inside Asana and Slack. High-volume production Ability to produce many variations quickly without becoming disorganized. Strong English communication is important because this role requires clear written updates, feedback loops, and daily coordination with the team. Key Metrics This role is measured by simple production and quality numbers. We care about speed, but we also care about accuracy, organization, and whether the creative is actually usable. Daily production volume 100 statics per day You are expected to produce 100 completed static ad creatives per workday, Monday through Friday. Weekly output 500 statics per week Your weekly production goal is 500 completed static ad creatives. QA pass rate 90%+ At least 90% of submitted creatives should pass our internal QA scorecard. QA includes things like correct offer, correct client or brand, correct dimensions, clear visual hierarchy, no spelling errors, proper file naming, organized folders, and whether the creative follows the assigned brief. What We Care About Most We want someone who takes ownership. If something is unclear, you ask. If something breaks, you communicate. If a brief is missing something important, you flag it instead of guessing silently. If feedback is given, you apply it quickly and improve the next batch. We move fast, expect high standards, and care deeply about client results. The right person for this role is calm under pressure, organized in their workflow, and able to keep producing without letting quality fall apart. This role is a good fit for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable being measured by output. We are looking for someone who can become a reliable part of the creative production system, not someone who needs constant reminders or hand-holding. This Role Is a Good Fit If You •Like fast-paced creative production. •Are comfortable using AI tools. •Can follow directions without needing constant reminders. •Understand that ads need to sell, not just look pretty. •Can create lots of variations quickly. •Stay organized across clients, folders, files, and deadlines. •Communicate clearly in Slack. •Take feedback well and apply it quickly. •Can consistently hit daily output goals. •Stay calm under pressure. •Take ownership when something is unclear, missing, or needs to be fixed. This Role Is Not a Good Fit If You •Prefer slow branding projects. •Need several hours to make one design. •Dislike AI tools. •Struggle with organization. •Do not like being measured by output. •Disappear during work hours. •Get defensive about feedback. •Cannot consistently follow briefs. •Need constant reminders to complete assigned work. •Are uncomfortable with fast-paced agency-style work. Work Schedule This is a full-time role. Schedule Monday through Friday Hours 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, New York City time Location Open to worldwide applicants Communication Strong written English required Candidates must be available during the full working schedule and able to communicate clearly with the team throughout the day. How To Apply Please send: •Your portfolio or examples of static ad creatives. •Examples of AI-assisted creative work. •The tools you use most often. •Your experience with high-volume creative production. •Confirmation that you are comfortable and have experience producing 100+ statics per day. •Confirmation that you are available 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday. We are looking for someone who can move fast, stay organized, communicate clearly, and consistently produce launch-ready creative at volume.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer — Automation & DevOps

What you'll actually do This is a hands-on, high-ownership role across three connected areas: 1. Build full-stack web applications from scratch. Engineer business-critical automations. You build the plumbing so that data, events, and alerts flow correctly, with error handling that doesn't fail silently. You will not be waiting for tickets. You'll be working with leadership to understand what needs to exist, then building it. Who you are You're a builder. You get energy from shipping things, not fro ---------- etings about shipping things. You have integrity and you finish what you start. When you say it's done, it's done. When something breaks, you raise your hand early instead of hiding it. You want a long-term home. You're looking to grow with one company over years, not stack short-term gigs. You write things down so others can maintain them, and you proactively share status — especially when something is blocked, broken, or behind. --- Required technical skills --- Full-Stack Development React / Next.js — Building production web applications from scratch (not just editing templates). TypeScript / JavaScript — Strong fundamentals, not copy-paste from search results. Backend & databases (SQL/Postgres) — Schema design, relationships, indexing, and writing efficient queries. Experience with a modern backend-as-a-service platform (e.g., Supabase or Firebase) including auth, row-level security, and serverless functions is a strong plus. REST APIs — Designing and consuming APIs, authentication patterns, pagination, and robust error handling. You should be comfortable integrating many third-party APIs into one system. Tailwind CSS / responsive UI — Clean, responsive interfaces that work across screen sizes. DevOps & Infrastructure Deployment & environments — Confidently take an app from your machine to production: build step, environment configuration, deploy target, verification, and a rollback plan. Environment variables & secrets — You never hardcode keys or commit secrets; you understand per-environment config. Containers — Working understanding of Docker and why consistent environments matter ("works on my machine" is a problem you know how to eliminate). Hosting platforms — Experience deploying and managing apps and web properties on modern platforms (e.g., Vercel, Render, Railway, or similar). Git — Version-control discipline: feature branches, small meaningful commits, pull requests, not pushing straight to main. Automation & Integration Engineering Workflow automation (n8n or equivalent) — Multi-step workflows including webhooks, scheduled jobs, branching logic, data transformation, retries, idempotency, and error handling. (n8n, Make, Zapier, or custom code — what matters is you understand the patterns.) Integrating SaaS platforms — Comfort connecting tools such as CRMs, ecommerce systems, project management, chat/messaging, and spreadsheets via their APIs and webhooks. You'll learn our specific stack quickly; the underlying skill is what we're hiring for. Data integrity — Deduplication, reconciliation, audit logging, and handling edge cases and out-of-order events so the same thing never gets processed twice. AI-Assisted Development Baseline familiarity required — You've used AI coding assistants (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot) and understand how to prompt them, validate their output, and use them to ship faster without losing track of what you're actually building. Eagerness to go deep — You don't need elite-tier access today. We provide it, and we expect you to grow into power-user proficiency fast. Ability to evaluate and prototype AI-powered features is something you'll develop here with the best tools in the industry at your fingertips. --- Nice-to-have (not required) --- Experience deploying and managing large numbers of web properties or landing pages programmatically. Familiarity with search-infrastructure concepts: indexing, sitemaps, structured data/schema, and how content gets discovered and ranked. Building chatbots or conversational AI agents. WordPress custom API integrations or plugin development. Stripe or other payment-processing integrations. Familiarity with SEO tools and marketing-technology platforms. Experience modeling API costs at scale. --- What success looks like --- First 30 days Onboarded to our systems and toolchain, including AI development tools. Shipped at least one small tool or meaningful feature. Taken ownership of and stabilized existing automation workflows. Established a clear communication rhythm with leadership. First 90 days Your first full-stack application is in production and being used by the team. Critical automations are documented, monitored, and running reliably. You're proactively identifying and proposing improvements, not just executing. You're operating independently on day-to-day priorities. First 6 months Multiple tools shipped and iterating based on real usage. Infrastructure is reliable, observable, and well-documented. You've become the team's go-to for "how should we build this?" Your work has produced measurable time savings and operational improvements — and you're being trusted with bigger problems. --- Core responsibilities --- Application development Build web applications (frontend + API + database + auth) from concept to production. Own the full lifecycle: schema design, API development, UI, deployment, and ongoing iteration. Write clean, maintainable, documented code. Ship working prototypes first, then polish based on feedback. DevOps & reliability Manage deployment across dev, staging, and production with verification and rollback. Configure environments and manage secrets securely. Keep systems observable — logging, status visibility, and alerting so problems surface fast. Automation & integration Design and deploy multi-step automation workflows that synchronize data across business platforms. Implement robust error handling: retries, deduplication, dead-letter patterns, audit logging, and alerts on failure. Establish reusable patterns with consistent naming, standardized building blocks, and clean environment-variable management. Documentation & visibility Document workflows, system architecture, and runbooks. Build operational dashboards and status outputs so the team can see what's running. Maintain mapping and integration documentation as systems grow. Continuous improvement Evaluate and recommend tools and processes that make the team faster. Prototype new automation and AI-powered capabilities. --- Soft skills that matter here --- Self-directed problem solver — You exhaust documentation, search, and AI tools before escalating. Time management — You show up on time, hit deadlines, and flag slippage early. Strong written communication — You explain technical decisions clearly and write documentation others can follow. Ownership mentality — If you built it, you own it. Bugs, performance, uptime — yours until it's handed off. --- Work schedule & holidays --- All staff work a split shift so we can collaborate and meet with US leadership on pertinent tasks. We observe all US holidays as well as PH public holidays (New Year's Day, Lunar New Year, Maundy Thursday, Good Friday, Bataan Day, Labour Day, Philippine Independence Day, National Heroes' Day, Bonifacio Day, Feast of the Immaculate Conception, Christmas Day, Rizal Day). We work hard and we value time with family. After a 90-day probationary period, all staff qualify for leave with proper notice per the employee handbook. --- Compensation --- Full-time, long-term position (this is a career role, not a contract gig). Typical monthly earnings of roughly $1,700–$2,100 USD for this role, depending on demonstrated knowledge, technical ability, and experience — with room to earn more as you take on greater responsibility. Performance-based increases as your scope and impact grow. We promote and pay from within as the company scales. --- Perks & benefits --- Elite AI development tooling, paid for by us — top-tier AI coding assistants and automation platforms most engineers never get to use. This is how you grow your skill set fastest. Paid access to the development platforms and API subscriptions you'll build on. Paid training and courses for professional development. Direct access to company leadership — your ideas get heard and shipped fast. The chance to architect and build products from the ground up, not maintain someone else's code. A small team where your contributions are visible and valued. A clear path to increased responsibility and compensation as we grow. --- How to apply --- Do not send a generic application. We will ignore it. We're looking for one person to grow with us long-term, and how you apply tells us a lot about how you work. Please include: A brief introduction (video recording) — Who you are, what you've built recently, and why a long-term role here interests you. A link to your portfolio, GitHub, or shipped work — We want to see things you've actually built and deployed, not tutorial projects. Your experience with AI-assisted development — Which tools you've used, how they fit into your workflow, and one specific example of how they helped you ship faster or better. (No elite-tier access yet? Tell us how you'd use it if you had it.) One question about the role — This tells us you actually read the posting. Applications that follow these instructions will be reviewed first.

title: VA Sales Specialist Fitness
description: JOB TITLE: Sales-Focused Virtual Assistant — Inbound Closer + B2B Hunter for Premium Fitness Studios (Base + Uncapped Commission) JOB OVERVIEW: We are a premium fitness company operating TWO studio locations in California, anchored by expert personal training and complemented by boxing, yoga, strength training, and calisthenics. We are hiring a Sales-Focused Virtual Assistant to be our dedicated closer across BOTH locations — owning every lead from first touch to signed membership, AND proactively building a B2B pipeline for corporate wellness and group programs. This is a high-leverage role: two studios, two lead pools, two markets — and uncapped commission across all of it. If you are a hunter who loves the phone, the close, and the commission check, keep reading. If you are looking for a "sit back and reply to email s" job, this is NOT for you. ------------------------------------------------------------ WORKING HOURS ------------------------------------------------------------ Monday through Friday, 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM Pacific Time (US). This is non-negotiable — it covers our peak lead and member-acquisition window across both locations. ------------------------------------------------------------ COMPENSATION — BASE + UNCAPPED COMMISSION ------------------------------------------------------------ BASE SALARY: USD $600 per month, paid bi-monthly via Wise or Payoneer. COMMISSION STRUCTURE — PERCENTAGE-BASED, UNCAPPED: TIER A — PERSONAL TRAINING PACKAGES (our flagship service) 8% of the total contract value of every PT package you close. Examples: - 3-month PT package at $1,800 sold:    $144 commission - 6-month PT package at $3,600 sold:    $288 commission - 12-month PT package at $7,200 sold:   $576 commission - Premium custom PT ($10,000+):         $800+ commission TIER B — GROUP STUDIO MEMBERSHIPS (Boxing, Yoga, Strength, Calisthenics) 6% of the first 12 months of contract value on every new membership you close. Examples: - Month-to-month at $179/mo (12 mo value = $2,148):    $129 commission - 6-month commitment at $159/mo ($1,908 value):        $115 commission - 12-month commitment at $139/mo ($1,668 value):       $100 commission TIER C — B2B / CORPORATE WELLNESS — THE BIG MONEY TIER 12% of total contract value on every B2B deal you source AND close. This is corporate wellness packages, team training, group programs for companies, executive PT for C-suite teams, and any business-to-business contract. Examples: - 10-employee corporate wellness package at $8,000:    $960 commission - 25-employee team training program at $20,000:        $2,400 commission - Annual corporate retainer at $36,000:                $4,320 commission We are based in the Bay Area / Silicon Valley — tech companies, startups, and professional firms within 25 miles are all in play. The B2B pipeline is wide open. Whoever builds it wins. TIER D — PIPELINE-BUILDING BONUSES (paid even before the close) - $5 per fully qualified inbound opportunity added to the pipeline (BANT-qualified: budget confirmed, decision-maker reached, timeline established, fit confirmed). - $25 per booked B2B discovery call (verified decision-maker, company size 25+ employees, scheduled on a real calendar). - $100 milestone bonus when you source, qualify, AND close a B2B deal entirely on your own outreach. TIER E — MONTHLY VOLUME BONUSES (stack on top of all commission above) - 10+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$100 bonus - 20+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$300 bonus - 30+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$800 bonus TIER F — MULTI-LOCATION BONUS - $100 monthly bonus when KPIs are hit across BOTH studio locations. REALISTIC EARNING POTENTIAL: With two studios feeding the pipeline and B2B in play, a strong closer can realistically earn USD $2,000–$4,500 in commission per month ON TOP of base. Top performers who land 1–2 B2B deals per quarter can exceed USD $5,000/month in total compensation. Uncapped. Period. PAYMENT TERMS: - Base paid on the 1st and 15th. - Commission paid the month following the close, after the customer's first payment clears. - Pipeline bonuses paid monthly with base. - 14-day clawback window if a sale is refunded. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT YOU WILL DO ------------------------------------------------------------ INBOUND SALES (across both locations) - Respond to every inbound lead within 5 minutes during your shift — SMS, email , DM, phone. - Qualify leads using our discovery framework. - Book or close — your call based on the lead's heat. - Run discovery calls, present the right package, handle objections, close the sale. - Send agreements via DocuSign and follow up until signed and paid. NURTURE & RECOVERY - Day 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 manual follow-up sequence on every unconverted lead. - Re-engage cold leads from the last 12 months. - Win back churned members from the last 6 months. B2B OUTBOUND PIPELINE-BUILDING (high-leverage) - Build a target list of 100+ Bay Area companies (25–500 employees) within 10 miles of our locations. - Cold outreach via LinkedIn, email , and phone to HR leaders, People Ops, and Founders. - Pitch corporate wellness, team training, executive PT, and group programs. - Book discovery calls on the owners' calendar. - Own the deal cycle from first touch to signed contract. CRM HYGIENE & REPORTING - Real-time pipeline updates across both locations. - Weekly sales report every Friday: leads, calls, consults, deals closed, commission earned, B2B pipeline status. ------------------------------------------------------------ REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS ------------------------------------------------------------ ENGLISH: - Fluent, near-native spoken and written English. - NEUTRAL ACCENT REQUIRED — must sound clear and professional to American customers, including corporate decision-makers. Your audio sample (see "How to Apply") is the first thing we review. SALES EXPERIENCE: - Minimum 2 years of phone-based sales experience. - Strong preference for: fitness sales, gy ---------- mberships, personal training sales, wellness, beauty, med spa, real estate, insurance, or high-ticket B2C closing. - B2B experience is a major plus. - Proven track record hitting quota — be ready to share specific numbers. PERSONALITY: - Friendly. People should feel like you actually care, because you do. - Dynamic. High-energy, naturally enthusiastic, the kind of voice that makes someone smile through the phone. - Resilient. Rejection sharpens you, not breaks you. - Hungry. You want the commission and you'll do the work to earn it. - Coachable. Feedback is fuel. TECHNICAL: - Comfortable on Zoom, Google Meet, MindBody / GHL / similar CRM, DocuSign, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Slack. - Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps). - Quiet workspace, zero background noise during calls. - Working webcam, professional-grade headset (not laptop speakers, not earbuds). - Modern computer running smoothly. PREFERRED (BONUS — NOT REQUIRED): - Personal experience as a gy ---------- mber, PT client, or fitness enthusiast. - Familiarity with the US fitness market and Bay Area / California consumer mindset. - Prior B2B prospecting or cold outreach experience. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHO WILL HATE THIS JOB ------------------------------------------------------------ - People afraid of the phone. - People who hate cold outreach. - People who don't want their performance measured in numbers. - People who think 12–8 PM Pacific is "too late" (3 AM – 11 AM Manila — yes, schedule shift required). - People who want a flat hourly rate with no upside. - People who think "sales" is a dirty word. If those bullets felt seen — please do not apply. ------------------------------------------------------------ HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS SECTION CAREFULLY ------------------------------------------------------------ To prove you actually read this entire job description, your application MUST include ALL of the following. 3+ years in SEO with demonstrable commercial results (traffic that turned into revenue, not just rankings) - Working knowledge of AEO principles — even if the discipline is new, you should already be thinking about how AI search changes the game - Technical competence — you don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to be able to read and edit code, work with APIs, and implement changes in a codebase without hand-holding - Experience in regulated industries (finance, insurance, legal) is a strong advantage — you understand what YMYL means in practice, not just in theory - Execute Meta campaigns for awareness, retargeting, and lead generation; build and test custom and lookalike audiences. ? Deliver regular performance reports covering spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, conversion rate, CPL, and pipeline influence. ? Maintain clean attribution and UTM hygiene across all campaigns; monitor performance in GA4, HubSpot, and platform dashboards. ? What You’ve Done (Qualifications) • 3–6 years of hands-on paid media experience with a documented track record of generating B2B leads via Google Ads. How We’ll Measure Success (KPIs) • Qualified lead volume from paid channels and cost-per-lead (CPL) against targets. • Pipeline contribution: paid-attributed opportunities and influenced revenue. • Channel efficiency: ROAS, conversion rate improvements, and budget utilization across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn. • Testing velocity: number of structured A/B tests run per quarter and learnings implemented.
