title: Operations VA
description: About Free Money Meister Free Money Meister is an AI-powered scholarship matching and prioritization platform. We are a U.S. based company helping students find the right scholarships, rank them by their actual likelihood of winning, and execute on them to minimize student loan debt. We are a fast-moving, high-bar team. We are building something that matters, and we move quickly. The person in this role works alongside a small group of people who consistently go above and beyond, and we are looking for someone who operates the same way. The Role This is a student-facing growth role focused on getting more students onto the platform. You will own the work of getting Free Money Meister in front of students and families: finding and booking the right marketing events, coordinating our presence at them, and supporting the campaigns and platform work that turn interest into sign-ups. You will report into our operations function and work closely with our Executive Assistant. This is a part-time, hourly, remote position. We expect roughly 10 hours per week to start, with potential to grow as you prove yourself and as the company scales. Provide your proposed hourly rate. What You Will Actually Do • Find, schedule, and coordinate marketing events that put us in front of students and families: college-readiness fairs, school and community events, and similar opportunities across Maryland and the Greater Washington and Greater Baltimore areas. • Book and coordinate our own sessions, such as Scholarship 101 workshops, with schools, organizations, and event hosts. • Run the outbound pipeline work to get students onto the platform: identifying the right events and hosts, reaching out, and following through to a confirmed booking. • Support inbound growth: helping the platform get discovered by students searching online and through AI tools, and tracking those efforts. • Help oversee and track platform changes and improvements that keep the student experience up to par as we grow. • Provide general marketing support: building and maintaining the events calendar, organizing assets, light campaign execution, and capturing what is needed for sign-ups and registrations accurately. Who We Are Looking For Experience is helpful but not required. We care far more about how you work than where you have worked. The right person is: • Super responsive. You reply quickly and you communicate proactively. If you are blocked or unsure, we hear from you while you are working, not after. • An overachiever. You go above and beyond. You notice things we did not ask about and surface them. You treat our goals as your goals. • A strong independent thinker. You can take an ambiguous task, make a judgment call, and defend your reasoning. You do not just execute, you think. • A clear communicator. Much of this role is reaching out to schools, event organizers, and hosts on our behalf, so clear, professional written communication matters. • Efficient and honest about time. You use modern tools, including AI, to move fast. Your logged time reflects the actual scope of the work. • A culture fit. You thrive on a small team that holds a high bar and moves fast. You take direction well and self-correct quickly. Tools and AI We expect you to use AI tools to work efficiently, and we view that as a strength, not something to hide. What we are evaluating is the judgment you add on top of the tools: the thinking, the prioritization, and the decisions. AI can build a list. It cannot d ---------- which events are worth our time or why. That part is you. A Note Before You Apply You do not have to be an expert in this field. What we are looking for is someone who is smart, has grit and initiative, and goes above and beyond. If that is you, there is a quick accompanying gig included with this posting that we would like you to complete and send over together with your job application. It helps us assess you better. Applications that include the completed gig will get our attention. The gig is your chance to show us who you are. Gig We want to get Free Money Meister in front of students and families by showing up at the right events. Your task: research and build a list of the top 10 to 20 marketing events we should target for Fall 2026 through Spring 2027 in Maryland, the Greater Washington (DC) area, and/or the Greater Baltimore area. Think about events where college-bound students and their families actually show up, for example: college and college-readiness fairs, financial aid and FAFSA nights, scholarship workshops, high school college nights, community and education expos, and similar gatherings. Choose the events you believe give us the highest-value opportunity to reach students and get them onto the platform. For each event, capture what matters and explain your thinking. Describe your process and why you made the choices that you made. The formatting is totally up to you. Note: If you want to make an impact, be part of fast growth, and work with a team that's all willing to put in the work, then this is the right place for you. How We Hire Resumes tell us very little about how someone actually works. So our process centers on the accompanying gig, which mirrors the real work of this role and lets us see how you think and make decisions. Logistics • Type: Part-time, hourly, remote (contractor). • Hours: Approximately 10 hours per week to start, with room to grow. • Confidentiality: A signed NDA is required before access to any internal systems or materials. If this sounds like you, complete the accompanying gig and send it over with your application. We want to see how you think.

title: Claude Code / AI Automation Setup Specialist – Cebu City Preferred

description: We are looking for a technical person in Cebu City or nearby who can help us set up Claude Code and AI automation systems for our business. This is not a normal VA role. We need someone who is comfortable following technical setup instructions, using terminals, connecting tools, testing automations, and troubleshooting when something does not work the first time. You do not need to be a senior developer, but you must be technical, patient, detail-oriented, and willing to figure things out. The main goal of this role is simple: Help us set up working Claude Code automations and document the setup clearly so the process can be repeated later. You will be helping with things like: Setting up Claude Code on a computer Running commands in terminal Connecting APIs, webhooks, Google Sheets, CRMs, email tools, and automation platforms Following detailed SOPs step by step Testing automations to make sure they work properly Troubleshooting setup errors by Googling, reading docs, and trying fixes Recording what was done so another person can repeat it Turning messy technical steps into clear setup notes Tools you may work with: Claude Code, ChatGPT, Google Sheets, GoHighLevel, Make/Zapier-style automation tools, APIs, webhooks, browser tools, code editors, terminals, email tools, and CRMs. You do not need to already know every tool. What matters most is that you can learn quickly, follow instructions carefully, and solve setup problems without needing constant hand-holding. This role is a good fit for someone who: Is naturally technical Has used terminals, code editors, APIs, GitHub, webhooks, or automation tools before Can follow a detailed setup guide without skipping steps Can troubleshoot errors independently before asking for help Can explain what they did in simple language Is comfortable with technical dashboards, settings pages, and documentation Is available to meet in Cebu City if needed for initial setup/onboarding This role is not a good fit if: You only want basic VA/data entry work You are not comfortable using technical tools You give up quickly when an error appears You skip steps or do not document your work You need every small instruction repeated multiple times Work setup: Cebu City preferred. Remote is okay for the right person, but being able to meet in person for initial onboarding is a big advantage. This will start with a paid test project. If the test goes well, this can become an ongoing role. Compensation: Starting at 30,000–40,000 PHP/month depending on skill level and results. Higher pay is possible if you can independently set up and troubleshoot automation systems. 40 hours/week preferred, but we can start with a paid test project first. To apply, answer these carefully. Generic or AI-looking answers will be skipped. 1. Tell me about one technical setup you personally completed. Do not describe your general skills. Pick one real setup and explain: - What tool/software you set up - What the goal was - What broke during setup - What you tried first - What finally fixed it - How you proved it was working 2. Imagine I give you access to a laptop and ask you to set up Claude Code from scratch. What would you check before you begin? Give me your actual checklist. 3. You are following an SOP and step 14 does not work because the terminal shows an error. What exactly do you do in the next 20 minutes before asking me for help? 4. Explain these in simple words: - API - Webhook - Terminal command - Environment variable - GitHub repository - Automation workflow 5. Give an example of a time you connected two tools together. What were the two tools, what data moved between them, and how did you confirm it worked? 6. When documenting a technical setup for someone else, what screenshots or notes would you include so they can repeat it without you? 7. You are setting up an automation and it works once, but fails the second time. What are the first things you would check? 8. What is one technical thing you do not know yet, but you are confident you could figure out? Explain how you would learn it. 9. Small thinking test: Imagine I give you a Google Sheet with customer names, email s, and statuses. I want Claude Code or another automation tool to check the sheet every day, find rows marked “Ready,” create a draft email for each one, and update the row to “Draft Created.” Explain: - What tools you would use - What access you would need - What steps you would take first - How you would test it safely - What could go wrong - How you would document it after it works 10. Record a 2–3 minute Loom video explaining any technical setup, automation, tool, or workflow you have used before. It does not need to be advanced. I want to see how clearly you explain steps. At the top of your application, write: “I can troubleshoot before escalating.”

description: GOHIGHLEVEL VA — CLIENT ONBOARDING & WEBSITE SETUP (Part-Time, Freelance, Room to Grow) Hi! I run an early-stage agency building websites and lead-generation systems for trade businesses — builders, roofers, concreters, plasterers. I'm hiring my first tea ---------- mber to own client onboarding inside GoHighLevel. A BIT ABOUT ME — I'm Isaiah i'm 29, and for most of my 20s I had no purpose. I always knew I wanted to build something more, but I didn't have the direction — only distraction. I started investing in real estate and became a team leader in my role working with high-risk youth. Then I found this. Building and learning business has become my purpose: a way to keep mastering myself, one day look after the people I love, and help others live up to their full potential too. What I love most is leadership: building a tight team, chasing a clear goal, and celebrating the wins together — with everyone benefiting and growing. If that fires you up, you're my kind of person. WHAT YOU'LL DO (THE DAY-TO-DAY): - Take each new client from the onboarding form and spin up their account from our snapshot/template in GoHighLevel. - Build out the client's website using the onboarding info plus our SOPs (mostly templated — you're customising, not designing from blank). - Set up their workflows, review-management, and lead-follow-up automations (largely copy-paste from the template). -Optimize their google business profile (SOP) - Chase clients for any missing info, photos, or documents before it holds up the build. - Move clients cleanly through the pipeline and send me a short daily update (done / doing / stuck). - Use AI tools (like Claude) daily to work faster. - Full training provided — no prior GoHighLevel experience needed. Most of the system is already built — the snapshots, the workflows, the SOPs. You are NOT inventing it from scratch; you're running it cleanly and consistently, client after client, and catching anything that's missing before it becomes a problem. Precision and follow-through matter more here than creativity. Your pay grows as the agency grows. You win when we win — and I mean that literally, it's written into how you're paid: WHAT YOU GET: - A real culture, not a faceless gig. You're employee #1, working shoulder-to-shoulder with me. Your wins get noticed, your ideas shape how we do things, and I want someone who genuinely enjoys the work — not someone counting down the clock. Work hard with me and you'll feel it in how you're trusted, treated, and paid. - A monthly retainer that secures your availability, covers our weekly Zoom, light ongoing upkeep, and helping refine the SOPs so they run smoothly for you. - Project-based pay per client you onboard — a fair flat fee for each onboarding, confirmed with you on our call. The more clients we land, the more you earn. - Milestone bonuses tied to client growth — as the agency hits new client milestones, your pay grows with it. - Free, hands-on training in GoHighLevel, AI tools, and agency systems — skills that raise your market value permanently. - A clear path: first hire today, then lead VA / operations as we grow. - Flexible part-time hours (10-20/week to start, growing with the business). - A 90-day performance review. High-performing tea ---------- mbers will be considered for increased responsibilities and bonuses and pay increases. THE GROWTH PATH (THE REAL OPPORTUNITY): You'll start by following my recorded walkthroughs and SOPs. The system is nearly all documented — you'll just help me put the final polish on a few SOPs so they work smoothly for you. Once you've onboarded a few clients and know the system cold, you'll own it — improving the SOPs and eventually overseeing onboarding end to end. As we land more clients, this role grows from first VA to lead VA / operations. The person who runs the engine well is the person who ends up managing it. THE SETUP, PLAINLY: this is a freelance / contract role to start — you invoice me, rather than being a salaried employee, and it's part-time and fully remote. I call you a "tea ---------- mber" because that's genuinely how I'll treat you, but I want to be straight: it's contract-based, with a real path to a long-term core role (and more pay) as the agency grows. WHAT YOU NEED (attitude over skills — I'll train the rest): You do NOT need GoHighLevel experience. What I can't train is who you are. You DO need: - Excellent written and spoken English. - A growth mindset — you want to learn AI, automation, and marketing, and keep levelling up. - Problem-solving — when something's missing or breaks, you think it through and find a fix before running to me. Bring solutions, not just problems. - Leadership potential — you want to grow into leading: owning processes, and eventually helping run and train a small team. - Consistency — this is a repeatable system you'll run again and again; you do it the same right way every time. - Reliability and punctuality — you do what you say when you say, and you show up on time, every time, to our weekly Zoom check-in. - Sharp attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions exactly. - Comfort working async — outside our weekly Zoom we won't always be online together (I work a rotating shift roster). You'll send a short daily update and work from recorded Loom videos, keeping things moving on your own — while flagging when you're genuinely stuck instead of going silent. START DATE: as soon as I find the right person — ideally within the next 2-3 weeks. I'm finishing training materials now, so you'll step into a system that's ready for you. HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is the first test): 1. Record a 1-minute video telling me: (a) why you'd be great for this role, and (b) something you taught yourself in the last year and exactly how you learned it. Upload to Loom or Google Drive and make sure the link is viewable. 2. Start your application with the word: CONCRETE 3. Include: your video link, a short personal intro (no copy-paste cover letters — I can tell instantly), your rate expectation, and an internet speed test screenshot (speedtest.net). Applications that skip the video or the code word won't be read. That's deliberate — following instructions exactly is the job. Thank you, and I look forward to reviewing your application.

description: About Us We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.) This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone). Our Stack (you'll work across most of this) -Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps) -Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API) -Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation) -ActiveCampaign (automations, API) -Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run) -REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job -LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API) -WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code. -Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API) -Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments -Softr (client portal on top of Airtable) -Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation. What You'll Do -Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems) -Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability -Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google -Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings -Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for. -Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms -Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break) -Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions. -Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this Compensation -Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience -Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance. -Annual base increases for strong performers -Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months Hours Of Work Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME. Who This Role Suits -5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool -You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail -You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround" -You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain) -You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked -You test your own work before calling it done -You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first -You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs Who This Role Does NOT Suit -Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps -Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role -Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs -Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours) -Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination. -Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point. Security Note (read this — it matters) We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great. SKILL REQUIREMENTS Required: -Zapier (Expert) -Airtable (Expert) -AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert) -API Integration / REST APIs (Expert) -WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced) -Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced) -Python (Advanced) -HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced) -Webhooks (Advanced) -Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced) Strongly preferred: -Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) -ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo) -Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions) -Flask or similar Python web frameworks -Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking Nice to have: -Softr / no-code app builders -Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs -SQL HOW TO APPLY To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read: 1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post. 2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't. 3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.) 4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem? 5. Your expected monthly salary in USD. 6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively. 7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning. Office Setup and Philippines Operations The successful candidate will assist with researching and organising the setup of a Philippines-based office. This may include: * Researching suitable office locations. * Finding possible office spaces, serviced offices, coworking offices, or small commercial offices. * Comparing rental costs and office facilities. * Contacting office providers or landlords. * Preparing summaries of office options. * Assisting with internet, computers, desks, security, and office setup requirements. * Helping create a practical office environment for accounting and administration staff. The candidate does not need to have previous office setup experience, but must be resourceful, organised, and willing to investigate options properly. 3. Learning Australian Accounting and Business Processes The candidate does not need to already be an expert in Australian taxation, SMSF administration, or SMSF audit. Justin will provide training, guidance, and direction. However, the candidate must be willing to learn about: * Australian bookkeeping. * Australian GST and BAS basics. * Payroll administration. * Accounts payable and accounts receivable. * Client document collection. * Accounting workflow management. * SMSF administration support. * SMSF audit support documentation. * Business compliance administration. * Client service standards. The candidate must have a strong learning attitude and be comfortable gradually developing technical knowledge over time. 4. Daily Operations Management The manager will assist with: * Managing daily tasks and team workflow. * Preparing daily and weekly task summaries. * Following up staff on incomplete work. * Keeping work organised and properly documented. * Reporting progress to Justin. * Identifying urgent issues. * Maintaining task trackers. * Creating workflow lists and checklists. * Helping staff understand their responsibilities. * Ensuring work is completed accurately and on time. 5. Business Growth and Development We are seeking someone who has a genuine interest in business growth. The successful candidate should be interested in learning how to: * Build a team. * Improve systems. * Find new staff. * Support client service delivery. * Help create scalable business processes. * Assist with marketing outsourced accounting services. * Identify opportunities for improvement. * Support long-term expansion of the office. * Help create a professional and reliable outsourcing operation. This role would suit someone who has ambition, initiative, and a desire to grow into a larger leadership role. 6. Communication and Reporting The candidate must be able to communicate clearly and professionally with Justin, staff, candidates, suppliers, and potential office providers. The role will require: * Daily updates. * Weekly progress reports. * Recruitment summaries. * Office space comparison summaries. * Staff performance updates. * Workflow updates. * Issue reporting. * Suggestions for improvement. Clear written English is important. 7. Systems and Administration The candidate will help create and manage simple systems, including: * Recruitment trackers. * Staff training records. * Daily task lists. * Weekly workflow reports. * Office setup checklists. * Staff performance notes. * Accounting workflow checklists. * Client document request lists. * Internal procedure documents. The candidate should be comfortable using spreadsheets, email , chat applications, online research, and cloud-based tools. Accounting Knowledge Requirement The candidate does not need to be a qualified accountant. The candidate does not need to already know all Australian tax, SMSF, or audit rules. However, the candidate should ideally have some basic understanding of accounting or business administration, such as: * Invoices. * Receipts. * Payments. * Bank reconciliations. * Bookkeeping basics. * Payroll basics. * Supplier statements. * Accounts payable. * Accounts receivable. * Document organisation. * Basic spreadsheet reporting. A background in accounting, bookkeeping, administration, finance, business management, or outsourcing operations would be highly regarded. Required Skills and Qualities The ideal candidate should be: * Trustworthy. * Reliable. * Organised. * Proactive. * Willing to learn. * Business-minded. * Resourceful. * A good communicator. * Able to work independently. * Able to follow instructions. * Able to think ahead. * Able to manage people. * Able to research and compare options. * Comfortable with responsibility. * Interested in long-term career growth. * Able to work closely with an Australian principal. Preferred Experience The following experience is preferred but not essential: * Experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance, or administration. * Experience recruiting staff. * Experience managing virtual assistants or junior staff. * Experience working with Australian businesses. * Experience in a BPO, outsourcing, or offshore staffing environment. * Experience using Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or task management tools. * Experience researching office spaces or helping set up business operations. * Experience communicating with clients, suppliers, landlords, recruiters, or candidates. Training Provided Training and guidance will be provided by Justin. The successful candidate will be trained in: * Australian accounting workflow. * Bookkeeping support processes. * Document collection processes. * SMSF administration support. * SMSF audit support file preparation. * Staff workflow management. * Client service standards. * Business operations. * Office setup planning. * Recruitment processes. * Internal reporting systems. The candidate must be willing to learn, take notes, improve, and help train future staff. Confidentiality and Professional Standards The successful candidate will have access to confidential business, client, accounting, payroll, and financial information. The candidate must: * Keep all information strictly confidential. * Follow data security procedures. * Use approved systems only. * Not share business information with third parties. * Maintain proper records. * Report issues honestly and quickly. * Be willing to sign a confidentiality agreement or NDA. Long-Term Growth Opportunity This is a long-term opportunity for the right person. The goal is to build a full outsourced accounting office in the Philippines that can support Australian accounting firms, business clients, SMSF administration, bookkeeping, and audit support. The successful candidate may grow into a senior role such as: * Philippines Office Manager. * Outsourced Accounting Team Manager. * Operations Manager. * Recruitment and Training Manager. * Offshore Business Development Manager. We are looking for someone who wants to build a career, not just complete daily tasks. Employment Type Full-time role Remote initially, with the possibility of helping establish a physical Philippines office Long-term role available for the right candidate Initial trial period may apply Growth pathway into senior management Application Requirements Applicants should provide: * Resume or CV. * Short introduction about yourself. * Details of accounting, administration, recruitment, or business experience. * Any experience working with Australian clients or businesses. * Any experience managing staff or helping build a team. * Any experience finding candidates or researching office spaces. * Software experience. * Expected monthly salary or rate. * Availability and preferred working hours. * Internet and computer setup if working remotely. * References or previous employer details, if available. Trial Task Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical trial task, such as: * Finding 5 possible accounting staff candidates in the Philippines. * Preparing a comparison of 3 possible office spaces. * Creating a simple recruitment tracker. * Drafting a staff onboarding checklist. * Preparing a daily operations report. * Reviewing a simple bookkeeping task and identifying what information is missing. Ideal Candidate Summary The ideal candidate is a reliable, proactive, and business-minded person who wants to help build an outsourced accounting office in the Philippines. They do not need to already know everything about Australian accounting, SMSF, or taxation. These areas will be taught by Justin. The most important qualities are honesty, loyalty, initiative, organisation, willingness to learn, ability to find and manage people, and the ambition to help grow a serious long-term business. Thank you Jko Group

title: YOUTUBE STRATEGIST/ CHANNEL MANAGER
description: Market Leaders' socials - study before applying: ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT Most "YouTube manager" roles are upload monkeys. You're handed a finished video, you slap on a title someone else wrote, you publish, you log off. Market Leaders doesn't work that way. We have the cameras, the editors, and the founders who know the material cold. What we don't have is one person who owns the **thinking** — the person who d ---------- what we make, why anyone would click, and whether the channel actually grows. That's you. You are not here to edit. You are here to run the engine. You plan the slate with the team, you brief the people who shoot and edit, you write the titles and direct the thumbnails that d ---------- whether a video lives or dies, and you read the analytics like a scoreboard. If you've grown a channel before and you think in CTR, retention, and packaging — not just in pretty cuts — read on. This is a fully remote role for someone who wants to own a number, not wait for instructions. ABOUT MARKET LEADERS Market Leaders is a Singapore-based social media consulting company. We help high-performing operators — property agents doing $500M+ in deals, financial advisors with established ad systems, business owners building real personal brands — turn their expertise into content that compounds. We teach the 5 C's: Character, Content, Community, Convert, Client. We believe in systems, not willpower. Peaceful and profitable. World-class, no compromise. This role is for **our own channels** — the Market Leaders brand channel plus our founders' long-form. You're building the flagship that proves what we teach. The bar is set. TOTAL COMPENSATION PACKAGE **Base Salary:** SGD $2,000/month **What's Included** - Fully remote — work from anywhere, as long as you overlap Singapore working hours (SGT) - Direct line to the founders and the content team you'll be directing - Market Leaders training on hooks, packaging, retention, and short-form/long-form strategy - The tools you need to do the job (analytics, scheduling, thumbnail collaboration, AI ideation) - Ownership of a real channel's growth number — not a faceless task queue **Work Benefits** - Results-focused, not clock-watching — we judge the channel's numbers, not your hours online - Clear monthly scoreboard so you always know where you stand - Real budget exposure: your packaging gets tested with real distribution **Path Forward** - Prove you can grow the number, and the scope grows with you — more channels, a bigger team to direct, and a senior content-lead track - This is a long-term seat for the right operator, not a gig THE 4Rs — YOUR ROLE BREAKDOWN ### 1. ROLE — The Mission Own Market Leaders' long-form YouTube engine end to end. You plan what we make, you direct the team that films and edits it, you package it so people click and stay, and you grow the channel on the strength of the analytics. You are the brain of the operation — the editors are the hands. Every video serves a business objective: - Position Market Leaders and our founders as the trusted authority in their space - Earn the click (title + thumbnail) and hold the watch (structure + pacing) - Turn our frameworks and founder insight into long-form people actually finish - Feed the short-form machine — every long-form becomes Shorts and cross-platform clips You will use AI to ideate and research faster, but the taste and the calls are yours. ### 2. RESPONSIBILITIES — The Day-to-Day Work **Strategy & Ideation — 30%** - Plan the monthly long-form slate *with the team* — what we make, in what order, and why - Research topics, search demand, and competitor channels to find angles worth filming - Turn founder material and frameworks into clear briefs and outlines the team can shoot - Bring a point of view to every video: who it's for, the hook, the payoff **Packaging — Titles & Thumbnails — 25%** - Write multiple title options per video and test them — this is the single biggest CTR lever - Direct thumbnail concepts (brief the designer; you own the concept, not the Photoshop) - Own click-through rate as a metric you're personally accountable for - Keep a swipe file of what's working and feed it back into the next slate **Production Direction — 25%** - Brief the shooters and editors against your outline, then QC the cut against the brief - Run the content calendar and pipeline so videos ship on a predictable cadence - Unblock the team, chase what's stuck, and keep the machine moving - Maintain a repeatable production system, not one-off heroics **Channel Management & Analytics — 20%** - Publish with proper titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, end-screens, and playlists - Live in YouTube Studio: read CTR, average view duration, retention curves, and traffic sources - Turn each long-form into Shorts and repurpose across Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn - Report the numbers and the next move — what we'll change and why ### 3. RESULTS — What Success Looks Like **Foundation Phase — Month 1** - Know the channels, the founders' voices, and the back catalogue cold - Ship the first slate you planned end to end — briefed, filmed, edited, packaged, published - Stand up a working content calendar and a titles/thumbnails packaging system - Establish the baseline: current CTR, AVD, and retention, so we know what we're improving *This phase is about learning the brand, the material, and the team rhythm.* **Growth Phase — Month 3** - Hold a consistent publishing cadence with no missed weeks - Show a measurable lift in CTR and/or average view duration vs. baseline - Run a repeatable packaging system the team can follow without you in every detail - Reliably turn each long-form into Shorts and cross-platform clips *This phase is where you stop reacting and start driving the channel.* **Long-Term Impact — Month 6** - Own the channel number — views, subscribers, retention — with minimal founder input - Direct the team to ship the slate on cadence while you stay focused on strategy + packaging - Demonstrate channel growth attributable to your packaging and slate decisions - Be trusted to take on more channels and a bigger team *This phase is where the channel runs as a system you own, not a series of one-offs.* ### 4. REQUIREMENTS — The Must-Haves **Experience** - Demonstrable track record growing a YouTube channel (yours or a client's) — show the before/after - Hands-on experience writing and testing titles and directing thumbnails for CTR - Experience directing a remote content team (editors, designers, shooters) against briefs - Strong grasp of long-form structure, hooks, and retention — and how Shorts feed the main channel **Skills** - Fluent in YouTube Studio analytics — CTR, AVD, retention, traffic sources, and what to do about each - Comfortable using AI tools for ideation, research, scripting support, and repurposing - Strong written and spoken English — you'll be briefing a team and the founders daily - Comfortable with a project-management tool (Notion, Asana, ClickUp, or similar) **Work Arrangement** - Fully remote, but you must overlap core Singapore working hours (SGT) for briefs and reviews - Reliable laptop and internet — you run the pipeline, you can't drop offline - Able to commit long-term, not a short gig between other things **Work Style** - Ownership mentality — you treat the channel's growth like your own business - Self-managed — nobody is going to watch over your shoulder; the numbers do that - Decisive on packaging — you form opinions and test them, you don't wait to be told - Open to feedback and fast iteration — you'd rather hear "this missed" than "this is fine" WHAT MAKES YOU THE PERFECT FIT **You Think in Numbers, Not Just Aesthetics** You don't ask "is the video done?" You ask "will this title earn the click, and will the first 30 seconds keep them?" CTR and retention are your scoreboard. **You've Actually Grown a Channel** You can point to a channel you moved — views, subs, watch time — and explain *why* it grew. You know the difference between a video that got lucky and a system that compounds. **You Direct Without Doing It All Yourself** You're comfortable handing the camera and the timeline to the team and getting what you wanted through a clear brief and honest QC. You scale through people, not through your own keyboard. **You Live in the Packaging** You have opinions on titles and thumbnails. You can look at any channel and explain what you'd change to lift the click. You collect what works. **You Use AI to Move Faster** You're not scared of AI. You use it to research, ideate, and repurpose faster — and you know it sharpens your taste, it doesn't replace it. **You Communicate Proactively** A remote team only works if you flag things early. If footage is weak, you say so. If the slate's slipping, you raise it before it's a problem. **You Crave Improvement** You don't take a flat video personally. You read the retention graph, find the drop-off, and fix it next time. HOW TO APPLY **1. Email ** Send your application to: ---------- Subject line: **YouTube Strategist — [Your Name]** **2. Include These 3 Things** **Channel Proof** - Link to a YouTube channel you've grown or managed, with rough before/after numbers (views, subs, watch time) - 2-3 examples of titles + thumbnails you packaged, and what the CTR did - Optional but useful: an example where you used AI in your workflow **Brief Response — 4 to 6 Sentences** > *"Pick one YouTube channel in the business, finance, property, or coaching space that you think is packaged well. Name 3 things they do well that most channels in their niche do badly — and 1 thing you would change about their titles or thumbnails to lift the click. Be specific. Point to actual videos."* This is the most important part of your application. We're hiring for strategic thinking, not just upload skills. Generic feedback = skipped application. **Resume/CV** PDF format only. **3. Paid Trial — If Shortlisted** We'll give you Market Leaders' positioning and one topic. You'll deliver a 30-day mini content plan: - 5 long-form video concepts, each with 3 title options and a thumbnail direction - One full video outline (hook ? structure ? payoff ? CTA) - A short plan for repurposing that video into Shorts and cross-platform clips - Turnaround: 72 hours from receipt of the brief - Paid regardless of outcome The trial isn't testing whether you can fill a template. It's testing whether you can think like a channel owner — pick angles that earn clicks, structure for retention, and run a system. **4. Interview** - 30-minute video call with the Market Leaders team - A short live packaging exercise — we hand you a topic, you talk us through titles and thumbnail angles - Decision before offer

title: UK Construction - Finance Assistant
description: FINANCE ASSISTANT Smith & Sons Construction Services Ltd | Remote | Part-Time (25 hours per week) ABOUT SSCS Smith & Sons Construction Services Ltd (SSCS) is a premium residential construction company operating across East London, Havering and Essex. We are a director-led business building a strong, systems-driven foundation, and we are looking for an experienced finance professional to take ownership of our day-to-day finances as we grow. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an experienced, UK-construction-literate virtual Finance Assistant to take ownership of our bookkeeping, reconciliation, reporting and supplier payments. The role begins by taking financial administration off the directors' desks. Over time - as you learn our systems and prove the core role can be done efficiently - it expands into higher-value finance work. We are looking for someone who can support the business for the long term, and the role is genuinely open to growing and being shaped around the right individual. The right person is meticulous, proactive and able to turn numbers into clear insight the directors can act on. This is a finance-first role, and the construction finance knowledge is non-negotiable. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Bookkeeping and reconciliation (the core of the role) Own our dedicated accounts inbox and manage the working relationship with our external accounting and bookkeeping team - resolving their weekly queries and, more importantly, working to prevent those queries by keeping the books clean in the first place. Process all purchase invoices through Dext: ensure each is correctly tagged to the right project, the correct cost category is applied, and - critically - the correct VAT treatment is used, including the construction VAT domestic reverse charge where it applies. Stay alert to duplication. For example, where a director has photographed and uploaded an over-the-counter invoice that also arrives by email , verify the entry rather than relying solely on Dext and Xero's duplicate detection. Reconcile all company bank accounts and credit cards in Xero on an ongoing basis. Administer the Construction Industry Scheme (CIS): verify subcontractors, apply the correct deductions, and prepare and file the monthly CIS return through Xero. Reporting and insight Produce project-level reporting on all active jobs: total contract value against amount invoiced and amount remaining, cost-to-date split across labour, materials and subcontractors, and overall project profitability - in effect, cost-value reconciliation (CVR) and work-in-progress (WIP) tracking - flagging any cash flow risks early. Produce business-level reporting: regular profit and loss, cash position and forecasts, so the directors always know where the business stands. Treat cash flow forecasting as a distinct discipline, not just historical reporting. Deliver a structured update to the directors at least once a week in a scheduled video meeting, with shorter interim updates to a director by WhatsApp as needed. Translating the numbers into plain, actionable insight is central to this role. Client invoicing, credit control and supplier payments Manage client billing through Xero, including stage-payment and repeating-invoice schedules. Help design billing schedules that keep projects cash-flow-positive for SSCS - particularly on larger contracts, where a flat weekly figure no longer fits and billing needs to track progress and applications for payment so the business is not funding the build ahead of being paid. Raise client invoices and chase outstanding payments (credit control). Run the weekly supplier payment cycle through a payment-approval system: identify bills that are due and not yet paid, enter all the details required to pay them (amount, invoice, reference and payee bank details), and present the week's payment run to the directors as a report. Directors review and approve line by line; approved payments release on the weekly cycle. The assistant prepares payments; the directors authorise them. This separation is a deliberate financial control and a fixed boundary of the role. HOW THE ROLE GROWS Phase 1: Take over and stabilise the finance administration above, learning our systems and conventions. Phase 2: Expand the finance remit: cash flow forecasting, billing-schedule design, tighter credit control, and proactive prevention of bookkeeping queries before they arise. Beyond that, the role is deliberately open-ended. We are building a long-term relationship, not filling a fixed list of tasks, and we expect the role to grow and reshape itself around the strengths and ambitions of the person we hire. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Weekly bookkeeping queries from our accountants drop close to zero, because issues are caught before they are raised. The books are reconciled and up to date at all times. The directors receive reliable, clear reporting every week and never have to chase for the numbers. Suppliers are paid accurately on a controlled weekly cycle, and clients are invoiced and chased without director involvement. ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS Demonstrable experience in UK construction finance and bookkeeping. Hands-on CIS experience: subcontractor verification, deductions and monthly returns. Working knowledge of the VAT domestic reverse charge for construction. Strong Xero experience across reconciliation, invoicing and reporting (Xero certification / Xero Advisor an advantage). Experience with Dext or similar invoice and receipt capture software. Excellent written and spoken English. Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. AI literacy. It is essential that you know how to use and leverage AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT and similar) to work faster and more efficiently - while understanding that AI is an assistant, not a replacement for judgement. You must apply a human eye to everything AI produces and take responsibility for checking that the work is correct, rather than letting the tools run unchecked. Able to work remotely with significant overlap with UK business hours for meetings and updates. DESIRABLE AAT qualified or part-qualified, or qualified by experience. Experience with Xero bill-payment and approval-workflow tools (for example ApprovalMax, Telleroo, Comma or Crezco). Cash flow forecasting and management-reporting experience. Job-costing, CVR or WIP experience in a contracting environment. Confident with spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets) for reporting. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES Proactive and self-managing - anticipates problems rather than waiting to be asked. Discreet and trustworthy with sensitive financial information. Organised, reliable and a clear communicator with the directors. PRACTICAL DETAILS Remote, part-time, 25 hours per week, with overlap with UK business hours. Reports to the Co-Director (Isaac). Core tools: Dext, Xero, a payment-approval platform, Google Workspace and WhatsApp. Standard (non-admin) Xero access and preparer-only rights in the payment system; the directors retain sole payment authority. A confidentiality agreement / NDA will be required. Rate: to be confirmed.

title: AI Product Video Creator – Ballistic-Protected Container Film
job_title: AI Product Video Creator – Ballistic-Protected Container Film
description: AI Product Video Creator – Ballistic-Protected Container Film We are looking for an experienced AI video creator / video editor to produce a professional product film for a specialized industrial / defense-related product: a sea container protected with a ballistic coating. This is a one-time paid project, but it may lead to more product videos, industrial presentations, AI films and marketing materials in the future. ## Project Overview The product is a sea container with a protective ballistic coating designed to reduce fragmentation risk and improve safety in high-risk environments. The container can be used in: * conflict-risk zones, * military or security environments, * field bases, * logistics zones, * temporary operational areas, * checkpoints, * emergency infrastructure, * equipment storage areas, * industrial and uniformed services applications. The film will be used mainly for business communication with Ukrainian companies, institutions, contractors and potential distributors. It may be sent together with a PDF product presentation or placed on a simple landing page with product information. The goal is to present the product as a practical, serious and professional protective solution for demanding environments. ## Important Style Direction We do **not** want a Hollywood action trailer. We do **not** want exaggerated war scenes, explosions, violence, gore or political propaganda. We need a realistic, industrial, serious B2B product film. The style should feel: * realistic, * industrial, * cinematic but controlled, * professional, * technical, * practical, * suitable for B2B / institutional buyers, * suitable for the Ukrainian market, * serious and trustworthy. Think more: industrial defense product presentation / field logistics solution / protective infrastructure film. Think less: action movie / war propaganda / dramatic combat trailer. ## Materials We Will Provide We will provide: * product photos, * product description, * technical information, * website link, * visual references, * key selling points, * company / contact details for final screen. The film should be generated and edited using AI tools and video editing tools based on these materials. You may use AI video, AI image generation, editing, motion graphics, overlays, cinematic transitions, sound design, product visualization and realistic environment creation. ## What the Film Should Show The film should present: * the container as a real industrial / protective product, * the ballistic coating as a protective surface layer, * possible use in high-risk environments, * use in field / military / logistics / temporary infrastructure settings, * mobility and practical deployment, * potential functions such as: * field office, * equipment storage, * temporary shelter, * logistics point, * technical room, * checkpoint, * operational support unit, * the concept of reducing fragmentation risk, * professional use by companies, services, contractors or uniformed units. ## Suggested Film Structure The final creative structure can be proposed by you, but one possible scenario is: ### 1. Opening Environment A realistic field logistics environment: temporary base, industrial yard, training ground or operational zone. Dust, vehicles in the distance, serious atmosphere, calm cinematic movement. Text idea: “Protective modular infrastructure for high-risk environments.” ### 2. Product Reveal The sea container appears as a strong, practical structure. Slow camera movement around the container. Close-ups of the coated surface. Text idea: “Sea container with ballistic protective coating.” ### 3. Risk Context Subtle reference to difficult environments: damaged infrastructure, distant smoke, field logistics, temporary deployment, security area. No graphic violence, no direct combat scenes. Text idea: “Designed for environments where fragmentation risk and operational safety matter.” ### 4. Protection Layer Visualization A clean visual showing the coating layer on the container surface. This can be done through AI, motion graphics or simple technical overlay. Text idea: “Protective coating designed to reduce fragmentation risk.” ### 5. Use Cases Fast but clear sequence showing possible applications: * field office, * storage unit, * temporary shelter, * logistics point, * equipment room, * checkpoint, * emergency infrastructure. Text idea: “Mobile. Practical. Adaptable.” ### 6. Deployment Container transported, placed on site, used as part of a temporary base or operational zone. ### 7. Closing Frame Strong final frame with the container in a serious field / industrial environment. Text idea: “Protective container solutions for demanding conditions.” Final screen: company name / website / contact details. ## Expected Deliverables Please quote for one or more of the following packages: ### Basic Package * Main film: 45–75 seconds * 1 thumbnail / cover * 1–2 revision rounds ### Extended Package * Main film: 45–75 seconds * 30-second version * 15-second teaser * 1 thumbnail / cover * 3–5 still visuals for PDF or landing page * 1–2 revision rounds ### Optional Add-ons * Ukrainian language text version * English language text version * Polish language text version * social media format versions * landing page hero video loop * extra thumbnails / stills ## Tools / Skills Needed Please tell us which tools you use, for example: * Runway, * Kling, * Luma, * Veo / Flow, * Midjourney, * ChatGPT, * CapCut, * Adobe Premiere Pro, * DaVinci Resolve, * After Effects, * Photoshop, * Canva, * other AI image / video tools. We are especially interested in creators who can combine AI-generated scenes with realistic product presentation, industrial environments and clean editing. ## Application Requirements Please apply with the subject: **BALLISTIC CONTAINER AI FILM** In your application, please include: 1. Your portfolio or links to similar AI video / product video / industrial video work. 2. Which AI video tools you use. 3. Which editing tools you use. 4. Your proposed approach for this project. 5. Estimated price for the Basic Package. 6. Estimated price for the Extended Package. 7. Estimated delivery time. 8. Number of revision rounds included. 9. Whether you can create realistic industrial / defense-style visuals without making the film look like an action movie. 10. Whether you can prepare English and/or Ukrainian text versions. Applications without video examples or portfolio links will not be considered. ## Important Notes This film is for a serious B2B product presentation. It must look professional, realistic and practical. It should not include graphic violence, political messaging, unrealistic combat scenes or exaggerated explosions. We are looking for someone who understands how to create a premium industrial product video using AI while keeping the tone serious, credible and business-oriented.

title: NDIS Operations Assistant
description: About SyncAssist SyncAssist is a backend operations partner for NDIS providers across Australia. We do not provide direct support to people with disability. We fix the broken backend that stops providers from delivering great support. Our clients are NDIS businesses - typically 5 to 100 staff -  whose operations have outgrown their systems. Invoicing errors, compliance gaps, missed remittances, disorganised participant records. The kind of problems that create financial risk and audit exposure for providers and their participants. We go inside their systems - ShiftCare, Visual Care, Xero, MYOB, PRODA, Google Drive, SharePoint -  and we fix what is broken. We build structured workflows, document SOPs, and execute operational rhythms so providers can focus on care. This is not a general admin role. Every person on our team works directly inside live NDIS provider systems. The work is precise, compliance-sensitive, and directly connected to participant outcomes. If you get it wrong, a real person's funding is affected. We are a structured, systems-driven team. We use ClickUp for task management, Process Street for workflow execution, Airtable as our delivery engine, and Google Drive as our single source of document truth. We document everything. We follow SOPs. We escalate fast and we do not cut corners. If that sounds like the environment you thrive in, read on. The Role: Position: NDIS Operations Assistant     Reports to: Head of Client Operations and Delivery You will be embedded inside the backend operations of active NDIS providers. You are not a personal assistant. You are not a generalist VA. You are executing structured, compliance-sensitive workflows inside live provider systems - invoicing, participant records, service agreements, compliance registers - on behalf of clients who have paid for precision. You will work directly under the Head of Client Operations and Delivery, following documented SOPs for every task. You will not make decisions outside your scope. You will escalate issues immediately. You will deliver consistent, accurate output every week. What You Will Actually Be Doing : These are the tasks you will own week to week. If you do not have direct experience with these tasks inside an NDIS provider context, do not apply. Invoicing and Finance Administration - Prepare weekly NDIS invoicing data from shift records in ShiftCare or similar scheduling platforms - Cross-reference service delivery records against participant plan budgets before submitting claims - Process and reconcile remittance advice from the NDIA against submitted claims - Track outstanding invoices in the financial workflow register - Execute the structured overdue invoice follow-up sequence as per SOP - Flag anomalies, budget shortfalls, or claim discrepancies to the Head of Operations immediately Participant and Provider Record Management - Maintain accurate participant records — personal details, plan dates, funding categories, support budgets - Prepare and manage service agreements, consent forms, and plan review documents - Update participant and staff registers in line with NDIS requirements and client-specific SOPs - Monitor participant funding utilisation and flag participants approaching budget limits - Manage document version control in Google Drive using SyncAssist file naming conventions Compliance and Register Maintenance - Maintain and update all client compliance registers — i ---------- , complaints, staff credentials, and policy registers - Prepare document packs for scheduled audits and quality reviews - Identify gaps or overdue items in compliance registers and escalate within the agreed timeframe - Ensure all documents are filed in the correct folders following the client folder template Email Triage and Inbox Management - Manage provider email inboxes within the agreed daily rhythm - Sort, prioritise, and action or escalate email s within the agreed daily rhythm - Draft routine responses using approved templates for standard provider communications - Flag urgent or compliance-sensitive email s immediately Task and Workflow Management - Log all tasks, updates, and completion notes within the client task structure in ClickUp - Execute workflow steps exactly as documented — no shortcuts - Raise flags when a workflow step cannot be completed as documented - Update the weekly client delivery summary with status of all active workflows Non-Negotiable Requirements : Every item below is a hard requirement. If you cannot demonstrate direct experience with each of these in an NDIS provider context, your application will not proceed. Requirements: What we need to see - NDIS invoicing  : Hands-on experience preparing NDIS claims - including PACE or PRODA submission workflows, claim codes, and support category budgets. Not just understanding invoicing in theory. - ShiftCare or equivalent : Direct experience in a rostering or NDIS scheduling platform — entering shifts, extracting invoice data, managing participant records. ShiftCare strongly preferred. - PRODA and PACE : Working knowledge of Services Australia systems. You should know what PRODA is used for, what can go wrong, and how to flag access issues. - Service agreements : Experience preparing or managing NDIS service agreements across plan management, self-managed, and agency-managed participant types. - Compliance registers : Experience maintaining participant, staff, and compliance registers in an NDIS context. Not just data entry - you must understand why these registers exist. - Google Workspace : Proficiency in Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets. Experience working within a structured folder system and following naming conventions. - ClickUp : Experience using ClickUp or a comparable task management platform for workflow tracking. You will be inside ClickUp every day. - SOP execution : You have worked in a role where you followed documented SOPs. You understand that SOPs are not suggestions. - Written English : Strong written English. You will be drafting communications, updating registers, and writing completion notes that the client may read. Tools You Will Use Daily : - ClickUp : All task management, workflow tracking, and client delivery registers - Process Street : Step-by-step workflow execution for client delivery - every major task has a checklist - Google Drive : Document storage, SOP library, client folder management - Google Sheets : Financial tracking, compliance registers, utilisation monitoring - Airtable : Internal delivery engine - client data, task registers, workflow status - ShiftCare or equivalent : Client NDIS scheduling and invoice data extraction - Xero / MYOB : Client financial systems - invoice review, reconciliation support - PRODA / PACE : NDIS claim submission and participant record management (client systems only) The Kind of Person We Are Looking For - Beyond skills and experience, we are looking for a specific type of operator. - Process-driven. You find comfort in structure. You do not invent new ways to do things that already have a documented process. You follow the SOP, and when the SOP does not cover something, you escalate rather than guess. - Compliance-aware. You understand that in the NDIS space, errors in invoicing or participant records affect real people. You do not rush tasks. You check your work before you mark it complete. - Proactive and visible. You do not go quiet. You check in at 9am and 4pm, every day, without being chased. If something is delayed or blocked, you say so before it becomes a problem. - Accurate over fast. You would rather take an extra ten minutes and get it right than submit something that creates a downstream error. Rework is expensive for everyone. - Long-term focused. We are not interested in contractors who will leave in 90 days. We invest in training and onboarding and we expect commitment in return. Important - Please Read Before Applying : - Confidentiality and Data Handling : SyncAssist works inside credentialed client systems. This means we handle PRODA access, NDIS participant data, Xero accounts, and provider compliance files on behalf of our clients. All client data is strictly confidential. You will be required to sign a confidentiality agreement before commencing. You will not retain, store, or use any client data outside the scope of your assigned tasks. Applications without direct NDIS experience will not proceed. This is not a role where you will be trained in NDIS administration from scratch. You need to arrive already knowing the system. Applications from general virtual assistants or those without direct NDIS provider experience will not be considered. How to Apply : Submit your application using the link below. What you'll actually be doing: — Opening Zendesk, picking up tickets, and resolving them end-to-end — Running subscription cancellations through a multi-step retention flow — Step 1 (ask why + offer benefits), Step 2 (offer pause/skip/frequency change), Step 3 (provide cancellation portal), through to final cancellation — exactly the way you've done it before — Catching legal trigger words — attorney, lawyer, BBB, FTC, dispute, chargeback, court, consumer protection — and switching to immediate resolution without hesitation — Checking Shopify order history, verifying subscription status in Loop or Seal, searching by email + name + username across multiple stores before responding — Handling delivery issues — tracking via 17track or USPS, providing updates with tracking links, managing "delivered but not received" cases — Processing refunds (full and partial), managing chargeback responses, and de-escalating frustrated customers with warmth and professionalism — Using pre-built macros for speed while adjusting tone to match each customer's situation — Signing off with your name, professional formatting, clean structure — every time If you just read that list and thought "that's literally my current job" — keep reading. What makes this different from your current role: — You work directly with the brand owner (me). No middle management, no agency layers, no confusion about who to ask — I give real, specific feedback — not just "do better." I'll tell you exactly which ticket, which step, and why — Your hours grow as fast as you prove yourself. This starts at 1 hour/day and scales to full-time. I've done this before — the right person gets more hours within weeks, not months — Bonuses for consistently clean work. Not a maybe — a real part of how we operate — Weekly PayPal payouts every Tuesday. No chasing invoices, no delays The details: — Starting rate: $5–6/hr depending on experience (willing to pay more for someone who's been doing this 3+ years) — Hours: 1 hr/day to start, scaling to 4–6 hrs/day, and eventually full-time — Schedule: Flexible within 9am–7pm CT — you pick your window — Tools: Zendesk (macros + views), Shopify (order lookup + admin), Loop or Seal Subscriptions, ---------- — Payout: Weekly via PayPal (Tuesdays) What I need from you (non-negotiable): — 3+ years of daily Zendesk experience — real queue work, not "I've seen it" — Real Shopify experience — order lookup, subscription verification, navigating multiple stores — Hands-on experience with Loop Subscriptions, Seal Subscriptions, or Recharge — actually cancelling, pausing, skipping, modifying subscriptions in the backend — Previous experience supporting supplement, wellness, or health brands — you understand the customer profile and product type — You can handle 50+ tickets/hour using macros — You catch legal keywords every single time — attorney, BBB, FTC, lawsuit, dispute, court — and you know exactly what to do when you see them — Strong written English — warm, clear, professional, no copy-paste robotics — Reliable internet + quiet workspace Why people stay with us: I'm not going to pitch you on culture or mission statements. Here's the truth: I pay on time, I communicate clearly, I respect your time, and I give you room to grow. The right person here isn't just clearing tickets — they're building something with me. I want someone who's looking for that. How to apply: Send me: 1. A short note about your experience — specifically which supplement or wellness brands you've supported, which subscription platform you've used (Loop, Seal, Recharge), and how long you've been using Zendesk daily 2. Your resume 3. A screenshot of your internet speed test If your experience matches, I'll send you a few screening questions and a short practical test. No tricks — just real tickets, real scenarios, showing me you can do what you already know how to do. Looking forward to meeting the right person. – Gavin

title: AI UGC video editor wanted (Veo + Flow)
job_title: AI UGC video editor wanted (Veo + Flow)
description: I'll keep this real so neither of us wastes time???? I make AI UGC videos, the creator-style clips that sell products, using Veo inside Flow. I'm looking for one person to help me crank them out. Good news first: you're not starting from a blank page. I give you the script and the first hook prompt, and your job is to turn that into a finished video. In practice that means building out the rest of the prompts (Claude helps a ton here), generating the footage in Veo, then re-rolling clips until they look right. That last part is most of the job, if I'm honest. After that you edit it all together, captions and sound and pacing, into something people don't scroll past. Some days that's ten versions of one idea. Some days it's a single video you fuss over till it's right. Before you apply, you need two things: 1.A Flow subscription and a Claude subscription, both active. The whole job runs on these, so I need you ready on day one, not getting set up next week. 2.A computer and solid wifi. You're rendering and uploading video all day, and bad internet kills this job. Then here's what I care about in a person: 1.Your English is good. Easy to talk to, easy to understand. We'll be on Telegram every day, so this one matters a lot. 2.You reply. If I text you and you're slammed, just say "busy, on it tonight." I don't need a paragraph, I just hate wondering whether you saw it. 3.You've got an eye. You can feel the gap between a video that's fine and one that lands, and the fine one bugs you a little. You notice the small stuff. The caption that's a frame late, the weird extra finger in one clip, the audio that drifts slightly off. You catch it before I do, because with AI video that tiny detail is the whole difference between something that looks cheap and something that looks real. 4.You're someone I'd want to talk to daily. I'll take a person I like over a slightly faster robot every time. 5.You care about this stuff and want to get good at it. A degree's a nice bonus, not a dealbreaker. One small thing: I read every application that comes in. So I know you got this far, open your message with the word pineapple. No word, I move on. How it works from here: You apply with the word. We get on a quick call so I can hear how you think. If we click, I send you the trial below. It's paid, and it's the whole game, whoever nails it is the person I hire. If the trial's strong, we do a proper onboarding call and you're in. The trial: Recreate this video: ---------- Here's the base character reference you'll work from: ---------- Same energy, same style. Here's the script word for word, five scenes: 1.When you are done eating chicken wings, do not throw out the bones, folks. 2.Wash them, bake at 450 degrees for 45 minutes, and grind to a fine powder. Now here is what most folks never figured out. 3.That powder is full of calcium and collagen. It strengthens the teeth, eases stiff joints, and settles the gut. 4.Stir a spoonful into your coffee or soup each morning. 5.Comment book and follow me to receive my full Amish healing collection. The voice is a middle-aged Amish woman. To land it, use this as your audio prompt: "She is a middle-aged Amish woman:" Anyone can read a script over some footage. What I'm grading is the detail. Get every one of these right and the job is yours: 1.Constant camera movement in every single scene. Nothing static. 2.A different background in each scene. Don't reuse one. 3.Different tools and props throughout. 4.A hook that makes the video even more engaging than the original. 5.The whole thing runs under 30 seconds. 6.No anomalies. It has to look genuinely real, no AI weirdness anywhere. 7.No typos in the captions. 8.No vocal glitches or weird audio. Pay: Base plus bonuses. Your videos perform, you earn more. Simple. hint: If you reach 1m views on a video you get $100, but this is not the only bonus, theres more. If you are hungry for success and you want to make 1k-2k a month and you wanna prove the people who doubted you, this is the right place. At last, you need to have a students mind, if you are willing to learn, we can't work together.
