description: We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly: A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business. We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for Facebook , Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels — and who can do it using a modern, AI-driven workflow that lets us move fast, test more, and scale creative volume without sacrificing quality. This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UGC-style ads, AI-generated creative, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative for e-commerce. --- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING --- You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including: — Facebook and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases — UGC-style ad creatives, both real and AI-generated: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly — AI talking-head and avatar-based ads: built using tools like HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and similar — Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action — Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after ---------- nts, and social proof — VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure — Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures — Localized creatives for new European markets as we expand --- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR --- We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how e-commerce ads work AND how to leverage AI to create them at scale. You should know how to edit videos that: — Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds — Make the problem feel real and urgent — Show the product clearly and persuasively — Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention — Feel native to Facebook , Instagram, and TikTok — Communicate benefits quickly and clearly — Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof — Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase on our Shopify store You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, AND AI-generated assets, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. --- AI WORKFLOW (NON-NEGOTIABLE) --- This is a core part of the role, not a bonus. You should be confident in: — Generating UGC-style AI avatars and talking-head content (HeyGen, Higgsfield, or similar) — Generating AI voiceovers in multiple languages and tones (ElevenLabs or similar) — Generating AI b-roll, supplementary visuals, and scene fillers when stock or original footage isn't enough — Knowing which tool to use for which job — and combining them efficiently inside a single edit — Optimizing tool credits and subscription costs: every generation has a real cost, and we need someone who knows how to get the best output with the fewest wasted credits — Iterating quickly when an AI generation doesn't land, without burning through resources — Blending AI-generated content with real footage so the final ad feels native and believable, not artificial If you've never touched these tools or you're not comfortable working in an AI-driven pipeline, this role isn't the right fit. --- THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE --- You'll be a strong fit if you: — Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands (beauty, skincare, or DTC is a strong plus) — Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative — Have hands-on experience with AI generation tools (avatars, voice, b-roll) — Can create multiple ad variations quickly — Know how to follow references without copying them blindly — Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow — Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused — Are resourceful with AI tools and credit budgets — Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast — Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice — and every AI generation — should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion. --- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE --- Ideally, you have experience with: — Meta/Facebook ad creatives for e-commerce brands — Short-form paid social videos — Long-form VSLs or sales videos — AI-generated UGC, avatar, and b-roll content — Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing — Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Runway, Kling, or similar AI generation platforms Bonus if you've worked with beauty, skincare, or K-beauty brands targeting a female audience over 40. --- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY --- — Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, AI-generated assets, and references — Generating AI b-roll, avatars, and voiceovers as part of the production pipeline — Creating variations of winning ads for further testing — Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs — Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios (Reels, Stories, Feed, TikTok) — Building localized variations of winning ads for new European markets as we expand — Managing AI tool usage efficiently to keep production costs under control — Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance — Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations --- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU --- — Competitive compensation based on experience — Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives — Access to premium AI tools and platforms — fully covered by us — The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive e-commerce revenue across multiple European markets — Clear creative direction and fast feedback — Long-term growth with a fast-scaling D2C brand expanding internationally We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert — using both classic direct-response editing instincts and the AI tools that make modern creative production possible at scale. If you're an e-commerce ad video editor who understands performance creative AND lives in the AI workflow, we'd love to hear from you. --- READY TO APPLY? --- If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. title: Client Support/Account Manager
description: Get to know who we serve before you apply: ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT Most "support" roles are a ticket queue. A client complains, you copy-paste a reply, you close the ticket, you forget the human. Market Leaders doesn't work that way. Our clients are high-performing operators — property agents, financial advisors, business owners — who pay us to help them grow. They don't need a help desk. They need someone in their corner who keeps them on track, removes the friction, and finds the thing they couldn't find themselves. That's you. You're the person who notices a client has gone quiet and reaches out before they fall behind. You're the one who walks them through the tool they're stuck on. You're the one who, when a client says "I can't figure out how to do X," just... handles it. If you're genuinely tech-savvy, genuinely organised, and you actually like helping people win — read on. This is a fully remote role for someone who takes ownership, not someone who waits for tickets. ABOUT MARKET LEADERS Market Leaders is a Singapore-based social media consulting company. We help high-performing operators turn their expertise into content and systems that compound. We work with: - **Property agents** doing $500M+ in transactions, leading 30+ agent teams - **Financial advisors** running established lead and ad systems - **Business owners + coaches** building personal brands that drive real revenue We teach the 5 C's — Character, Content, Community, Convert, Client — and we believe in systems, not willpower. Peaceful and profitable. Here's the truth about coaching: the clients who get results are the ones who keep showing up and doing the work. Your job is to make that easy — to keep them accountable, unblock them on the tech, and be the reliable hand they can reach for. You protect the client relationship so our coaches and founders can focus on the coaching. TOTAL COMPENSATION PACKAGE **Base Salary:** SGD $800-1,000/month (paid via Wise or PayPal in SGD) Range depends on experience and how much you can own from day one. **What's Included** - Fully remote — work from anywhere, as long as you overlap Singapore working hours (SGT) - Direct training on our tools, our AI bots, our client systems, and how we work - Exposure to how a real coaching business runs — the systems behind the scenes - The tools you need to do the job well **Work Benefits** - Results-focused — we judge whether clients stay on track and feel supported, not your hours online - Clear playbooks so you're never guessing how to handle something - A role where being proactive and resourceful is the whole point, not a bonus **Path Forward** - Prove you can own the client relationship, and the scope grows — more clients, more responsibility, a senior customer-success track - This is a long-term seat for the right person, not a gig THE 4Rs — YOUR ROLE BREAKDOWN ### 1. ROLE — The Mission Be the accountability and support layer for Market Leaders' clients. You keep clients on track with what they committed to, you help them with the tech and tools they get stuck on, and you find the things they can't find for themselves. You're the reliable, proactive hand that makes the client experience feel handled. Every interaction serves one objective: the client keeps moving forward, feels supported, and stays with us because the experience is excellent. You'll use our AI tools and systems to help clients faster — but the care, the follow-through, and the judgment are yours. ### 2. RESPONSIBILITIES — The Day-to-Day Work **Accountability & Check-ins — 35%** - Track what each client committed to (from their coaching calls, client chart, and ongoing chats) - Work inside client chats — reach out proactively, nudge, follow up, and check in before things slip - Run a consistent weekly check-in rhythm with clients - Log progress so the coaches and founders always know where each client stands **Tech Support & Enablement — 30%** - Help clients set up and use our tools, AI bots, portal, and the software they need - Troubleshoot when something isn't working, calmly and clearly - Run short screen-share walkthroughs when a client is stuck - Write simple how-to guides so the same question doesn't come up twice **Concierge & Research — 20%** - Find the things clients can't find — resources, templates, vendors, answers, examples - Do light research on the client's behalf so they don't lose time hunting - Be the "let me sort that out for you" person clients come to rely on **CRM Hygiene & Escalation — 15%** - Keep the client chart, records, notes, and statuses clean and up to date - Flag at-risk or quiet clients early - Escalate the right things to coaches or founders — with context, not just "client's upset" ### 3. RESULTS — What Success Looks Like **Foundation Phase — Month 1** - Know the client roster, their commitments, and the tools they use - Hit a consistent response time on every client message - Learn our systems, AI bots, and playbooks well enough to handle common questions solo - Run your first round of weekly check-ins *This phase is about learning the clients, the tools, and the rhythm.* **Growth Phase — Month 3** - Own the weekly accountability loop — clients are being followed up with, on time, every week - Resolve most tech questions yourself without escalating - Build a small library of how-to guides for the questions that repeat - Spot at-risk clients early and flag them with useful context *This phase is where you stop reacting and start running the support engine.* **Long-Term Impact — Month 6** - Measurably lift client follow-through — clients are doing what they committed to - Noticeably cut the number of routine questions reaching the founders and coaches - Be the trusted point of contact clients reach for first - Own the client-experience playbook and keep improving it *This phase is where the client experience runs as a system you own.* ### 4. REQUIREMENTS — The Must-Haves **Experience** - Prior customer-facing experience — customer success, account management, support, or client coordination - A track record of being the reliable, proactive one — examples welcome - Comfortable working directly with clients who are busy, successful, and expect competence **Skills** - Excellent written and spoken English — most of this job is clear communication - Genuinely tech-savvy — you learn new software and AI tools fast and can troubleshoot calmly - Strongly organised — you don't drop follow-ups, and nothing falls through the cracks - Resourceful — when you don't know something, you find out, you don't just give up **Work Arrangement** - Fully remote, but you must overlap core Singapore working hours (SGT) for client responsiveness - Reliable laptop and internet — clients are counting on you to be reachable - Able to commit long-term, not a short gig **Work Style** - Ownership mentality — a client's progress is your responsibility, not just your task list - Proactive — you reach out before you're asked, you don't wait for problems to escalate - Calm and warm under pressure — clients should feel handled, not managed - Open to feedback and fast iteration — you'd rather hear "do this better" than "this is fine" WHAT MAKES YOU THE PERFECT FIT **You Take Ownership** You don't ask "did I reply?" You ask "is this client actually moving forward?" Their progress is your scoreboard. **You're Genuinely Good with Tech** New tool, new AI bot, unfamiliar software — you figure it out fast, and you can explain it to someone who can't. You're the person friends call when something won't work. **You're Proactive, Not Reactive** You notice the quiet client. You follow up before the deadline. You flag the problem while it's still small. Clients never have to chase you. **You're Resourceful** "I couldn't find it" isn't in your vocabulary. When a client needs something, you go find it, figure it out, or get the answer. **You're Organised to a Fault** You track every commitment and every follow-up. Nothing slips. Your notes are clean enough that anyone could pick them up. **You're Warm Without Being a Pushover** You can hold a client accountable and keep them feeling supported at the same time. You're a direct, caring mentor, not a doormat and not a drill sergeant. **You Communicate Clearly** Whether it's a check-in, a how-to, or an escalation, your message is clear, kind, and gets to the point. HOW TO APPLY **1. Email ** Send your application to: ---------- Subject line: **Client Support / Account Manager — [Your Name]** **2. Include These 3 Things** **Relevant Experience** - A short note on a client or customer relationship you owned, and what you did to keep them on track or solve a problem for them - Any tools, software, or AI you're comfortable with (and how you've used them) **Brief Response — 4 to 6 Sentences** > *"A client tells you: 'I'm stuck — I can't get this tool to work and I'm falling behind on what I said I'd do this week.' Walk us through exactly how you'd handle it, start to finish. Be specific about what you'd say and what you'd do."* This is the most important part of your application. We're hiring for ownership and judgment, not scripts. Generic answers = skipped application. **Resume/CV** PDF format only. **3. Paid Trial — If Shortlisted** We'll give you 3 sample client situations: - An accountability nudge (a client who's gone quiet and is behind on a commitment) - A tech question (a client stuck on one of our tools) - A "can you find X for me" request You'll write how you'd respond to each, and propose a simple weekly check-in cadence you'd run across a small client book. - Turnaround: 48 hours from receipt of the brief - Payment: **USD equivalent of SGD $40 via Wise or PayPal on submission** - Paid regardless of outcome The trial isn't testing whether you can write a polite reply. It's testing whether you can take ownership, communicate clearly, and actually solve the problem — including the tech. **4. Interview** - 30-minute video call with the Market Leaders team - A short live scenario — we describe a client situation, you talk us through how you'd handle it - Decision before offer WHAT HAPPENS NEXT - Application review: within 3-5 business days - Top candidates contacted: within 48 hours of decision - Full process: application ? paid trial ? interview ? offer, within 2 weeks max We do not drag this out. If you are a fit, you will know. If not, you'll get a respectful "not this cycle" reply within a week. NOT A FIT IF This role is not for you if: - You want a passive ticket-queue job where you wait for problems to come to you - You need someone watching over you to stay on task — remote means self-managed - You're not actually comfortable with software and troubleshooting - You drop follow-ups or let things fall through the cracks - You can't overlap Singapore working hours for client responsiveness - You'd rather avoid hard conversations than hold a client accountable - You want a short gig, not a long-term seat If any of those describe you, that's fine. We'd rather know upfront.

description: Yes, that's a materially different role. What you've described is not a learning designer, instructional designer, curriculum designer, or educational producer. title: YouTube Research Assistant - Tesla, SpaceX & Elon Musk Niche
job_title: YouTube Research Assistant - Tesla, SpaceX & Elon Musk Niche
description: I am looking for a part-time YouTube Research Assistant for a YouTube channel focused on Tesla, SpaceX, and Elon Musk. This is NOT a generic writing job: I am looking for someone who is genuinely and deeply interested and passionate about everything related to Tesla, SpaceX, Elon Musk, and also the businesses/ventures connected to him. This part is very important: if you are not truly interested in these topics, this role is not a good fit for you. I am personally deeply passionate about these topics, and I am looking ONLY for someone who also has a real and genuine passion and interest about these topics. Your main job will be to help with Tesla / SpaceX research, video ideation, and topic development before videos are written. This means you will not only collect information, but also think about how that information could become a strong YouTube video: what the main angle could be, why viewers would care, what the strongest thesis is, and what sources support the idea. Tasks may include: • Finding strong Tesla / SpaceX / Elon Musk sources for future YouTube videos • Spotting possible video ideas from news, interviews, earnings calls, X.com posts, company updates, and market narratives • Turning raw research into possible YouTube angles or theses • Explaining why a topic could be interesting to viewers • Identifying the strongest bull case and bear case for a topic • Reading and summarizing earnings calls, investor updates, official company posts, interviews, articles, and reports • Finding useful quotes, timestamps, clips, charts, or screenshots • Separating confirmed facts from estimates, opinions, rumors, and speculation • Creating clear research briefs that are already oriented toward a YouTube video • Suggesting possible video structures, hooks, and key arguments • Fact-checking scripts or claims before publishing • Helping organize research in Google Docs / Notion / Google Drive At first, the role will mainly focus on research, ideation, fact-checking, and topic development. However, my goal is not to find someone only for a short-term task. My goal is to find the right person to work with long-term, ideally for the years to come. If the collaboration works well, the role could expand over time into helping with outlines, script structure, script drafts, and other parts of the YouTube production process. The role is starting as part-time, but it could grow into more hours or even a full-time role in the future if there is a strong fit on both sides. Also, as the collaboration grows and the person becomes more valuable to the channel, the hourly rate can increase over time based on performance and value. The most important things I am looking for are: 1. Genuine interest in Tesla / SpaceX / Elon Musk 2. Strong English reading and writing 3. Good research ability 4. Ability to think critically, not just copy/paste information 5. Ability to think in terms of YouTube videos, not just general research 6. Strong curiosity and willingness to learn 7. Proactive mindset: someone who can bring ideas, not only wait for instructions 8. Attention to detail 9. Reliability and clear communication 10. Long-term mindset and desire to grow with the channel Please do not apply if you are not genuinely interested in Tesla, SpaceX, Elon Musk, or these types of topics. Generic applications, copy/paste answers, or AI-generated answers without real understanding will not be considered. For the strongest candidates, I will also do a short video call to discuss Tesla, SpaceX, Elon Musk, and the role in more detail. This is mainly to understand if there is a real fit for a long-term collaboration. To apply, please answer these questions in your own words: Please be specific. Generic answers, copy/paste answers, or AI-style answers will not be considered. 1. When did you first become interested in Tesla, SpaceX, or Elon Musk? What specifically triggered your interest? 2. How do you follow these topics in your daily or weekly routine? 3. What was the last Tesla, SpaceX, or Elon Musk-related topic that genuinely interested you and why? 4. Which Tesla product or business do you think most people misunderstand right now? Please explain your reasoning. 5. What is one Tesla-related topic or SpaceX-related topic that you think could become a strong YouTube video right now? What would the main angle be? 6. Name 10 specific sources you use or would use to research Tesla / SpaceX / Elon Musk topics. These can include social media channels, X.com profiles or other sources. 7. Pick one recent Tesla, SpaceX, or Elon Musk-related news item and explain how you would research it for a YouTube video. What sources would you check? What questions would you try to answer? 8. Are you comfortable using Google Docs, Google Drive, and Notion? 9. How many hours per week are you available? 10. What is your hourly rate? 11. Are you only looking for part-time work, or would you be open to increasing your hours in the future if the collaboration works well? If yes, how many hours per week could you realistically work later? There may be a small paid research test for selected candidates before starting regular work. If you are genuinely passionate about Tesla, SpaceX, Elon Musk, and future technology, this could be a very interesting and rewarding role because you would spend your time researching, thinking about, and developing content around these topics. But if these topics do not naturally interest you, this role will probably feel boring very quickly, so please only apply if the interest is real.

title: SEO Content Operations Manager (QA and Editing)
job_title: SEO Content Operations Manager (QA and Editing)
description: Good work should win the work. Rootl helps trades and local service businesses get found, picked and booked online. We exist because good businesses lose to worse ones every day. Not because they're worse at the job, but because the worse ones got found first. It started with advice from an upstairs window to a window cleaner halfway up a ladder. By 2036 we want Rootl to be the UK's most trusted local search company for trades, with our first US hub open. We're building the team that gets us there. Want a seat on the bus? WHAT WE DO We help trades and local service businesses get found on Google, and inside the AI tools their next customer is already searching with: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini. That is the job. We work with plumbers, gas engineers, roofers, joiners, plasterers, drainage crews, window firms, waste and pest control, architects, developers and taxi firms. We run three services, Essentials, Growth and Accelerator, all pointed at one thing: putting our client in front of the customer who is already searching. THE ROLE, IN ONE LINE You own how we deliver. You run our content production from brief to published page across every client, keeping the quality high and the pipeline moving. READ THIS TWICE: THIS IS NOT A WRITING JOB Our AI tools do the heavy drafting. We are not looking for a writer with flair. We need someone who can take a draft and make it genuinely client-ready. That means catching errors, tightening the copy, fixing the SEO, and making sure nothing wrong or sloppy ever reaches a client. The detail is the deliverable. A STRAIGHT WORD ABOUT THIS ROLE This is a brand new seat, and we are building it as we go. The founder needs to step out of the day to day and focus on where Rootl is heading and how we get there. That leaves a real gap, and it is yours to fill. So be clear on what you are walking into. We are moving fast and we do not have every answer yet. Some weeks will feel like organised chaos. This role exists to bring order to it. If that excites you rather than worries you, and you are the sort who turns chaos into a clean, repeatable system, this is your seat. It is a rocket ship, and we want you on board. WHY YOU'D WANT THIS SEAT - A small, focused team built around getting one job done brilliantly. James runs sales and strategy. Our web developer builds the sites. You own the SEO content production system end to end. Three people, three clear lanes, no politics, no meetings about meetings. - Real responsibility from day one. This is not a six-month shadow-the-founder role. - The work is simple by design. It is a series of checklists. We want someone who finds that energising, not boring. - You will not be slotted into someone else's process. You will write the process, recorded with the founder and turned into the Blueprints and SOPs every future Rootl hire is trained on. - Real long-term upside for the person who stays the course. We will talk that through properly once you are established. - Local search is shifting under everyone's feet right now. We are moving fast on it, and you will be at the front. - We hire the right person, not the perfect person. Every candidate is DISC profiled, because the seat has to fit how we work. WHAT YOU WILL OWN - Running our content agent and editing its output to a publish-ready standard - Quality checking every page before it goes ---------- facts, spelling, grammar, British English, tone, and on-page SEO - Working from SEO briefs and making sure each page does the job it is meant to do - Managing our web developer: answering their questions, handing over finished pages, keeping the build on track - Spotting local SEO improvements (Google Business Profile, on-page, internal links) and flagging them - Owning the schedule: what is due, for which client, by when, and hitting it - Running your part of our weekly tea ---------- eting - Taking our SOPs and making the process tighter over time WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - You spot a wrong town or city name, a missing full stop, or a clumsy sentence from a mile off. Detail is your thing. - You would rather follow a proven checklist and run it well than reinvent the wheel each time. - You take pride in doing similar work to a high standard, week in, week out. - You check your own work before anyone else sees it. Things do not slip past you. - You can take an SOP and run with it without being chased. - You want a long-term home where you can own something, not a stepping stone. - Excellent written British English. We will test this. - Solid on-page SEO: titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, alt text, basic schema. - Comfortable editing AI-written content: cutting repetition, fixing flat phrasing, removing the AI tells, and fact-checking. Nice to have, not essential: - Local SEO or Google Business Profile experience - Experience optimising content to get picked up by AI answers (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) - WordPress TOOLS YOU WILL USE Our content agent, WordPress, Google Workspace, Local Dominator, BrightLocal, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. Training and SOPs provided. You do not need every tool on day one, but you do need to learn fast. HOURS, PAY AND HOW IT WORKS - Part-time to start, around 10 to 15 hours a week, paid at $8 USD an hour. - We start with a short unpaid test task so we can see how you work. If it goes well, you move onto a two-week paid trial, paid for the hours you actually work. - Once you pass the trial, we guarantee 40 hours a month as a floor, so there is always a baseline you can count on. In practice you will usually do more. Your hours and your rate both grow as you prove yourself and as we sign more clients, and the aim is to build this into a full-time seat for the right person. - If a client ever leaves and the work drops, we give you at least one week's written notice of any change to your hours. - Paid weekly for your first month, then monthly after that, by Wise. - You track your time in Toggl. Your tracked hours are what you invoice, so it stays clear and fair on both sides. - Every Monday, without fail, we run a 30 minute tea ---------- eting using the LIONS sheet. It is a simple one-page worksheet covering five things: Last week, Issues, Opportunities, the Next seven days, and Successes. You fill yours in and come ready to run your part. If you are ever away, you still send your completed sheet before the meeting. It keeps us aligned and the work on track. - We work UK hours, 9:00 to 4:30. At least half your hours each week need to fall inside that window so we can work together properly. For you in the Philippines that is roughly 4pm to 11:30pm, so an evening pattern fits well. - This is an independent contractor role on a proper written agreement covering confidentiality, client data, and how we pay you. You look after your own taxes in the Philippines, and you provide your own computer, reliable internet, and a quiet place to work. - Four weeks' notice on either side if it is ever not working out. HOW TO APPLY - Start your application with the phrase "I spotted it" so we know you have read this far. - Tell us, in a few lines, about a time you caught a mistake everyone else had missed. - Share any examples of editing, proofreading, or SEO content work you are proud of. - If you get through this first stage, we will send you a short test task: a real page with a few errors planted in it, for you to fix and explain. This first task is unpaid and the same for everyone. If it goes well, the paid trial follows. A LAST WORD We are not the biggest name out there, and we are not trying to be. We are here to show what local search looks like when it is done properly, and we want to be the best in the country at it. We are looking for the person who helps us get there. If you have read this far and something here lit you up, that is a good sign. We read every application that opens the right way. Show us why it should be you. Want a seat on the bus?

job_title: A-Player DM Setter For Men’s Coaching Brand (Performance-Based, Long Term)
description: Read this carefully. If you’re just looking for “any VA job” or fixed hourly pay, this is not for you. I’m Stefan, founder of Status Alpha – a high-ticket mentorship for men who want elite body, energy, mindset and performance. We sell €3.5k–€20k coaching programs to men worldwide. Most clients come from DM conversations. We already flood Instagram, Facebook , TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and X/Twitter with content. Inbound and outbound conversations are only going up. I have a full Content Operating System and A-player closers. Now I want an A-player setter whose only job is: Start smart conversations. Qualify fast. Book calls. Get paid on results. If that excites you, keep reading. MISSION OF THE ROLE Turn warm attention from my content into qualified booked calls for my sales team. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Own DMs on non-bot platforms (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, maybe others). - On Instagram/Facebook, take over stuck / high-intent leads when automations have done their part and a human is needed. - Proactively initiate DMs with warm leads (engagers, commenters, voters) when directed by the team. - Follow proven scripts and flows, adapt when needed, and track results. - Be measured on: - Conversations started - Calls booked - Show-up rate - Sales from your sets This is appointment setting, not closing. No cold calling, no “spray and pray”. You talk to people who already follow or engage with me. DAY-TO-DAY - Check all assigned platforms multiple times per day (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, plus IG/FB stuck/high-intent leads). - Reply to inbound messages using our scripts and training. - Start DMs with warm leads: - People who comment with clear pain/interest - Story viewers / voters (when handed to you) - Engagers on high-performing posts that we flag for you - Qualify leads using our questions (budget, problem, timeline, fit). - Handle basic objections in DMs (time, “not sure”, “need to think”), and route serious buyers to a call. - Book calls on the correct calendar with all required notes. - Keep simple tracking of: - Who you talked to - Who booked from your DMs - Who showed up - Who bought (for commissions) - Follow up old leads consistently. - Occasionally reply to high-intent comments (“how do I work with you?”) and move them into DMs. - Work closely with me and my team to improve scripts based on what you see in the field. You will not create content or do generic admin. Your job is DMs and booking calls. WHO THIS IS FOR - You love sales conversations and messaging. DMs do not drain you. - Written English is 9/10+. You sound natural, not robotic. - You have proven experience as a DM setter / appointment setter / closer (bonus if it was for coaches, consultants or fitness). - You can show proof (numbers, screenshots, client references, or case studies) that you have actually booked calls and driven revenue. - You are hungry. You want uncapped income, not just a small fixed salary. - You like being measured. Numbers do not scare you. - You can work Philippines evenings to overlap with Dubai and US/Europe time zones. - You are okay working 6 days/week with lighter Sundays. Nice-to-have (not required): - Certificates in appointment setting / sales. If you have them, send them. NOT FOR YOU IF - You are scared of rejection or pushback in DMs. - You have zero sales reps and zero proof. - You need someone to tell you what to do every minute. - You are just collecting clients and will disappear in 30 days. COMPENSATION This is performance-driven. - Base: 200–300 USD/month (depending on experience) - Commission: 3–5% of cash collected from clients who buy after calls you set - Our programs are €3,500–€20,000 - Even at the low end, 3–5% is about 110–300+ USD per sale Realistic on-target earnings once ramped: - 15–25+ calls booked/month - 30–40% close rate by our closers You can make 800–1,800+ USD/month once you are dialed in. There is no cap. SCHEDULE - About 35–40 hours/week spread across: - Mon–Sat: core setting hours in the evening PH time (to be agreed) - Sun: lighter check-ins and follow-ups You must be available during agreed core hours, not “whenever”. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS - At least 1 year of experience in appointment setting / DM setting / sales (coaching, agency, SaaS or similar). - Very strong written English (we will test this). - Stable internet + backup (data or second connection) and a quiet place to work. - Comfortable using: - Instagram / Facebook / TikTok / LinkedIn / YouTube DMs - Google Sheets / basic CRM - Loom / Zoom for training - Willing to follow proven scripts AND give feedback to improve them. HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY) 1) Subject line / OnlineJobs title: A-PLAYER SETTER – [Your First Name] 2) In your message, include short, direct answers to: a) Briefly describe your best DM setting or sales experience (1–3 sentences). b) What was your best month ever in terms of calls booked or revenue generated, and for what kind of offer? Share numbers. c) On a scale of 1–10, how strong is your written English? Show me with 2–3 sentences selling me on why I should pick you. d) What monthly income are you aiming for in USD within 3–6 months if you crush it here? e) Confirm your typical working hours in PH time and your availability on Sat/Sun. f) Attach or link proof that you’re a killer in DMs: - Screenshots, metrics, or a simple breakdown (for example: “20 calls booked / 7 closes on $5k offer in one month”), - Any certificates in setting/sales (optional but a plus). 3) OPTIONAL (big plus): Record a 2–3 minute Loom or audio where you: - Introduce yourself - Tell me about a time you turned a dead lead into a booked call - Explain why you’re the best choice for this role Generic or copy-paste applications will be ignored. I am only looking for 1–2 killers who want to grow with the brand long term. If you read this all the way down and you’re fired up, apply now.

Instagram, Facebook , TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and even X/Twitter. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Take raw videos from a Google Drive INBOX and: - Upload to transcription tools - Paste transcripts into Google Docs - Fix grammar, misheard words and punctuation so it reads like a native wrote it - Use AI tools (I provide access and prompts) to: - Generate structured editor briefs - Pull hooks, clip ideas and timestamps - Create and maintain Clip Briefs for the editor: - Fill meta info, link to source files, paste AI briefs - Add simple thumbnail notes (text plus which folder to pull photos from) - Coordinate with the editor: - Move assets through Raw -> Briefed -> Editing -> Needs Revision -> Approved - Watch drafts, write clear revision notes, and approve final versions - Organize assets in Google Drive: - Keep RAW vs PROOF vs Stefan Asset Bank clean - Follow naming conventions and folder structures - Schedule and publish content using native schedulers / tools on: - Instagram and Facebook - TikTok - YouTube Shorts and long form - LinkedIn - X / Twitter - Log monthly performance in a simple sheet: - Add top performing posts with their metrics - Write 3–10 short learnings (patterns, not complex analytics) You get Looms and SOPs for all of this. description: I'm a US-based real estate and small business owner with multiple companies and properties, all using Xero. My books need a full cleanup and catch-up across 2023, 2024, and 2025, in preparation for tax filing with my CPA. This is not simple data entry. I need someone detail-oriented who understands bookkeeping fundamentals — categorizing transactions correctly, reconciling bank feeds, and flagging anything that looks off rather than just guessing. You'll be working across 2-3 separate Xero organizations (a business entity and personal/property accounts), so accuracy and the ability to keep entities separate is critical. What you'll be doing: Reconciling bank and credit card transactions in Xero across multiple organizations Categorizing historical transactions correctly (2023–2025) based on chart of accounts and guidance I'll provide Cleaning up a large backlog of "Uncategorized Expenses" Entering recurring income that hasn't been recorded (e.g., owner-financed note payments) Matching invoices and bills to bank transactions Flagging transactions you're unsure how to categorize rather than guessing Preparing clean monthly reports once cleanup is complete Eventually: setting up recurring monthly invoicing/billing workflows to owners (this becomes the ongoing part-time role) What I need from you: Solid experience with Xero (required — please don't apply if you've only used QuickBooks) Experience with multi-entity or multi-property bookkeeping is a strong plus Comfortable with bank reconciliation, AP/AR, and basic US accounting categorization Detail-oriented and comfortable asking questions when something is unclear, rather than guessing and moving on Able to work independently once given clear direction, but communicate proactively Available for daily or near-daily check-ins during the cleanup phase English fluency for clear written communication Nice to have: Experience working with US-based real estate, property management, or rental income (STR/owner-financed notes) Experience preparing books for CPA tax handoff Familiarity with Hubdoc, Dext, or similar receipt/invoice capture tools To Apply, please include: Your years of experience specifically with Xero Whether you've worked with multiple entities/organizations for one client before Your availability (full-time hours, time zone overlap with US Central Time preferred) Your expected monthly rate for full-time work A short note on how you'd approach a backlog of "uncategorized" transactions spanning 3 years Please do not send generic copy-paste applications — I will prioritize candidates who clearly read this posting.

This role goes beyond technical execution. We're looking for someone who understands how systems work together to generate leads, improve conversions, and maximize customer lifetime value. title: Landscape Architect
description: About the role Calimingo Pools is a growing Southern California pool and outdoor living company. We design and build high-end custom pools, spas, and landscape environments — and we need a sharp, dependable Drafter / Landscape Architect to help us keep projects moving smoothly from design to approved permit. This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in the Philippines. You'll work closely with our US-based designers and engineers, preparing technical drawings and permit packages, communicating with city building departments, and helping manage the full permit lifecycle for multiple projects at a time. We value reliability, strong communication, and someone who takes ownership of their work. What you'll do - Prepare detailed CAD drawings — site plans, section drawings, structural details, and full working plan sets ready for permit submittal. - Coordinate with our US-based designers and structural engineers to gather all information needed to complete permit packages and HOA submittals. - Convert raw job-site measurements into clean, accurate blank site plans for the design team to work from. - Research city planning and zoning requirements (setbacks, easements, code requirements) to ensure designs are buildable before work begins. - Communicate with California city building departments and HOA offices (via email , phone, and online portals) to expedite permit approvals. - Log and update project progress in our project management system, keeping clients and office staff consistently informed across multiple active projects. - Manage revision cycles and respond to plan check corrections from city departments until permits are approved. Required skills Proven experience as a Drafter, Landscape Architect, or similar role Strong hands-on CAD software skills (AutoCAD, SketchUp, or similar) Experience with 3D modeling tools Familiarity with US city building departments and HOA submittal processes Strong written and spoken English communication skills Highly organized, self-directed, and able to manage multiple projects independently Reliable internet connection and a dedicated home workspace Nice to have Background in pool, spa, or outdoor living design Previous remote work experience with a US-based client or employer Artistic eye or rendering ability for presentation drawings Familiarity with project management tools (Buildertrend, Asana, or similar) Degree in Landscape Architecture, Architecture, or Civil/Environmental Design Experience reading and interpreting structural and civil engineering plans What reliability looks like to us We're not looking for someone to clock in and disappear. Our ideal candidate is someone who: Responds promptly Replies to messages within a reasonable window during agreed working hours Meets deadlines Delivers drawings on time and flags issues early — not at the last minute Takes ownership Tracks their own tasks without needing to be chased, and follows through Communicates clearly Keeps the team updated, asks smart questions, and escalates when needed What to expect Overlap with US Pacific Time (PST/PDT) is required All communication and coordination is done remotely via email , video calls, and our project management platform You'll work directly with the project lead, designers, and engineers — a small, collaborative team Volume varies by season — strong project flow with opportunities to grow as the company scales How to apply Apply to this ad with the subject line "Drafter / Landscape Architect – [Your Name]" 1. Your updated CV / resume 2. Portfolio or work samples (CAD drawings, site plans, or similar) 3. A short note (3–5 sentences) on your remote work experience and why this role interests you

title: Remote Video Editor & Graphics Specialist
description: We are looking for a talented, reliable, and creative Remote Video Editor & Graphics Specialist to help edit long-form videos, create short-form reels, and design graphics for social media and marketing. This is a remote position and may be ideal for someone overseas who has strong video editing skills, understands short-form content, and can help turn raw video footage into polished, engaging content. About the Role We create a lot of video content and need someone who can take large videos and turn them into multiple pieces of content. This may include full-length edited videos, short reels, social media clips, thumbnails, captions, graphics, and other visual content. We are not just looking for someone who can “cut videos.” We are looking for someone who understands how to make videos more engaging, how to create strong hooks, how to hold viewer attention, and how to make content look professional while still feeling authentic. Responsibilities The person in this role will be responsible for: Editing long-form videos from raw footage Creating short-form reels, TikToks, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and YouTube Shorts Taking large videos and finding the best short clips inside them Creating strong hooks for short-form videos Cutting out dead space, mistakes, pauses, and unnecessary sections Adding clean, accurate captions/subtitles Adding text overlays, music, transitions, sound effects, and graphics when appropriate Improving pacing so videos are easier and more interesting to watch Basic audio cleanup and volume balancing Basic color correction when needed Creating thumbnails for videos Designing social media graphics, quote graphics, promotional images, and basic marketing visuals Repurposing one long video into multiple pieces of content Organizing video files, edited files, and project folders Following brand guidelines and maintaining a consistent look and feel Suggesting ways to improve content, increase engagement, and create more usable clips from each video Completing revisions based on feedback Types of Content You may be asked to work on: Long-form talking videos Educational videos Personal brand content Business promotional videos Social media reels YouTube-style videos Testimonial-style videos Event videos Lifestyle or family-style content Graphics for social media posts, ads, flyers, thumbnails, and promotions Skills Required The ideal candidate should have experience with some or all of the following: Video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar Graphic design tools such as Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar Short-form vertical video editing Long-form video editing Captioning/subtitles Creating thumbnails Social media graphics Basic audio cleanup Basic color correction Storytelling and pacing Understanding hooks, retention, and viewer attention File organization Meeting deadlines Communicating clearly in English What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who: Has a strong portfolio with real examples Can explain why a video performed well Understands that the first 1–3 seconds of a video are extremely important Knows how to turn one long video into several short reels Understands that every reel should stand alone and make sense by itself Can create clean, readable captions Can make videos look polished without over-editing them Has good design taste Can follow instructions Can work independently Is honest, dependable, and organized Is open to feedback and revisions Takes confidentiality seriously Preferred Experience Experience with the following is a plus, but not required: Editing content for business owners, influencers, coaches, churches, healthcare businesses, home care companies, or personal brands Creating viral-style short-form clips Repurposing long videos into multiple reels YouTube video editing Thumbnail design Canva template creation Motion graphics Social media content planning AI tools for captions, transcription, editing, or content repurposing Education A degree in film, communications, marketing, graphic design, or a related field is a plus, but it is not required. A strong portfolio, good judgment, creativity, reliability, and proven ability to create engaging content are more important than formal education. Confidentiality Requirement Because this role may involve access to private, unpublished, personal, business, or client-related content, the selected candidate will be required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement and Confidentiality Agreement before receiving access to any files. You must agree not to share, copy, publish, distribute, save, reuse, or disclose any content, footage, audio, images, business information, client information, personal information, or private materials provided to you. You may not use our content in your portfolio, samples, social media, website, or promotional materials without written permission. Any unauthorized sharing, leaking, distribution, or misuse of our content may result in termination and potential legal or financial responsibility for damages caused by the breach. Application Requirements To apply, please send the following: A short introduction about yourself Your video editing experience Your graphic design experience A link to your portfolio Three short-form videos you edited One long-form video you edited One thumbnail or graphic design example Your best-performing video link A short explanation of why that video performed well The account size at the time the video was posted, if known The number of views the video received Whether the video was organic or boosted/paid The software and tools you use Your expected monthly rate or hourly rate Your availability and preferred work schedule Your internet speed and computer specifications Confirmation that you are willing to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement Confirmation that you will not share, reuse, post, or distribute any private content Confirmation that you will not use our content in your portfolio without written permission A short explanation of how you would turn one 30-minute video into several short reels Applications without sample work, portfolio links, or clear answers may not be considered. Important Question Please answer this question in your application: If we gave you a 30-minute raw video, how would you d ---------- which parts should become short reels? We are looking for someone who understands hooks, viewer attention, storytelling, pacing, captions, and how to make each short video stand on its own. Paid Test Project Qualified applicants may be asked to complete a short paid test project before being hired. The test project may include: Creating one 30–45 second reel from raw footage Creating one 60–90 second reel from raw footage Editing a cleaned-up 2–3 minute version of a video Adding captions Creating one thumbnail or social media graphic Writing a short caption for the post The test project will help us evaluate editing style, pacing, caption quality, creativity, communication, and ability to follow instructions. Work Arrangement This is a remote position. We are open to part-time, full-time, or contract arrangements depending on skill level, availability, quality of work, and pricing. Please include your desired schedule and pay expectations when applying.

title: Web Designer (High-End Interactive & Animation Focus)

We are building a culture of the industry’s brightest talent while creating a fun, hardworking, and collaborative environment. We are the ultimate resource for our clients, offering SEM/PPC, Web Design, Graphic Design, Social Media Management, Copywriting + Blogging, Email Marketing, Photography, and Videography. As we continue to grow our team, clientele, and company, we recognize that our success comes directly from talented individuals who thrive in a collaborative environment and push creative boundaries. Our mission is to save, support, and serve small businesses around the world while cultivating a culture that allows our team to be creative, innovative, and inspired. We are specifically looking for designers who go beyond template-style websites and have the ability to create dynamic, visually engaging experiences through layout, motion, animations, and strong visual storytelling. You should be excited about experimenting with layouts, subtle motion, and micro-interactions that elevate the experience and make a site feel modern and high-end. We’re looking for someone whose portfolio includes bold, creative, or interactive websites that truly stand out — not just functional builds. This role will work closely with the Web Manager and collaborate with designers, developers, and marketing strategists to bring client brands to life online. title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description: I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us. I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company. If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply: REQUIRED EXPERIENCE: - Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar & Email Management, etc) You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to email & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language -- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software - 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram, Facebook , Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus - Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-) - Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and email service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc) ABOUT YOU: - “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable. - Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects. - You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months. - You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth - You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving. - Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday. - You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources. - You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for. If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply. PERKS: I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in: - Task & Calendar Management - Launch/Sales Strategy Planning - Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses) - Social Media Management - Digital Media Marketing (Including Email and SMS Marketing) - Lead Generation After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include: - Part time work hours - Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast) - Starting Salary at $500 USD a month ($6000 USD annual) - Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn) Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: Brand and Graphic Designer
description: SKYR N BOWLS Brand & Graphic Designer (Remote) — Build the Look of an Exciting New Miami Wellness Brand We’re a brand-new health-food concept launching in Miami, and we’re looking for a talented graphic designer to create our entire visual identity from the ground up. This is a rare chance to put your fingerprints on a brand from day one — the logo, the colors, the menus, the packaging, the whole feel. If you love clean, modern, aspirational design and want a project you’ll be proud to show off, keep reading. Who We Are Skyr N Bowls is Miami’s first protein bowl built on authentic Icelandic skyr — nearly 40g of protein, no added sugar, real ingredients, beautifully made. Think of the gorgeous, Instagram-ready açai bowl, but reinvented around a genuinely healthy, high-protein base. Our signature bowls have names like Lúcuma, Pink Coconut, Caffao, and Açai Bliss. We sit right at the intersection of fitness, wellness, and beautiful aesthetics that defines Miami’s active culture. The brand should feel calm, clean, and aspirational — a small daily luxury, not just food. There’s a lovely international travel story woven through it too: Iceland, Amsterdam, Barcelona, and Miami. The Creative Vision We already have a clear point of view, and now we need a designer to bring it fully to life. Here’s the feeling we’re going for: • A soft, sky-blue color palette — fresh, cool, and unmistakably ours. • Minimalist, modern styling with lots of light and breathing room. • Aspirational and wellness-forward — it should feel like permission to enjoy something delicious without any guilt. • Keywords to keep front and center: real food, balance, vitality, self-care, trust, and freshness. You’ll have real creative ownership here. We want your ideas, your eye, and your craft — not just hands to execute. The right person gets to define how an entire brand looks and feels. What You’ll Create This is a launch project first, with ongoing design work to follow as we grow. To start, you’ll design: • A complete logo suite and brand identity. • Our color palette, typography, and a simple brand guidelines document. • Menu cards and price boards. • Packaging — cups, labels, branded stickers, and to-go items. • In-store signage and display graphics. • Loyalty cards and promotional pieces. • A starter kit of social media templates and launch content for Instagram and TikTok. Once the brand is established, we’d love to keep working with you on an ongoing basis for social content, new campaigns, and seasonal designs as the business expands from our pilot toward a flagship Miami café. Who We’re Looking For • A strong portfolio in branding and graphic design — ideally with food, beverage, wellness, or lifestyle work. • A real sense of modern, minimalist aesthetics and clean typography. • Skilled in industry-standard tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Figma, or Canva Pro). • Able to take a brand vision and run with it — thoughtful, self-directed, and detail-oriented. • Good written English and clear, responsive communication for remote collaboration. • Reliable, organized, and able to hit deadlines. Why You’ll Love This Project • Build a real brand from scratch — a standout, complete identity for your portfolio. • Creative freedom and a direct line to the founders, with no layers of bureaucracy. • Fully remote, flexible hours — work from wherever you are. • A genuine chance for an ongoing, long-term working relationship as we grow. • A fun, positive, healthy brand you’ll actually enjoy designing for. How to Apply Please send your portfolio (or a link to it) along with a short note about why this project excites you. If you have any food, beverage, or wellness branding in your portfolio, point us to it. We can’t wait to see your work and find the designer who’ll help shape the face of Skyr N Bowls. Eating healthy is an act of self-love — come help us make it beautiful.

Full-time and long-term for the right person, not a one-off gig. ------------------------------------------------------------ ABOUT US ------------------------------------------------------------ You'll be working with a fast-growing health and wellness brand scaling hard in the US market. We run a huge creative team that ships a high volume of paid ad creatives every week, and we spend serious money on ads — so the work you make actually goes out and gets tested at scale. You'll see real numbers on your edits, not just upload and forget. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHO I'M LOOKING FOR ------------------------------------------------------------ A direct response editor who makes ads built to perform, not just look nice. If you've only ever done pretty edits with no understanding of what makes an ad convert, this probably isn't for you. You should be able to cut these ad styles confidently: - AI UGC ads - Voiceover + b-roll style ads - Greenscreen / AI avatar style - Claymation / Pixar / 3D animation style - Podcast-style ads - And honestly, whatever style is winning right now You'll be making a high volume of AI-generated creative — AI UGC, claymation, Pixar-style, podcast ads, avatars, and more — so you need to be genuinely comfortable producing and blending AI generative assets into ads that convert. ------------------------------------------------------------ THE ACTUAL EDITING SKILLS YOU NEED ------------------------------------------------------------ This is the part people usually leave vague, so let me be specific. Day to day, you'll need to be genuinely good at: HOOKS & RETENTION EDITING You understand the first 3 seconds make or break an ad. You know how to open strong, hold attention with pattern interrupts, zooms, jump cuts, and pacing, and keep someone watching to the CTA. PACING & RHYTHM You cut to the energy of the voiceover/script — tight where it needs to be, never letting a clip drag. Your edits feel fast and snappy without being messy. STORYTELLING TO A SCRIPT You can take a VO or ad script and build the visual story around it: matching b-roll, on-screen text, and beats to what's being said so the message actually lands. B-ROLL SOURCING & SEQUENCING You know how to find (or generate) the right supporting footage and place it so it reinforces the message, not just fills space. CAPTIONS & ON-SCREEN TEXT Clean, readable, well-timed subtitles and kinetic text — styled to match the brand, synced properly, and used to drive retention (not just slapped on). SOUND DESIGN Music selection that fits the mood, proper audio leveling, SFX and "whooshes" on transitions, ducking music under VO. Bad audio kills good visuals. BASIC MOTION GRAPHICS & TEXT ANIMATION Simple, clean animated text, callouts, highlights, and transitions that look professional. COLOR & CLEANUP Basic correction so clips match and look consistent, plus a clean, polished finish (no jarring cuts, no random aspect-ratio jumps). AI GENERATION You can actually prompt and produce usable assets — AI UGC clips, claymation, Pixar-style, avatars, b-roll, images — and blend them into a real ad so it doesn't look obviously AI. ORGANIZATION Named files, tidy project structure, hitting deadlines. You make it easy for the team to work with you. ------------------------------------------------------------ TOOLS YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW ------------------------------------------------------------ CapCut, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Kling, Veo 3, Nano Banana, Higgsfield — and whatever else is current in the gen-AI stack. This space changes every single week and I need someone who actually keeps up, not someone I have to drag along. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT YOU'LL OWN (KPIs) ------------------------------------------------------------ DAILY OUTPUT: 1–3+ high-quality ad creatives per day, following our scripts and styles. 70% FIRST-PASS APPROVAL RATE: At least 7 out of 10 of your submissions should require no revisions — meaning they match the brief and are ready to test. AVAILABILITY: Online and responsive Monday–Friday. Weekends are optional but encouraged for the people who want to climb the leaderboard faster. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT MATTERS MOST (BEYOND THE SKILLS) ------------------------------------------------------------ - DTC experience is a must. You've already worked with one or more DTC / ecom brands — this is non-negotiable. Show me the work. - You use AI tools daily and stay updated as new ones drop. - Mindset — this is the big one. Coachable, fast learner, growth-oriented, and the type who tries to overdeliver instead of doing the bare minimum. You don't have to be perfect on day one. But you should be good enough to hit the ground running and hungry enough to keep leveling up. We've got a head editor who'll guide you on frameworks, hook structures, and what actually makes an ad win — so this is a genuine chance to learn ecom and direct response from the inside while getting paid well to do it. ------------------------------------------------------------ COMPENSATION ------------------------------------------------------------ Base retainer: $1,000–$1,500/month, depending on your skill level and experience. Retainers go up over time as your skills grow and you take on more responsibility. Leaderboard bonuses — on top of your retainer. Here's how it works: the editor with the highest number of winning ads gets first place, and so on. The whole team is ranked on a leaderboard each month, and the top 5 editors get paid bonuses on top of their base. The better your creatives perform, the higher you climb, the more you earn. ???? 1st place: $[500] ???? 2nd place: $[400] ???? 3rd place: $[300] 4?? 4th place: $[200] 5?? 5th place: $[100] We spend at a scale where this adds up to real money for editors who consistently ship winners. The leaderboard isn't just for show — it's there so the people putting in the work actually get rewarded for it. ------------------------------------------------------------ THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF ------------------------------------------------------------ - You make pretty videos but don't understand direct response. If you can't explain why a hook works or what makes an ad convert, this isn't the role. - You need hand-holding. You'll get guidance and frameworks from our head editor, but you're expected to manage your own workload, hit deadlines, and solve problems without constant check-ins. - You're a one-tool specialist who resists learning new things. Our stack changes weekly. If a new AI tool drops and the team adopts it overnight, you need to pivot without frustration. - You see this as "just a job." The people who win here are genuinely into short-form, AI creative, and direct response — and want to grow with a fast-scaling brand, not clock in and out. ------------------------------------------------------------ HOW TO APPLY ------------------------------------------------------------ In your proposal, include: - The Names of the previous Ecom Brands/Companies you have edited for - A short description of your current skillset. - A few examples of past ad creative work (UGC, voiceover, animation — whatever you've got) to back it up, including the DTC brand(s) you've worked with. Then answer these questions: 1. Pick one ad creative you've made that performed well. Break down WHY it worked from a direct-response angle — the hook, pacing, offer, CTA, or any specific editing choice that drove the result. 2. Tell me about a creative that underperformed. How did you use the performance data to figure out why, what did you change in the next version, and what happened? 3. Walk me through how you produce AI UGC or generative ads (claymation, Pixar, podcast, avatar, etc.) so they don't look obviously AI. What's your process and which tools do you reach for? 4. This role is high-volume — 1 to 3+ creatives a day. Describe your experience working at that kind of pace and how you keep quality high while moving fast. Include the code word 'ScaleMode' somewhere in your application. I only review applications that include it — it tells me you actually read the post and pay attention to detail. Then submit the trial task after you send your proposal. That's it. Looking forward to seeing what you can do.

title: Operations & Knowledge-System Operator — AI-Native Infrastructure Business
job_title: Operations & Knowledge-System Operator — AI-Native Infrastructure Business
description: ## About us, in plain terms Blue Harbour ( ---------- )  helps large infrastructure organisations achieve **capital certainty** — a clear, governed, trustworthy view of where their capital programmes stand and the decisions behind them. We use AI to deliver that with a speed and diligence traditional consulting can't match: what used to take a consulting team weeks, we turn around fast and well. We're already live with our first major client in New Zealand, opening in Australia next, and built to expand into new markets after that. AI is *how we work*, not what we sell. We sell certainty; AI is our edge in producing it. We're hiring our **first operator** — the person who runs the commercial engine of the business so it keeps running and replicating into new markets. ## The role in one line Run the commercial machine end-to-end — the product-and-knowledge engine that turns delivered work into reusable assets, the business-development pipeline, the executive backbone, and research — with the judgment to know what to handle and what to escalate. ## What you'll actually do - **Run the product-and-knowledge engine — this is the heart of the role.** We turn every piece of delivered work into reusable, sellable product: the features, methods and analysis built for one client become the templates, modules and playbooks we deploy for the next. We run a structured, AI-operated "second brain" that several people contribute to, and it's already built. Your job is to keep it coherent *and* to drive the loop that converts one-off delivery into canonical, reusable assets — enforce the conventions, keep the canonical material clean and current, turn finished work into templates, and make the repeatable version of what we do one of our most valuable assets. You steward and systematise against the founder's "what good looks like"; you don't have to author the product judgment, you have to capture and compound it. - **Run the growth pipeline — Australia next.** Research and qualify the organisations we'd work with as we open a new market — whether we partner to sell and deliver, or go direct — keep the CRM current, and draft the outreach and pitches. You run the funnel right up to the close; the founder holds the relationships and closes. As you go, you help capture *how* it's done — the repeatable version of "find and win the next market" is itself one of the assets we're building. - **Hold the executive backbone.** Inbox, calendar, follow-up, focus protection. Nothing drops. - **Build the pipeline of high-value rooms and relationships.** Research and organise the events, forums, and introductions that grow our network in target markets. You handle the research and logistics; the founder handles the relationships once he's in the room. - **Run onboarding for new tea ---------- mbers.** As we bring on technical and delivery people, you run the onboarding scaffolding — training flow, a guided path through the system, the day-to-day "where does this live" — so they get productive without the founder running it. (You're building the scaffolding a future delivery team will run.) - **Draft offers of service** from a brief to ~70% off our template library; the founder takes them the rest of the way. - **Run market and competitive research** — pricing, positioning, landscape, and which market to open next — delivered as a clear, decision-useful read with sources, not a pile of links. You'll use AI throughout — the same way the business does, as the tool that makes the work fast and thorough. Day one, that means using AI with judgment to do real work; over time, you'll grow into genuinely running an AI-operated company, a skill that compounds and that almost no one has yet. ## What you get - **USD 2,000–3,000/month**, depending on experience. This is a **full-time, single-client role**, and we pay a fair full-time rate specifically so you don't need a second client splitting your focus. The pay and the single-client commitment are two halves of the same deal. - **Benefits from day one:** private health cover (HMO), a 13th-month equivalent, paid leave, and an equipment/internet allowance. We're hiring for the long term and we structure the role that way. - **A provided AI tooling seat.** - **Real growth without having to leave to get it.** You'll become fluent in running an AI-native operation — a rare and rising skill — and the role's scope deepens as the business opens new markets. - **Stability.** This is a long-term seat at a growing business, not a project or a stop-gap. We're looking for someone who wants one solid, high-trust role for years, not the next rung. ## Ramp & hours - Part-time for the first 6–8 weeks while you learn the system, **paid as a fixed monthly retainer** (not pro-rata), then full rate once you're up to speed — sooner if you're ready. - Remote, with a **minimum 4 hours' daily overlap with New Zealand business hours** (Manila daytime — no night shifts). When in your day the rest of the work happens is flexible; the overlap and "nothing drops" are not. ## Who this is for If you've run an operation end-to-end and been trusted with the whole picture before, you'll recognize this role. We're looking for someone who: - leads with **judgment** — knows what to handle, what to escalate, and what to push back on; - turns **one-offs into reusable assets** — instinctively makes the second version a template, not another from-scratch job, and can tell what's reusable from what's client-specific; - thinks in **systems and conventions** — can keep a shared system coherent as more people use it, without bottlenecking everything through themselves; - **finishes** — work arrives done and self-checked, not at 80%-and-back-to-you; - writes **clearly and fast**, and can hold someone else's voice; - uses **AI with judgment** — knows when to trust it, when not to, and when to do it by hand; - is **discreet by instinct**, not just when told; - wants a **long-term, single-client seat** and the security that comes with it. This is a high-responsibility, high-ownership role. The right person is bracing for that — for owning outcomes and holding the line on what matters — not for anything else.
