title: Ready to Help Build a Luxury LGBT Real Estate Brand in Charlotte, NC? Let's Grow Together.
job_title: Ready to Help Build a Luxury LGBT Real Estate Brand in Charlotte, NC? Let's Grow Together.
description: Who We Are Jonathan Winn Real Estate is a Charlotte, NC-based real estate practice built on three non-negotiables: concierge-level client service, high-impact property marketing and a relentless commitment to growth.  We do not do average. Our clients are buying and selling some of the most significant assets of their lives, and they deserve to feel that every step of the process is handled with care, expertise, and intention. We market our listings like a luxury brand. We treat our clients like family. And we show up every single day looking for the next person we can serve. We are proudly LGBT-owned and deeply embedded in the LGBT real estate community through the KW Rainbow Network and our local LGBT community in Charlotte. Our brand reflects our values which are authenticity, inclusion, and doing right by people in everything we do.  We always do the right thing, even when no one is looking. This is not a job for someone who wants to clock in and clock out. This is a role for someone who is genuinely excited about building a business, who takes initiative without being asked, who sees opportunities before they become obvious, and who understands that their fingerprints will be all over the growth of this company. If you have experience in real estate sales operations and you know what it takes to grow a real estate business, we want to hear from you. The Role We are looking for a sharp, experienced, and growth-minded Virtual Operations and Marketing Coordinator to run the systems that keep our pipeline full, our clients cared for, and our brand visible.  And in everything that we do, help us identify new opportunities to grow and generate more clients to serve. This is a full-time role with real responsibility. You will not just execute tasks. You will be expected to assess our current operations, spot gaps and opportunities, and bring ideas and solutions to the table proactively. The right person will become an indispensable strategic partner in growing this business. This role has a clear path to team leadership as the business scales. Your Responsibilities will include: CRM & Database Management (Follow Up Boss) - Organize, clean, and maintain our contact database - Input new contacts and business cards into FUB and create corresponding vCard files - Tag leads correctly and flag daily follow-up opportunities each morning - Prepare a daily "who to reach out to today" priority list for Jonathan Add new KW Rainbow Network members, enroll them in a welcome sequence, and invite them to connect with Jonathan via calendar booking link - Build, manage, and continuously improve action plans and automations for all of our target audiences, including prospects, other real estate agents, current active clients, clients who have closed business with us, and more. Email Newsletters - Draft and send our monthly sphere newsletter using Jonathan's brand voice - Draft and send our monthly agent referral newsletter to approximately 2,500 real estate agents nationwide - Support re-engagement campaigns for dormant client lists - Proactively suggest newsletter content, subject lines, and improvements based on what is working Direct Mail & Farm Marketing - Coordinate monthly mailers across three farm lists via Wise Pelican or similar mail service - Rotate mailer formats monthly to keep outreach fresh and engaging - Maintain, clean, and grow all farm address lists Social Media & Brand - Schedule and post to Instagram, Facebook , and LinkedIn on a consistent cadence - Keep website up-to-do with monthly blog posts that are relevant - Design on-brand graphics in Canva using our brand kit - Set up and maintain our brand kit in Canva - Monitor social performance and proactively suggest content improvements - Support the creation and launch of a Youtube channel Client Experience Communications - Build and maintain a milestone communication library for every stage of a transaction - Manage a past client nurture schedule including monthly touches, anniversaries, and holiday outreach - Send review requests after every closing and actively manage our online reputation - Identify gaps in the client experience and recommend improvements Market Intelligence & Content Research - Deliver a weekly brief covering Charlotte events, neighborhood market activity, listing trends, and content ideas for YouTube and social media - Track listing activity and market trends in our farm areas so Jonathan always has fresh talking points - Research competitor agents and identify opportunities to differentiate our brand RealScout Management - Set up, edit, pause, and manage client property searches - Add home value alerts after closing Business Growth & Strategy - Assess our current operations and proactively identify bottlenecks, missed opportunities, and areas for improvement - Bring one idea per week for growing the pipeline, improving client experience, or strengthening the brand - Track key business metrics and flag trends Jonathan should know about - Help build systems and processes that scale as the team grows Required Skills and Experience: To qualify for this role you will need at least 2 years of experience in the following: - Real estate operations, transaction support, or real estate sales marketing -- you must understand how a real estate business grows - CRM management --> Follow Up Boss experience is a strong plus - Email newsletter creation and database management - Social media posting, scheduling, and performance monitoring - Canva design using brand templates Who You Are (Soft Skills) This role is for someone who is genuinely wired for growth. You will thrive here if you are: - A self-starter and initiative-taker --> you do not wait to be told what to do next. You see what needs to happen and you make it happen - Growth minded --> you understand that feeding the pipeline is everyone's job, not just the agent's, and you actively look for ways to help the business grow - A strategic thinker --> you can zoom out, assess a business, and bring insights and recommendations, not just completed tasks - A proactive communicator --> you flag issues before they become problems and bring solutions, not just questions - Detail-oriented --> nothing slips through without you catching it first - Reliable and independent --> you can work autonomously across a 12-plus hour time difference without daily hand-holding - Genuinely aligned with and proud to represent an LGBT-owned, community-rooted luxury real estate brand Basic Technical Requirements In addition to excellent written English you will need to be comfortable with the following tools: - Follow Up Boss (CRM) - Wise Pelican (or similar direct mail system) - RealScout (property search management) - Canva (graphic design) - Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets) - Instagram, Facebook , LinkedIn - Slack (daily communication) - Creating and managing a Trello or Asana task management system - Zoom or Google Meet (weekly check-in) Desired Skills (Nice to Have but Not Required) If you have the following skills they will give you a significant advantage: - Prior experience building CRM action plans, automations, or drip campaign sequences - Experience analyzing real estate business metrics and making growth recommendations - YouTube content planning or video coordination experience - Experience managing or training other virtual assistants Work Schedule and Holidays - This is a full-time position at 40 hours per week. - Hours are flexible but you must have consistent availability that overlaps with US Eastern Time business hours. Daily morning or afternoon overlap with Charlotte, NC business hours is required -- not optional. - We honor most Filipino national holidays. Specific holidays will be discussed and agreed upon at the start of employment. Technical Requirements (Non-Negotiable) - A reliable, up-to-date computer capable of running Follow Up Boss, Canva, Google Workspace, and social media platforms simultaneously - Fast, stable internet connection with a minimum of 10 Mbps -- please include your speed test result in your application - Quiet, dedicated workspace for daily communication and weekly Zoom calls Salary and Compensation - Base salary: $400/week ($1,600/month), full-time - Performance bonus: $100 for every real estate transaction that closes while you are part of the team. This is not a gift --> it is a recognition that your work in keeping the pipeline warm, the database clean, and the marketing consistent directly contributes to every closed deal. When Jonathan wins, you win.  This is a Winn-Winn. Perks and Benefits After successfully completing your 3-month probationary period with clear 30, 60, and 90-day performance metrics met, you will be eligible for: - 13th month bonus - $100 closing bonus per transaction (effective immediately upon hire for all new under contract transactions) - Path to increased base compensation as the business grows - Opportunity to grow into a team lead role managing other virtual staff Training Provided You will receive full onboarding training on our tools, systems, brand voice, and workflows including Loom video walkthroughs and a structured Week 1 onboarding plan. We invest in the people who invest in us. That said , we are also looking for someone who can look at what we have and tell us what we are missing. The best candidate will come in curious, ask smart questions, and start contributing ideas from day one. Career Potential - This role is designed to grow with the business. As Jonathan scales toward building a full team and stepping into a rainmaker leadership role, the right person in this position will grow into a Director of Virtual Operations who manages other VAs, owning systems, and playing a key role in the expansion of the business. - We are not looking for someone to fill a seat. We are looking for someone to help build something. How to Apply We review every application personally. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Please send all six of the following and use the subject line: "I'm Your Winn-Winn VA" 1. Your resume or work history with real estate experience clearly highlighted 2. A short paragraph in your own words -- no templates, no copy-paste or AI generated responses -- explaining why you are the right fit for this specific role and this specific brand 3. Your Follow Up Boss experience level: none, beginner, intermediate, or advanced 4. One example of a time you helped a business grow including what did you do, what was the result, and how did you know it was working 5. Your computer specs and internet speed in Mbps (please include a speed test screenshot if possible) 6. Your available working hours and how they overlap with US Eastern Time

This is real print-production work — not social media graphics — so you must understand building at scale, CMYK, bleed/safety areas, and how to package files to a vendor spec sheet. ## What you'll do - Design and produce **14? × 48? static bulletin** and **digital bulletin** artwork from our brand template and copy. - Build every file to the **exact vendor spec sheet** (size, scale, resolution, color mode, bleed, safety area) for Lamar / Clear Channel Outdoor / OUTFRONT. - Professionally **cut out / mask portrait photos** (clean edges on hair and shoulders) and composite them onto brand backgrounds. - Maintain a **consistent template system** across 45+ variations using master files, smart objects, and styles. - Apply OOH best practices: short readable copy (?7 words), large legible type, high contrast, correct legal disclaimer placement. - Prepare **print-ready packaged files** (CMYK, outlined fonts, embedded/linked images, PDF/X export) and **RGB digital JPGs**. - Source or recommend **high-resolution photography** where our supplied images are too small for print. - Handle revisions, proofs, and "overage" copy; hit vendor deadlines (copy is typically due ~10 working days before a board runs). ## Required skills & experience - **3+ years** professional graphic design with **real large-format / OOH / billboard or print-production experience** (portfolio required). - **Expert in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop** (InDesign a plus). - Strong **typography and layout** — you understand legibility at distance. - Professional **photo cutout / masking / retouching**. - Solid **print production** knowledge: CMYK, resolution-at-scale (building 1 inch = 1 foot), bleed & safety area, rich black, packaging files, and PDF/X export. - Understanding of **digital OOH** requirements: RGB, exact pixel dimensions, static-only (no animation). - **High attention to detail** and the discipline to follow exact spec sheets. - **Good written English** and responsive, reliable communication. ## Bonus points - Experience with **U.S. political / advocacy / issue advertising**. - Experience working directly to **Lamar / Clear Channel Outdoor / OUTFRONT** specs. - Comfort **sourcing and licensing high-resolution stock or photography**. - Basic **motion / DOOH** skills (a plus, not required). ## Tools you'll need - Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator + Photoshop required; InDesign a plus) - Reliable internet and computer capable of handling large print files - File sharing (Google Drive / Dropbox) ## Reference — the specs you'll build to | | Static 14?×48? bulletin | Digital bulletin | |---|---|---| | Build scale | 1 inch = 1 foot | Pixel-exact | | File size | ~49? × 15? trim (1? bleed); 48? × 14? live/safety | 1400 × 400 px (varies per board) | | Resolution | 150 ppi at scaled size | 72 dpi | | Color mode | CMYK | sRGB / RGB | | Format | High-res packaged PDF, fonts outlined | High-res JPG | | Motion | n/a | Static only, no animation | *(Exact specs vary by board — you must read and follow each vendor's individual spec sheet.)* --- ## How to apply — please read carefully (we filter applications) 1. **Start your message with the word "BULLETIN"** so we know you read the full post. 2. Send your **portfolio link**, and point us to any **billboard / large-format / OOH / print** work specifically. 3. In 2–3 sentences, explain **the difference between preparing a static 14×48 bulletin file vs. a digital bulletin file** (think color mode, scale/resolution, format). 4. Tell us your **availability** and your **rate** (and whether you prefer hourly, monthly, or per-board). Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed. ## Paid test (shortlisted candidates only) We'll invite finalists to a **small paid test**: using a portrait, copy, and brand colors we provide, deliver — - **(a)** a print-ready **14? × 48? bulletin** built at 1 inch = 1 foot, **150 ppi, CMYK**, with 1? bleed and a correct 48?×14? safety area, exported as a packaged print **PDF**; and - **(b)** a **1400 × 400 px, sRGB digital bulletin JPG** of the same design. We pay for the test and review the files for spec accuracy, type legibility, and clean photo cutouts.

description: The one-line mission: Build us a list — by any means necessary. Online, offline, paid, organic, cold, warm, or hot. The list is the asset that pays this company. You own getting names, email s, and phone numbers into our pipeline, and you live by one number: qualified leads added per dollar spent. Who We Are THE MISSION YOU'D BE JOINING Patrick Capital Group builds brands that help everyday people break generational cycles and build real wealth and freedom. Pay GROWTH-DRIVEN, BUILT TO SCALE WITH RESULTS Build-phase base to start, with pay that climbs as the list grows and revenue follows. We pay for results, and we pay more as you deliver them. We’re building a real brand and want someone who wants to grow with us long-term.

title: Order Operations Specialist (Remote - Excellent English!)
description: About the role We run a social engagement and brand-visibility service. Most of our order volume is delivered automatically by our system, but a steady stream of orders is fulfilled by hand, and every customer message needs a fast, clear, human reply. Right now those two things slip: customers wait days for answers and often cannot tell whether their order was actually delivered. You will own that gap end to end. This is a detail-and-follow-through job, not a creative one. If you like clearing a queue to zero and leaving customers with a clear answer, you will do well here. What you will do - Answer customers quickly and clearly (the core of the job). Most questions are "when will this be delivered?", "it says delivered but I don't see it," and "can you redo or change this?" You will open the order, confirm what happened, reply with a proof link, set expectations, and close the loop. Today many of these go unanswered and turn into refund requests. Your job is to make sure that stops. - Fulfill the orders we do not automate. For each by-hand order, you do the work and record it: ---------- ments, Quora answers and upvotes, X comments, YouTube comments, Threads followers and likes, ProductHunt upvotes, AI and community brand mentions, and blog citations. You post or deliver the engagement, paste the proof link, and mark each unit delivered as it goes live (for example, an order of 15 brand mentions gets updated one by one as each is posted). - Keep status and proof accurate. Every active order should show the right status with a link or screenshot proving it is real. The single biggest complaint we get is "it shows delivered but I cannot find it." You make that complaint disappear. - Resolve issues. When something is removed, shadowbanned, or a count drops, re-deliver it or escalate. Process refunds or store credit when it is the right call. Handle custom comment text and edit requests. - Review and flag. Screen the content customers ask us to post, and flag anything inappropriate, harmful, or that you cannot resolve, rather than guessing. - What you will not do: the automated deliveries themselves (Reddit upvotes, downvotes, and comments are handled by our system). You still answer the customer messages about those orders and resolve problems, but you do not deliver them. You should have - Excellent written English. You will be writing to customers all day, often when they are frustrated. - Real attention to detail and follow-through. Orders have many small units, and each one needs proof. - Ownership. We need someone who clears the queue every day and does not let it pile up. - Comfort with web dashboards and the major social platforms (Reddit, LinkedIn, X, Quora, YouTube, Threads, ProductHunt). - Discretion and professionalism. You will see customer details and order content. Nice to have - Customer support or virtual assistant experience. - Familiarity with social media growth or engagement services. To apply Start your message with the word SIGNAL so we know you read this all the way through. In a few sentences, tell us about a time a customer was upset with you and exactly how you turned it around.

description: SENIOR MEDIA BUYER — FASHION DTC (META, TIKTOK & GOOGLE) Experienced buyers only · Fashion e-commerce brands · Remote · Long-term Please read this entire post before applying. WHO WE ARE We operate a growing portfolio of e-commerce fashion brands. We run a real operation: a dedicated creative team, a finance & analytics function that sets clear acquisition targets, and a documented system for how media buying is run here. You'd be joining an established structure, not building one from scratch. THE ROLE We're hiring an experienced media buyer to take several fashion brands off our plate and scale them profitably. You'll be handed an ad account, introduced to the creative designer you'll work with, given a clear NCPA (New Customer Cost Per Acquisition) target per brand from our finance team, and our internal Media Buyer Operating Manual. From there, you run it. Your job is simple to state and hard to do well: hit the NCPA target on every brand you run, and scale spend profitably. You'll have full autonomy to make daily scale/cut/test decisions within our framework — we don't micromanage buyers who deliver. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Plan, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Google for multiple fashion brands - Hit and protect the NCPA target finance sets for each brand — scaling spend while staying profitable on new-customer acquisition - Work directly with your assigned creative designer: request, brief, and test new creatives and angles - Make daily scale / hold / cut / test decisions using our decision framework - Manage budgets, pacing, audiences, and creative testing across platforms - Report performance weekly, with a deeper monthly review WHO YOU ARE (HARD REQUIREMENTS) Do not apply unless ALL of these are true. We are not training anyone on the fundamentals — you must already be able to do this work on day one. - Proven, hands-on experience running Meta, TikTok, AND Google ads — not one or two of them, all three - Specific experience with FASHION / apparel e-commerce brands. You understand fashion buyers, seasonality, creative trends, and how fashion catalogs convert. General e-comm or lead-gen experience is not the same thing - You've owned acquisition to a CPA / CAC / ROAS target before and can speak to real numbers you hit and how - You can work independently with full autonomy — follow a documented system, make your own daily decisions, and deliver results without hand-holding - Strong written English for clear remote communication and reporting You are NOT a fit if: you're a generalist VA who "also does ads," you've only run one platform, you've never worked with fashion brands, you need to be taught how campaigns work, or you're looking for a short-term gig. This is a serious, long-term seat. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with subscription / membership fashion models - Comfort with Advantage+ / catalog ads and CAPI setup - Experience managing multiple brands or ad accounts at once HOW WE WORK / WHAT YOU GET - Clear NCPA targets per brand from a dedicated finance & analytics function — you're never guessing what "profitable" means - A dedicated creative designer to brief and request from - A documented Media Buyer Operating Manual so expectations and decision rules are explicit from day one - Full autonomy to run your brands within the framework - Long-term, ongoing work with a growing brand portfolio HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY) Applications that don't follow these steps are rejected automatically. This is the first test of whether you read and follow instructions, which is the job. Start your application with this code word: PORTFOLIO (This confirms you actually read the post. No code word = no reply.) Then include all of the following: 1. PLATFORMS — Confirm which of Meta, TikTok, and Google you've personally run, and for how long on each. 2. FASHION PROOF — Name 1-2 fashion / apparel brands you've run ads for, what your role was, and specifically a result you drove (e.g. "scaled X brand from $Y to $Z/day at a $___ CPA"). Real numbers, not "I improved performance." 3. SCREENING QUESTION — If I gave you a fashion brand with a target NCPA (new customer cost per acquisition) of $40, and an ad set had spent $120 with 1 purchase, what would you do and why? (We want to see how you actually think.) 4. LOGISTICS — Your expected monthly rate, your weekly availability, and your timezone. 5. PROOF — A link to a portfolio, case studies, screenshots of past account performance, or anything that proves the above. Claims without proof carry little weight. A NOTE ON SERIOUSNESS We run a real, structured operation and we invest in the people who join it. In return we expect proven operators who take the work seriously. If that's you, we'd love to see your application. If you're mass-applying, please skip this one.

description: ABOUT THE PROJECT I’m the creator of an online course that teaches people how to understand, watch, and love American football. The course covers everything from basic rules to offensive and defensive formations, play types, player positions, game strategy, and more. The course has approximately 30 video lessons. Your job is to transform that raw footage into a polished, engaging lesson video. WHAT YOU’LL DO Each video will require one or both of the following: 1. Asset Integration — I will provide some pre-made assets. You will cut to the image/video at the right ---------- nt in my script, hold it on screen as I explain the concept, and then cut back to me on camera. Clean, professional timing. 2. Motion Graphics / Animation / Explainer Overlay — Some concepts require motion to understand. For example: a receiver running a route, a defensive line shifting, a play developing in real time. You will create motion graphics, animated diagrams, or short explainer animations that visually demonstrate the concept while my voice plays over it. NON-NEGOTIABLE: YOU MUST UNDERSTAND AMERICAN FOOTBALL This is a hard requirement, not a preference. You cannot create accurate motion graphics for a play-action pass, a cover-2 defense, or a pick route if you don’t know what those things are. We are not in a position to teach you the game while you’re building the videos. You must be able to: • Name and explain basic offensive formations (e.g., I-formation, shotgun, spread) • Understand what “down and distance” means and how game flow works • Animate a receiver route accurately (go route, slant, out, curl, etc.) • Identify player positions on both sides of the ball • Recognize the difference between offensive and defensive schemes at a conceptual level If you’re not sure whether you qualify — you probably don’t. Please do not apply. WHAT I PROVIDE • My on-camera lesson video (Edited) • Full written script with timestamps for where graphics appear • Designed assets • Brand colors, fonts, and style guide (after test phase) • Clear notes on what each graphic needs to show for your original creations (motion graphics, etc.) SKILLS REQUIRED • Video editing (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve) • Motion graphics and animation (After Effects strongly preferred) • Sports animation experience (any sport is a plus; American football is ideal) • Experience with educational or explainer video format • Strong communication and ability to meet deadlines consistently PROJECT SCOPE This project will begin with a paid test phase of 2 videos. If the quality, communication, and workflow are excellent, this becomes a 30-video ongoing project. • Total project: approximately 30 videos • Turnaround expectation: 1-2 business days per video once assets are delivered for the initial test phase. Total project will need to be completed in 2 - 4 weeks. • Revisions: 2 rounds included per video HOW TO APPLY To be considered, your application must include ALL of the following: 1. 2–3 portfolio links that are relevant — motion graphics, sports animation, or educational video examples. 2.  Answer to this question: Name 3 American football terms and briefly explain them without using AI. 3. Your software stack (editing + motion graphics). Creating AI videos that look realistic are fantastic, as long as they are accurate. Some concepts may work for realistic AI and some may need to be animation. 4. Your realistic turnaround time per video. IDEAL CANDIDATE You’re the right person for this project if you: • Actually watch football and get excited by the idea of making it visual and accessible • Have created sports-related or educational motion graphics before • Are detail-oriented and take pride in clean, polished final products • Communicate proactively and meet deadlines without being chased • Are looking for an ongoing project — not just a one-off gig This is a meaningful project. title: Virtual Car Rental Sales Representative
description: Virtual Sales Representative — Carzi (Car Rental) Location: Remote (supporting Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport operation) Type: Part-time or Full-time Hours of operation: Sunday–Friday, 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Arizona time) Schedule: Shifts assigned weekly — flexibility required About This Role This is a sales job first and foremost. If you live for the close, get a rush from hitting targets, and treat every customer inquiry as a chance to sell — keep reading. If you’re looking for a passive customer-service seat where you answer questions and wait for your shift to end, this isn’t it. Carzi is an independent car rental company at Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport with a fleet of ~100 vehicles and a contactless rental model. Our customers book online and handle everything by text and phone — they never stand at a counter. That means you are the salesperson and the storefront. Every text is a selling opportunity. Every call is a chance to upsell. The reps who win here are the ones who treat this like commissioned sales, not a help desk. What You’ll Actually Be Doing (Selling) • Close rentals. Turn inquiries, quotes, and “just checking prices” texts into booked, paid reservations. You own the conversion. • Upsell on every booking. Vehicle upgrades, damage protection, prepaid fuel, add-ons — you’ll have penetration targets on each, and we’ll track them. Top performers move the numbers; we notice. • Win back the fence-sitters. Follow up on abandoned bookings and lukewarm leads and bring them across the line. • Sell over text and voice. Build rapport, create urgency, handle objections, and close — all without ever meeting the customer face to face. This is a craft, and we want people who are good at it. • Process payments, deposits, and payment requests accurately • Run risk-based checks on reservations — review customer and payment details, flag high-risk bookings, and apply verification policies to protect against fraud and chargebacks • Keep reservation records clean and well-documented What We’re Looking For • A real sales background. Inside sales, retail sales, call-center sales, car rental upselling, or any role where you carried a quota and hit it. Tell us your numbers. • A genuine desire to sell. You see “no” as “not yet” and you actually enjoy turning a maybe into a yes. • Proven closer over text and phone — you can build rapport and close without face-to-face contact. • Comfortable juggling multiple software systems at once (rental management, SMS, payment tools — TSD or similar a plus) without dropping the sale • Strong judgment for risk — you can spot a sketchy booking and know when to verify, escalate, or decline • Excellent, fast, persuasive written communication — most of your selling happens over text • Self-managed and reliable in a remote environment • Available within operating hours (Sun–Fri, 6 AM–10 PM AZ time) with flexibility on weekly shift assignments Big Pluses • Documented sales performance — upsell/ancillary penetration rates, conversion rates, quota attainment, leaderboard finishes • Car rental experience (virtual or counter — reservations, sales, or operations) • Experience with contactless or remote rental operations Compensation • Part-time and full-time positions available • Shifts within Sunday–Friday, 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM Arizona time, set weekly • Competitive base with upside for performers — this is a role where selling well pays off How to Apply Don’t just send a résumé — sell us on you. Tell us about your sales experience and, specifically, a time you closed a tough sale or turned a hesitant customer into a paying one. Include real numbers if you have them (conversion rate, upsell penetration, quota %). Show us you can sell, starting with this message.

description: Senior Media Buyer Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-time Compensation: $12 / hour About the Role We’re looking for a senior media buyer who can confidently manage six-figure monthly ad spend across Meta and Google, with TikTok and other growth channels as a strong plus. But platform fluency is the floor here, not the bar. This is not a “log in, check ROAS, adjust budgets, log off” role. We’re looking for someone who treats the ad account as one lever in a much bigger machine — someone who understands how creative, retention, product, inventory, merchandising, customer behavior, and operations all feed back into acquisition performance. This person should be highly analytical, but also creative and commercially minded. You should be just as comfortable looking at Meta campaign structure as you are asking why a product page is not converting, why a bestseller is out of stock, why returning customer revenue is inflating ROAS, or why a creative angle is no longer resonating. For a brand like ours, paid media is not only about scaling spend. It’s about understanding what is actually driving profitable growth. That means looking beyond platform-reported ROAS and using tools like Triple Whale, GA4, Shopify, and ad platform data together to understand the full picture. If you’ve ever felt like a media buying role boxed you into “just optimize the account” when you could clearly see bigger opportunities in creative, funnel, product, retention, or offer strategy — this role is built for you. Why This Role Is Different Most media buying roles are siloed. You get an account, a budget, and a target, and you’re left to “make the numbers work” with limited visibility into anything upstream or downstream. We’re explicitly looking for the opposite of that. You’ll have direct access to and regular collaboration with the people who own creative, retention, product, merchandising, and operations. You’ll be expected to ask questions like: “Is our ROAS being inflated by returning customers?” “Are we scaling the right products based on margin, inventory, and customer demand?” “Is this creative underperforming because of the hook, the product angle, or what happens after someone clicks?” “Are we pushing spend into SKUs that are about to sell out?” “Is our acquisition actually profitable when we look at new customer CAC, AMER, and contribution margin?” “Are we over-discounting when scarcity, product storytelling, or drop energy would work better?” This role is for someone who wants their media buying expertise to shape broader marketing strategy, not just execute inside someone else’s plan. If you want to work on a brand where creative, product, customer psychology, and performance marketing all deeply intersect, we’d love to talk. What You’ll Do - Own paid media performance across Meta, Google, and TikTok, with bonus experience across platforms like Snap, Pinterest, Reddit, AppLovin, programmatic, or other emerging channels. - Manage six-figure+ monthly budgets with a focus on profitable, sustainable growth — not just spend volume or vanity scale. - Evaluate performance through both platfor ---------- trics and blended business metrics, including MER, AMER, RMER, blended CAC, new customer CAC, returning customer revenue mix, contribution margin, ROAS, CPA, AOV, LTV, and payback. - Use Triple Whale, GA4, Shopify, and platform data together to understand what is actually happening in the business, not just what Ads Manager is reporting. - Think critically about attribution, incrementality, retargeting overlap, returning customer behavior, and platform-reported performance. - Understand how retention, LTV, product mix, inventory, merchandising, and offer strategy affect what “good” CPA/ROAS actually looks like. - Partner closely with creative to bring informed strategic input — hooks, angles, formats, product stories, testing frameworks, and creative learnings — rather than simply requesting “more creative” when performance dips. - Help shape creative testing roadmaps across evergreen, launch, drop, promotional, UGC, founder-led, product-led, and brand-building content. - Collaborate with retention, product, creative, and operations teams to understand the full customer journey and identify where acquisition efficiency is being won or lost outside of the ad account. - Partner with product and operations to align spend with inventory levels, hero SKUs, margins, product launches, limited-edition drops, seasonal ---------- nts, and merchandising priorities. - Know when to scale, when to hold back, and when performance issues are being caused by stockouts, weak PDPs, offer fatigue, poor product mix, catalog issues, or post-click friction rather than media buying alone. - Manage and optimize product feeds, catalog ads, Advantage+ Shopping campaigns, Performance Max, Shopping campaigns, product sets, exclusions, SKU-level performance, and feed-related opportunities. - Build and maintain testing roadmaps for audiences, creative, offers, landing pages, products, and channels — with clear hypotheses, not just “let’s try this.” - Evaluate the post-click experience, including PDP quality, landing pages, collection pages, site speed, merchandising, product education, and conversion rate issues. - Support product launches, drops, seasonal campaigns, limited-edition releases, and inventory-sensitive promotions with thoughtful budget pacing and channel strategy. - Own budget pacing, forecasting, and scenario planning across channels, especially around product launches, promotional periods, seasonal peaks, and major brand ---------- nts. - Use tools like Motion, Atria, or similar creative analytics/testing platforms to connect creative performance data to media buying decisions. - Report on performance in a way that ties media metrics to business outcomes, and proactively flag risks, inefficiencies, or opportunities. - Stay current on platform changes, attribution shifts, AI-driven campaign structures, creative trends, and broader industry changes, then translate those into practical strategy adjustments. - When ad account management isn't demanding full attention, we expect you to spend that time on the broader marketing funnel — analyzing traffic patterns for optimization opportunities, surfacing landing page and CRO insights, and collaborating with the ops team to confirm inventory viability before scaling spend. What We’re Looking For - 3+ years of hands-on media buying experience, with demonstrated success managing six-figure monthly budgets. - Deep, current expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads. Working knowledge of TikTok is strongly preferred. Experience with additional platforms like Snap, Pinterest, Reddit, AppLovin, programmatic, or DSPs is a bonus. - Strong experience in DTC ecommerce is required, ideally with fashion, jewelry, accessories, beauty, lifestyle, collectibles, or another highly visual/category-driven brand. - Strong working knowledge of Triple Whale, GA4, Shopify analytics, and attribution platforms. You should be able to reconcile platform-reported performance with blended business metrics and identify when the data is misleading, incomplete, or over-crediting paid media. - Deep understanding of DTC performance metrics beyond platform ROAS, including MER, AMER, RMER, blended CAC, new customer CAC, returning customer revenue mix, LTV, AOV, contribution margin, and payback period. - A strong grasp of attribution limitations, incrementality, retargeting overlap, and the risk of over-relying on returning customers or retargeting to make paid media performance look stronger than it actually is. - Experience managing acquisition for brands with product launches, drops, seasonal campaigns, limited-edition products, or inventory-sensitive promotional ---------- nts. - Strong creative instincts and brand sensitivity. You understand that performance creative still needs to feel specific to the brand, the customer, and the product — not generic DTC ad creative. - Solid creative strategy judgment. You understand what makes an ad work beyond “the algorithm d ---------- ,” and can give creative teams useful, specific feedback on hooks, angles, messaging, formats, pacing, and product storytelling. - Comfort with creative analytics/testing tools such as Motion, Atria, Triple Whale, or similar platforms. - Experience with product feeds, catalog ads, Advantage+ Shopping, Performance Max, Shopping campaigns, product sets, SKU-level analysis, and feed troubleshooting. - Strong analytical skills. You are comfortable in spreadsheets and dashboards, but you also know how to distinguish signal from noise. - A genuine, demonstrable interest in the full marketing funnel. You can speak intelligently about how retention, LTV, merchandising, inventory, creative, and product mix inform acquisition targets. - Strong communication skills and genuine comfort working in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment. This role requires regular syncing with creative, retention, product, and operations — not working in isolation. - A bias toward efficiency over vanity scale. Nice to Haves - Experience with jewelry, accessories, fashion, beauty, fandom, collectibles, or other visually driven consumer brands. - Experience working directly with founders or lean marketing teams. - Background or strong working knowledge of retention/lifecycle marketing, including email , SMS, CRM, segmentation, and customer cohorts. - Experience briefing or directing creative production, not just requesting assets. - Experience supporting product drops, limited-edition launches, waitlists, early access ---------- nts, or community-driven campaigns. - Understanding of offer strategy and how to test promotions without defaulting to deeper discounts. - Experience partnering with creative teams, photographers, designers, editors, content creators, or UGC creators. - Experience with landing page testing, PDP optimization, CRO, merchandising strategy, or post-click analysis. title: IT Support Analyst
description: Job description: The Technical Support Specialist provides Tier 1 technical support to customers experiencing issues with their VoIP phone systems and network connectivity services. This is a fast-paced role that involves managing support requests via phone, email , and ticketing systems. Key Responsibilities The specialist is the frontline expert responsible for diagnosing and resolving a wide range of issues. VoIP/PBX System Support -Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues related to VoIP (Voice over IP), SIP (Session Initiation Protocol), and PBX (Private Branch Exchange) systems (both physical and cloud-based like FreePBX, 3CX, or Cisco CUCM). -Assist with the provisioning, configuration, and deployment of new VoIP handsets, soft phones, and system extensions. -Resolve common call quality issues, such as jitter, latency, and echo, often requiring the analysis of call logs or packet captures (Wireshark). Network and Connectivity Troubleshooting -Troubleshoot network issues impacting voice communication quality, including local area network (LAN) and wide area network (WAN) connectivity. -Configure and troubleshoot customer-side network devices like routers, modems, and firewalls to ensure proper Quality of Service (QoS) and port forwarding for VoIP traffic. -Provide support for network fundamentals such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLANs. Ticketing and Documentation -Accurately log, track, and manage customer issues using a ticketing system (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk). -Create and maintain high-quality internal and customer facing documentation (knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides). -Escalate unresolved issues to senior engineering or infrastructure teams when necessary. Required Qualifications: -Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. -Experience in a 24/7 support environment and willingness to work rotational shifts and holidays. -1+ year experience deploying and/or testing VoIP systems or solutions\ -1+ year experience in telecommunications -1+ years isolating and repairing VoIP system faults/misconfigurations and/or determining interoperability issues -Experience with TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routers and IP routing, and switches -Familiarity with VoIP devices, i.e. Linksys PAP2, SPA 9000, and “soft phones” -Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and customer service skills -Good written and verbal communication skills in English -Certifications/Licenses: Relevant technical certifications (CCNA, CompTIA Network+, -CompTIA A+, or specific vendor certifications for Cisco, Microsoft, or VoIP platforms) Preferred Skills -Experience with cloud-hosted PBX platforms (e.g., FreePBX, 3CX, RingCentral, Sangoma). -Familiarity with Wireshark, network analyzers, and SIP troubleshooting tools. -Ability to manage high call volumes and multitask effectively in a fast-paced support environment. Core Competencies -Exceptional problem-solving and analytical abilities for effective root cause analysis. -Outstanding verbal and written communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical users with patience and clarity. -Customer-Centric Focus with a commitment to delivering high-quality service and timely resolutions. -Ability to prioritize and manage multiple simultaneous tasks in a high-pressure, dynamic environment. Technical Skills -Expert knowledge of VoIP protocols (e.g., SIP, RTP, Codecs) and their role in telecommunications. -Proven experience with PBX/Unified Communications platforms (e.g., Asterisk, FreePBX, Cisco, Avaya). -Strong foundation in networking fundamentals (CompTIA Network+ or CCNA level knowledge). -Experience troubleshooting modem and router configurations for various internet service types. -Familiarity with network diagnostic tools like ping, traceroute, and packet sniffers. -Proficiency with operating systems like Windows and Linux CLI (Command Line Interface) for system checks and management.

title: Amazon PPC Growth Lead
description: READ THIS FIRST: Please fill out this Google Form to be considered for this job: ---------- Amazon PPC Growth Lead About the Role We are hiring an Amazon PPC Growth Lead to own advertising strategy and performance across a portfolio of Amazon brands. This is not a maintenance role. We are not looking for someone who simply adjusts bids, checks budgets, and waits for instructions. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of PPC as a growth function inside the business. If you are used to brand managers specifically telling you which products to raise budgets on and by how much, this is not the role for you. You will analyze the performance, know the brands inside and out, talk to the clients directly, collaborate with the brand manager on joint strategy, and advise on the strategy necessary to drive the growth. The right person knows how to analyze performance, identify what matters, create a plan, and communicate clearly with clients. They understand that Amazon advertising is not just about ACoS. It is about revenue, profitability, ranking, product growth, budget allocation, conversion, and total business performance. You should be the person who sees what is happening before the client asks. You bring ideas. You find problems. You recommend action. You follow through. Clients should feel confident that you understand their business and are actively leading the advertising strategy forward. You must be comfortable organizing and presenting data and analysis to the client, explaining your analysis and decision making and talking for a 1 hour PPC meeting 4-5 times per week. We are building a growth oriented agency with the longer term goal of launching our own products. What You’ll Own You will own PPC strategy and performance for assigned Amazon accounts. That means you will: Build and manage Amazon PPC strategies that support client growth goals Analyze performance across campaigns, products, keywords, search terms, budgets, and profitability Identify opportunities to grow revenue, improve efficiency, reduce waste, and scale what is working Explain what is happening in the account, why it is happening, and what should happen next Bring proactive recommendations to clients and internal teams Create action plans for underperforming areas and follow through until there is a result Connect PPC performance to broader business drivers like conversion rate, pricing, inventory, reviews, organic rank, margin, and product lifecycle Communicate strategy clearly so clients trust that their business is being actively managed Stay current on Amazon Ads changes, new opportunities, testing strategies, and competitive shifts What Success Looks Like Success in this role is not measured by whether you “touched” campaigns or adjusted bids. Success is measured by whether you are helping move the client’s business forward. You are successful when: Clients feel confident that PPC is being owned, not maintained You bring smart recommendations before being asked You can clearly explain performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps Accounts become stronger, cleaner, more strategic, and more scalable under your ownership PPC decisions are tied to business outcomes, not just campaign metrics You identify problems early and come with solutions You know when to push for growth, when to protect profitability, and when to challenge the current strategy Your work creates visible impact on revenue, profitability, efficiency, or client confidence What We Do Not Want This role is not a fit for someone who: Is used to spending most of your time raising and lowering bids Waits to be told what to do Runs mostly auto and category campaigns Reports high level aggregated numbers without diving into the details and explaining what they mean Thinks ACoS is the only metric that matters Avoids accountability for business outcomes Needs someone else to create the strategy Does the minimum required campaign work and calls it optimization Uses AI or Automation to do the majority of the work. We need someone who thinks, owns, communicates, and drives. Responsibilities Own Amazon PPC strategy across assigned client accounts Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns Analyze account performance and identify growth, efficiency, and profitability opportunities Build campaign structures that support scale, control, and clear decision-making Manage keyword strategy, search term harvesting, negatives, placements, budgets, and bid strategy Develop testing plans for new campaigns, products, keywords, placements, creative, and budget strategies Review performance trends and create clear action plans Prepare client-facing insights, recommendations, and strategic updates Partner with account managers and leadership to align PPC strategy with client business goals Identify when non-PPC issues are impacting performance, including pricing, inventory, reviews, conversion rate, content, or competition Communicate risks and opportunities early, with recommended next steps Must be highly competent managing accounts with over $100k/mo advertising budgets. Goals for This Role The goal of this role is simple: Make clients trust that their Amazon advertising is being actively led by someone who understands the business. You will be expected to: Drive profitable growth where opportunity exists Improve inefficient or underperforming accounts Build client trust through clear strategic communication Create proactive recommendations that lead to action Make PPC strategy easier for clients and internal teams to understand Turn data into decisions Own outcomes, not just tasks Requirements 3+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience Must be able to run accounts manually. Must also be familiar with Pacvue Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display Deep knowledge of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CVR, CPC, CTR, keyword strategy, campaign structure, and profitability Ability to analyze data and turn it into clear recommendations Strong communication skills, especially when explaining performance and strategy Experience managing multiple Amazon accounts or brands Ability to work independently and take ownership without constant direction Strong judgment around growth, efficiency, budget allocation, and profitability tradeoffs Preferred Experience Experience working in an agency or multi-client environment Experience with Amazon reporting tools, PPC software, or business intelligence dashboards Experience presenting strategy directly to clients or senior stakeholders Understanding of Amazon SEO, product launches, ranking strategy, promotions, and catalog performance Who Will Thrive Here You will thrive in this role if you are used to driving a business forward with ad strategies. You are analytical, creative, and accountable. You like digging into accounts and figuring out what is really going on. You are not satisfied with surface-level reporting. You want to know what is working, what is broken, where the opportunity is, and what should happen next. You do not need to be micromanaged. You want ownership. You want to be trusted. You want your recommendations to matter. Most importantly, you understand that great PPC management is not maintenance. It is leadership.

What You’ll Do You will edit short-form recipe videos, including: - Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and other vertical videos - Fast-paced recipe edits with strong pacing and clean transitions - Hook-first videos that grab attention in the first 1–3 seconds - Food-focused edits that make the recipe look indulgent, realistic, and delicious - Text overlays, captions, recipe callouts, and simple on-screen instructions - Cutting out dead space and choosing the most appetizing shots - Syncing clips with music, voiceover, or sound effects when needed - Creating multiple versions of the same video for testing hooks, pacing, or structure - Making revision edits based on feedback The goal is to create content that looks premium, appetizing, and made for social media — not boring recipe videos, not generic AI-looking content, and not slow edits that people scroll past. If you see this, write the word goldfish in your subject line for the application. Types of Videos You’ll Edit Examples include: - High-protein comfort food meal prep videos - Recipe reels with hook + cooking process + final plated shot - AI-generated food clip videos - Before/after food transformations - Sauce pours, cheese pulls, sizzling pans, chopping, mixing, plating, and meal prep shots - Problem/solution style videos for busy people who want healthy meals that still taste indulgent - Variations of the same recipe video for testing different hooks You Might Be a Great Fit If - You already edit short-form videos and understand TikTok/Reels pacing. - You spend time watching food videos and recipe content. - You can tell when food looks realistic, delicious, and appetizing. - You know how to make the first 1–3 seconds of a video stronger. - You understand pacing, cuts, captions, hooks, music, and retention. - You notice small details that make a video feel polished. - You can take feedback without ego and make edits quickly. - You like flexible, output-based work that fits around your existing schedule. - You’re looking for a side hustle rather than another full-time commitment. - You want to grow with a brand where strong performance can lead to higher pay, bonuses, and more consistent work. - You have long-term vision and understand that early-stage opportunities can grow into bigger income once the brand gains traction. Requirements - Experience editing short-form vertical videos - Strong sense of pacing and retention - Good visual taste for food content - Ability to make food look appetizing, indulgent, and premium - Comfortable adding captions, text overlays, music, and basic sound effects - Ability to follow detailed instructions and brand style - Reliable communication - Ability to meet deadlines - Organized file delivery - Willingness to edit multiple versions when testing hooks or formats - Must be able to accept feedback and make revisions Experience editing food videos is a huge plus, but not required if you have strong short-form editing skills and a good eye for what performs on social media. Tools / Software You can use the editing software you are most comfortable with, such as: - CapCut - Premiere Pro - DaVinci Resolve - Final Cut Pro - After Effects - Canva, when needed for simple graphics or text - Google Drive or Dropbox for file sharing Bonus points if you are also comfortable working with AI-generated clips or understand how to make AI footage feel more natural through editing. Pay This is output-based freelance work and should be viewed as a flexible side hustle with growth potential. - $5 per edited short-form video - Pay includes the opportunity for performance bonuses - Strong performers may also participate in upside through performance bonuses - As sales and content performance increase, there will be opportunities for larger pay, higher bonuses, and more consistent work - The goal is for pay to increase significantly as the brand gains traction, especially for people who help build the system early and consistently deliver great work How to Apply Please send: 1. A short message about why you are interested 2. Your experience editing short-form videos 3. Any experience with food videos, recipe content, AI clips, or social media content 4. 2–5 examples of videos you have edited 5. Your availability each week 6. What editing software you use 7. Confirm that you understand this is output-based side-hustle work with long-term upside: $5 per edited video, with performance bonuses and upside opportunities as the brand grows Bonus points if you can explain what makes a food video perform well on Reels, TikTok, or Shorts.

title: B2B Lead Generation VA — List Building + Cold Email for IT Reseller (SMB Focus)
job_title: B2B Lead Generation VA — List Building + Cold Email for IT Reseller (SMB Focus)
description: I work in sales for a US-based IT reseller, and I'm looking for a sharp, detail-oriented lead generation VA to help me build my outbound pipeline from the ground up. We sell IT solutions — hardware, software, licensing, firewalls, networking, SaaS — at transparent, competitive pricing. My approach is simple and honest: I give prospects a real shot to lower what they're paying. Your job is to help me reach the right people and start those conversations. A big part of this role is SOURCING the leads. You'll research and build targeted contact lists of purchasing and IT decision-makers — using tools I provide (like Apollo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator) plus your own careful research — then run a weekly cold -email campaign and hand me the warm replies to quote. We're focused on small and mid-sized US businesses, where there's usually a single decision-maker (an IT manager or owner) who can act fast on a good quote. This is an ongoing role — I want a long-term working relationship and reward good work with raises. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Source and build targeted contact lists in Apollo and LinkedIn (filter by job title, company size, industry, location) - Target purchasing/procurement and IT decision-makers: IT Manager, IT Director, Purchasing/Procurement Manager, owner/operator at SMBs - Verify the right person and a valid business email before sending, using LinkedIn and company websites - Load lists into a cold -email tool (Instantly / Smartlead) and run a weekly campaign from a sending domain I provide - Monitor replies — filter out no-thanks, out-of-office, and bounces; flag the genuinely interested - Log each warm lead in a shared Google Sheet/CRM (name, company, what they're sourcing, their reply) and notify me to quote - Keep lists clean — remove anyone who replies or opts out I provide all the tools, the sending domain, and the data subscriptions. You don't need to bring your own contact lists — I want someone skilled at sourcing and verifying leads with proper tools, not someone selling a pre-built database. MUST-HAVE SKILLS - Strong written English - Hands-on experience with Apollo.io (or similar: ZoomInfo, Lusha, Clay) - Experience running cold -email campaigns (Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Mailshake, etc.) - Comfortable with LinkedIn research / Sales Navigator - Google Sheets / basic CRM (HubSpot a plus) - Honest and detail-oriented about data quality NICE TO HAVE - Email deliverability know-how (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, inbox warmup) - Prior experience selling into US businesses - Familiarity with IT/tech products HOW TO APPLY 1. Start your message with the word "TRANSPARENT" so I know you read the full post. 2. Tell me which lead-gen and cold -email tools you've used, and for how long. 3. Quick test: Pick any real mid-sized US company. Walk me through the exact steps and tools you'd use to find and verify the business email of their IT Manager or Purchasing contact. 4. One sentence on the largest contact list you've built and its bounce/reply rate, if you know it. Applications that don't start with "TRANSPARENT" or that skip the test won't be considered. I read every qualifying application personally.
