title: Local B2B Advertising Sales Representative
description: ABOUT SUMMER HOUSE MEDIA CO. Summer House Media Co. is an emerging media company focused on creating local advertising opportunities that help small businesses increase visibility in the communities they serve. Our current offer is a shared direct mail advertising campaign. Local businesses can reserve ad space on a professionally designed 9 x 12 postcard that is mailed to approximately 5,000 households in a targeted local area. We are seeking a sales professional who can manage the full sales process and support campaign coordination from initial outreach through advertiser onboarding, proof approval, and mailer completion. ABOUT THE ROLE The Local Advertising Sales Representative will manage the full end-to-end sales cycle and advertiser coordination process for Summer House Media Co.’s Shared Local Mailer program. This is not an appointment-setting-only role. The selected contractor will be responsible for moving qualified prospects from initial research and outreach through follow-up, objection handling, closing, payment coordination, advertiser intake, proof approval follow-up, and campaign completion. PRIMARY GOAL The primary goal is to help fill available paid advertising placements for a monthly shared local mailer while ensuring confirmed advertisers submit the materials and approvals needed to move the postcard into print. A confirmed paid placement means that a business has selected an advertising tier, submitted payment, and that payment has been received and confirmed. WHAT YOU WILL BE SELLING The Shared Local Mailer is a professionally designed 9 x 12 postcard mailed to approximately 5,000 local households in selected ZIP codes or carrier routes. Businesses can choose from three advertising placement tiers. Premium Anchor Ads are priced at $650. Standard Feature Ads are priced at $475. Starter Local Ads are priced at $325. Quarterly visibility packages may also be available for businesses that want to appear in multiple consecutive mailings and maintain category visibility over time. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Research and source qualified local businesses within assigned target areas and priority business categories. Build, organize, and maintain a clean prospect list and sales pipeline. Conduct cold calls, email outreach, and approved follow-up communication with local business owners and decision-makers. Qualify prospects by identifying decision authority, current marketing needs, service area, promotional opportunities, and fit for the mailer. Present the Shared Local Mailer offer clearly, professionally, and accurately. Explain placement options, campaign timeline, local household reach, and the value of category visibility. Follow up consistently with warm leads and und ---------- prospects through the campaign reservation deadline. Handle common objections related to cost, timing, current marketing efforts, direct mail, and return on investment. Help businesses choose between one-time and quarterly placement options. Ask for the sale and move interested businesses toward a clear decision. Send or coordinate payment links and follow up until advertiser payment is received. Document all outreach activity, prospect notes, follow-up dates, sales status, objections, and outcomes in the assigned lead tracker. Send advertiser intake forms after payment is confirmed. Collect and organize advertiser materials, including logos, business details, contact information, promotional offers, website links, QR code destinations, photos, and brand preferences when available. Follow up with advertisers who have incomplete or missing materials before campaign deadlines. Track advertiser materials, intake completion, placement details, proof status, and approval status. Coordinate advertiser proof review and collect written approval before final print production. Follow up with advertisers regarding proof edits, missing approvals, or final corrections. Maintain organized campaign folders and advertiser records. Help coordinate final advertiser details for print preparation and mailing. Notify advertisers when the mailer has been sent or is scheduled to mail. Begin renewal conversations with advertisers after the campaign is mailed and identify potential quarterly package opportunities. Provide feedback on lead quality, messaging, objection patterns, high-performing categories, advertiser issues, and opportunities to improve future campaigns. IDEAL CANDIDATE The ideal candidate is confident in outbound sales and comfortable speaking with small business owners and decision-makers. You should be comfortable owning both top-of-funnel outreach and end-of-funnel conversion, along with basic campaign coordination responsibilities after the sale. This means you can research prospects, start conversations, build trust, follow up, handle objections, ask for the sale, coordinate payment, collect advertiser materials, manage deadlines, track approvals, and keep the campaign moving forward without requiring constant supervision. You should be organized, self-directed, professional, consistent with follow-up, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a deadline-driven environment. Experience in cold calling, business development, local business sales, advertising sales, marketing services, client acquisition, lead generation, account management, sales support, project coordination, or service-based sales is strongly preferred. Experience selling print media, direct mail, shared mailers, local promotions, agency services, or advertising is helpful but not required. CAMPAIGN EXPECTATIONS The selected contractor will be expected to consistently source and contact qualified local businesses, build and manage a pipeline of interested prospects, follow up with warm leads, help secure paid ad placements, collect advertiser materials, track approvals, and maintain organized campaign records throughout the cycle. Lead sourcing will be shared. Summer House Media Co. will provide target market direction, priority business categories, sales materials, campaign details, and strategic lead guidance. The sales representative will be expected to source and build the majority of the prospect list and outreach opportunities. COMMUNICATION AND REPORTING EXPECTATIONS The selected contractor will provide every-other-day progress updates during active outreach. A weekly summary report will also be required. Weekly reports should include outreach activity, prospect pipeline status, warm leads, paid placements, advertiser intake status, missing materials, proof approvals, common objections, high-performing categories, follow-up priorities, and recommended next steps. The assigned lead tracker and campaign tracker must be updated consistently throughout the campaign. Major campaign issues, strong sales opportunities, late-stage prospects, missing advertiser materials, late proof approvals, or risks to the sales or production timeline should be communicated promptly. WHAT WE PROVIDE Summer House Media Co. will provide a campaign overview, sales timeline, sales flyer, one-page offer sheet, pricing and placement information, sales script, cold email templates, lead tracker format, campaign tracker format, target business categories, market direction, payment process, advertiser intake process, proofing workflow, automated tools and campaign support. COMPENSATION This is a performance-aligned contract. Compensation details will be discussed with selected candidates. The pilot structure may include a limited hourly component, commission on confirmed paid advertiser placements, and performance bonuses tied to campaign outcomes. SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE Success is not measured only by calls made, email s sent, or meetings booked. Success is measured by consistent prospecting, strong follow-up, organized pipeline management, professional communication, movement of qualified prospects through the full sales cycle, confirmed paid advertising placements, timely advertiser intake, complete materials collection, proof approvals, and a well-organized campaign ready for print. HOW TO APPLY Please include a brief summary of your outbound sales, business development, client coordination, or campaign support experience. Please describe your experience cold calling small businesses, local business owners, or decision-makers. Please share any experience selling advertising, marketing services, local promotions, print media, direct mail, agency services, or service-based offers. Please include your availability. Please provide a brief example of a campaign where you helped generate leads, appointments, closed sales, collected client materials, coordinated approvals, or supported campaign delivery. Please share your preferred compensation structure for project-based sales and campaign coordination work. We are looking for a sales professional who can combine consistent outbound activity with thoughtful follow-up, strong organization, advertiser coordination, and a results-focused approach to closing paid placements and helping deliver the campaign.

title: CONTROLLER
description: Recruit + Field is a premium qualitative market research recruiting firm. We recruit, screen, qualify, and place respondents — and we hold ourselves to a very high standard in everything we do. We're looking for a Controller who brings that same standard to our finances. This is not a passive reporting role. We need someone who is genuinely invested in the financial health of this company — someone who reads the numbers, understands what they mean, asks hard questions, and flags issues before they become problems. You will have real visibility into the business and direct access to leadership. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable processing an invoice and presenting a financial dashboard to leadership. You execute AP and AR personally, you watch the numbers closely, and you speak up when something is off. This is a do-it-yourself role with real organizational impact. You will own the full financial operations cycle — including personally executing AP and AR transactions daily, month-end close, payroll coordination, reconciliations, and reporting — while also serving as the company's internal watchdog on spending, vendor costs, and financial accuracy. This role is equally about execution and oversight. You are in the weeds and watching the big picture at the same time. WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS We are growing, and our financial infrastructure needs to keep pace. We need a single point of ownership for financial operations — someone who proactively monitors spending, holds vendors accountable, surfaces risks, and ensures that leadership always has an accurate, current picture of the company's financial health. The right person will bring order, visibility, and vigilance to our finances and become a trusted partner to leadership. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Financial Vigilance & Expense Oversight This is a top priority, not a secondary task. You will actively monitor company finances and flag anomalies proactively. • Conduct regular expense audits — reviewing all company spend across QuickBooks, Ramp (corporate card platform), and vendor invoices • Identify unusual charges, duplicate billing, unauthorized spend, or cost creep and escalate immediately to leadership • Maintain and regularly review a vendor master list; flag redundant, lapsed, or overpriced vendor relationships • Review all invoices before payment to verify accuracy, proper coding, and business justification • Proactively surface cash flow risks, budget variances, and unusual trends — don't wait to be asked • Build and maintain a recurring audit cadence (monthly and quarterly) for all expense categories 2. Accounts Payable & Receivable — Full Execution This is a hands-on execution role, not a supervisory one. You will personally process AP and AR transactions daily — this is a core part of the job, not a delegation task. Accounts Payable • Review, code, and process all incoming vendor invoices — verifying accuracy, proper GL coding, and business justification before any payment is made • Execute vendor payments including check runs, ACH transfers, and credit card settlements — ensuring nothing is paid late or paid incorrectly • Manage all non-autopay items in QuickBooks Online from receipt through to cleared payment • Advance payments when due and proactively manage payment timing to maintain vendor relationships and avoid late fees • Collect W-9 / W-8 forms from all new vendors before first payment is issued; maintain vendor records accurately in QuickBooks Online • Reconcile vendor statements against QuickBooks records and resolve discrepancies directly with vendors • Oversee 1099 preparation and filing at year-end, including respondent 1099 reporting in coordination with the ops team Accounts Receivable • Generate and send client invoices accurately and on time — ensuring invoices match agreed project scopes and terms • Record and apply all incoming payments in QuickBooks Online promptly and accurately • Monitor outstanding receivables and proactively follow up on any past-due balances — escalating to leadership when needed • Maintain clean AR aging — flag any overdue accounts or collection risks early • Reconcile client payments against invoices and resolve any billing discrepancies directly with clients or internal project leads • Keep bank feeds updated and ensure all transactions are assigned consistent, accurate accounting codes 3. Month-End Close & Financial Reporting • Execute month-end close — reconciliations, journal entries, bank/credit card statement reconciliations • Prepare monthly financial package: P&L, cash flow summary, balance sheet snapshot, and budget vs. actuals • Generate dashboard-ready reports for leadership that are clear, accurate, and actionable — not just data dumps • Attend and contribute to monthly financial review meetings; own follow-up action items • Review weekly accounting accuracy and resolve variances promptly 4. Payroll Coordination • Oversee payroll processing in coordination with the payroll processor (Human Resources) and QuickBooks Online payroll • Manage benefits coordination, department/role changes, and new hire payroll setup • Ensure payroll accuracy and flag discrepancies before they are processed 5. Quarterly Financial Management • Conduct comprehensive reviews of budgets, forecasts, and profitability metrics • Lead quarterly vendor contract reviews to identify savings opportunities • Prepare quarterly financial statements and present clear, actionable insights to leadership • Ensure compliance with quarterly tax filing requirements; liaise with external CPA as needed • Run scenario analyses, burn reports, and cash flow projections as needed 6. Process Improvement & Documentation • Identify inefficiencies in financial and operational workflows and implement practical improvements • Document and maintain SOPs for all key financial processes • Leverage tools — QuickBooks Online, Ramp, and others — to their full capability • Partner with Sales, HR, and Operations to ensure financial processes support business goals 7. Financial Support to the VP of Qualitative Research & CEO While this role reports directly to the VP of Qualitative Research, the Controller also serves as a financial resource to the CEO — providing visibility, analysis, and insights that support company-level decision-making. • Keep the VP of Qualitative Research informed with accurate, timely financial summaries and flag anything requiring attention or escalation • Provide the CEO with financial data, reporting, and analysis as needed — including profitability summaries, cash flow snapshots, and budget vs. actuals • Prepare ad hoc financial analyses and scenario models as requested by the VP or CEO • Attend leadership meetings as needed and contribute clear financial context — translating numbers into plain language • Proactively surface financial trends, risks, or opportunities to leadership rather than waiting to be asked • Support budget planning, goal-setting, and financial forecasting in partnership with the VP and CEO WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In the first 90 days, a successful Controller will: • Have fully taken over AP and AR — all invoices processed, payments advanced, and client invoices going out cleanly and on time • Complete a full audit of current vendor spend and surface any flags to leadership • Establish a clean, consistent month-end close process • Deliver a financial dashboard that leadership can actually use • Have caught at least one thing that wasn't being caught before Ongoing, you will be measured on financial accuracy, the timeliness and quality of reporting, the proactiveness of your issue-flagging, and your genuine partnership with the VP of Qualitative Research and CEO. CORE COMPETENCIES • Financial stewardship — you treat company money with care and take personal ownership of financial health • Proactive communication — you surface issues early, not after the fact • Attention to detail — you notice things others miss • Technical proficiency — advanced QuickBooks Online; experience with Ramp or similar expense platforms • Analytical thinking — you understand what numbers mean, not just what they say • Process discipline — you build systems that prevent problems, not just respond to them • Cross-functional collaboration — you work well with non-finance people and translate financial data clearly SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS Education • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or a related field (required) Experience • Minimum 7 years of experience in a controller or senior accounting role • Minimum 2 years working cross-functionally with non-finance teams • Demonstrated experience with expense auditing, vendor management, and financial controls • Experience in a small business or startup environment strongly preferred — you are comfortable being the only finance person in the room Technical Requirements • Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online (non-negotiable) • Experience with corporate card/expense platforms (Ramp experience a plus) • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills for reporting and analysis • Comfortable with remote tools and virtual collaboration WORK REQUIREMENTS • Must be available to work and communicate during US Eastern Time business hours • High proficiency in written and spoken English required for all communications • Remote position — must be self-directed and reliable without in-person oversight APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS To be considered for this position, please begin your submission or proposal with the sentence: "I AM HUMAN." Applications that do not include this phrase will not be reviewed. In your cover letter or proposal, please include a brief description of a time you identified a financial issue — billing error, cost anomaly, unauthorized spend, or similar — that others had missed, and describe the steps you took to resolve it. This is the most important thing we want to understand about you.

No exceptions. -Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this Compensation -Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience -Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Who This Role Suits -5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool -You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail -You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround" -You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain) -You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked -You test your own work before calling it done -You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first -You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs Who This Role Does NOT Suit -Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps -Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role -Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs -Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours) -Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. job_title: Remote Payment Operations Chat Support – Floating Shift (30 Hours/Week)
description: PAYJN is a global payment service provider seeking a disciplined and detail-oriented Payment Operations Chat Support Specialist based in the Philippines. This is a fully remote, non-voice position. The work is primarily conducted through written chat and involves checking transaction information, following operational procedures, and assisting merchants professionally and accurately. This is a long-term floating-shift position, not a short-term freelance project. It is suitable for someone who can work independently, remain attentive during quiet periods, and reliably cover different operating shifts. GUARANTEED WEEKLY SCHEDULE You will normally receive three 10-hour shifts per week, equivalent to 30 guaranteed hours. Regular floating coverage in Manila Time (GMT+8): • Wednesday: 15:00–01:00 • Friday: 05:00–15:00 • Saturday: 19:00–05:00 Additional shifts may become available when regular employees are absent, on leave, or when emergency coverage is required. Emergency coverage is normally communicated at least three hours in advance. Additional approved shifts are paid based on actual tracked time. SCHEDULE EXPECTATIONS • You must be able to work all three regular floating shifts. • You must be comfortable working morning, afternoon, and overnight schedules. • You may be asked to temporarily cover a fixed shift when another employee is on leave. • Outside work is permitted only if it never conflicts with PAYJN schedules or confirmed coverage duties. • Once you accept an additional shift, you are expected to report on time and complete it fully. COMPENSATION Floating-shift compensation is calculated from a USD 400 monthly full-time base: USD 400 ÷ 26 working days ÷ 10 hours = approximately USD 1.5385 per approved hour. At 30 hours per week, expected monthly earnings are normally around USD 185–200, depending on the calendar and approved hours worked. Additional approved shifts increase your earnings. Payroll is processed twice monthly, normally between the 1st–3rd and the 16th–18th. Payment is made in USDT through the TRC20 network. PAID TRAINING Selected candidates receive three days of paid training, 10 hours per day. • Days 1–2: Guided training with an experienced tea ---------- mber • Day 3: Practical assessment • Training is paid at the same approved hourly rate. • Three fully completed training days equal approximately USD 46.15. • Completed and verified training time is paid even if the candidate does not pass. • Completing training does not guarantee continued employment. CAREER PATH Strong floating-shift employees may apply for a fixed full-time position when staffing needs allow. Potential full-time compensation: • Probationary full-time role: USD 400/month • Regular full-time role: USD 450/month • Shift leader role: Up to USD 500/month • Eligible full-time employees may receive a USD 35 full-attendance bonus. Promotion depends on accuracy, reliability, learning performance, and company requirements. It is not guaranteed based only on length of service. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS • At least two years of relevant work experience • College-level education or higher preferred • Strong BPO, banking, fintech, payment, e-commerce, crypto, or transactional support experience is preferred • Strong written English and fast, accurate typing • Comfortable working with numbers, transaction references, screenshots, and system records • Able to learn and retain structured procedures • Able to recognize unusual cases and escalate instead of guessing • Professional and emotionally stable under pressure THIS ROLE IS NOT SUITABLE FOR SOMEONE WHO: • Relies only on copy-and-paste answers • Frequently needs the same procedure explained repeatedly • Guesses when transaction information is unclear • Disappears during assigned working hours • Cannot maintain focus while working remotely • Has commitments that conflict with assigned shifts • Is unable to work the three listed schedules ATTENDANCE AND PERFORMANCE • Be fully ready before the scheduled shift begins. • Remain online and responsive throughout the assigned shift. • Customer messages should normally be acknowledged within 1–3 minutes. • Reasonable short personal breaks may be self-managed, provided coverage and response times are not affected. • Group attendance records and automated online-status checks verify availability. • Late arrival and early departure are deducted based on actual approved minutes. • Unreported absence, falsified attendance, or repeated disappearance may result in removal from the roster or termination. TIME TRACKING AND TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS TimeProof must remain active throughout every assigned shift. Approved TimeProof records are the primary basis for payroll. Technical problems must be reported in the work group during the same shift. You must have: • A reliable PC or laptop; mobile-only work is not accepted • Stable primary internet and a backup connection • Reliable electricity or a practical power-outage backup plan • A quiet workspace suitable for focused, confidential work • The ability to restrict personal phone use and unrelated activities during shifts HOW TO APPLY Send everything below in ONE complete message. Multiple incomplete messages may be treated as failure to follow instructions. Start the first line with the exact word: PAYJN Then include: 1. A brief professional introduction 2. Your latest resume 3. Your highest educational qualification 4. Exact dates and duties for your relevant work experience 5. Confirmation that you can regularly work all three listed shifts 6. Confirmation that you can accept emergency coverage with approximately three hours’ notice when available 7. Details of any current work or commitments that could affect scheduling 8. A screenshot of your current internet speed test 9. Your computer specifications, including processor, RAM, and storage 10. Your backup plan for internet and power interruptions Qualified applicants receive a short assessment covering written English, transaction and numerical checking, following a simulated procedure, abnormal-case escalation, and typing accuracy. Applicants who pass may be invited to Telegram for further discussion. Only selected candidates receive an offer for the three-day paid training period.

description: About us We're an Australian site-monitoring and surveillance company. We run CCTV camera systems across construction and infrastructure sites, and we monitor them through our own software platform. We're building a small overnight team to watch live camera feeds, spot when something isn't right, and make a quick phone call to the right person while our Australian sites are unattended. Also, the ability to confidently organise Teams/video conferencing meetings as required. What you'll do Watch multiple live camera feeds inside our software during overnight shifts Notice when something looks wrong and d ---------- whether it's a real issue or a false alarm When it's real, make the phone call — calmly and clearly notify the right person and follow a simple escalation chain Write short, clear, time-stamped notes on what happened Flag any cameras that go offline or look faulty Work as part of a small overnight team What we're looking for Excellent spoken and written English — you'll be making phone calls and writing clear notes, so confident, professional communication is essential Tech-savvy and quick to learn — comfortable picking up new software fast and working across multiple screens and feeds (this matters far more than any specific prior tool) Good judgement under quiet conditions — able to stay alert through a calm night shift and tell the difference between a real event and a false one Confident on the phone/video conferencing — you won't hesitate to call someone, even at 3am, when the situation calls for it Reliable fibre internet PLUS a backup connection (mobile data or a second line) Power backup — UPS or generator — so an outage doesn't take you offline mid-shift A quiet, dedicated work-from-home space No CCTV, security, or monitoring background required — if you're sharp, reliable, communicate well, and can stay focused overnight, we'll teach you the rest. Shift & pay Night shift aligned to Australian overnight hours (Philippine time is only ~2–3 hours behind, so this is a much gentler night shift than US or UK monitoring work) Generous salary Long-term, stable, full-time — we're building a team and want people who'll grow with us How to apply Reply with these three things. You are a good fit because you have done this before, for an agency or for multiple clients, and you can show me one TikTok you turned into a Reel and explain what you changed for that platform. About Rudderr Rudderr is an e-commerce brand management and wholesale growth company that helps consumer brands expand across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, Faire, and social media. We manage products across several categories, including outdoor and survival gear, home improvement, lawn and garden, wellness, beauty, and specialty consumer products. We are building an internal AI-assisted content production operation capable of producing high-quality product lifestyle images, short-form videos, and UGC-style content at scale. About the Role We are looking for an experienced AI Creative Operations Manager to build, lead, and manage our Philippines-based content production team. You will not be expected to create every image or video yourself. Your primary responsibility will be to build the people, systems, workflows, and quality-control process required to deliver accurate, realistic, and premium e-commerce content consistently. You will receive original product photography and creative direction from our U.S. team. You will then manage a team of junior AI image and video editors who transform those product photos into realistic lifestyle scenes, advertising assets, social media content, and short-form videos. Our most important standard is product fidelity. Logos, dimensions, materials, colors, proportions, accessories, controls, textures, and product features must remain accurate. Product distortion, invented features, incorrect branding, and visibly artificial imagery must be caught and corrected before delivery. Primary Responsibilities Build and Manage the Creative Team • Recruit and evaluate junior AI image editors, video editors, and creative production contractors. • Handle onboarding, training, performance reviews, coaching, and replacement of underperforming tea ---------- mbers. • Maintain sufficient staffing so content production does not stop when an editor becomes unavailable. • Assign work based on each editor’s skills, availability, and performance. • Build a reliable team capable of increasing or decreasing production based on demand. Build the Content Production System • Create repeatable workflows for AI-assisted product photography, lifestyle imagery, video, and synthetic UGC. • Develop SOPs, templates, prompt libraries, brand guidelines, file-naming systems, and quality-control checklists. • Establish a clear process from receiving original product photos through final asset approval. • Organize project files, source images, masks, models, prompts, revisions, and final exports. • Improve production speed without sacrificing product accuracy or visual quality. • Work toward a typical delivery time of approximately 24–48 hours for standard content requests. Own Quality Control • Review every asset before it reaches the U.S. team. • Enforce a zero-tolerance standard for distorted products, altered logos, incorrect colors, missing accessories, unrealistic shadows, and inconsistent proportions. • Check perspective, lighting direction, contact shadows, reflections, scale, resolution, texture, anatomy, and environmental realism. • Identify whether an asset can be corrected through inpainting, masking, compositing, relighting, regeneration, or manual Photoshop editing. • Train junior editors to recognize common AI generation errors. • Maintain consistency across image collections, recurring virtual models, brand campaigns, and product variations. Manage AI Image and Video Production • Oversee the creation of realistic lifestyle scenes using original product photography. • Ensure that the actual product remains accurate while environments, backgrounds, people, and scenarios are generated or composited around it. • Direct the creation of outdoor, camping, water-sports, home, wellness, and other product-specific lifestyle scenarios. • Manage short-form video production using still product images, generated environments, motion effects, and AI video tools. • Develop recurring virtual creators or product experts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, advertising, and educational content. • Ensure temporal consistency so products remain sharp and stable while backgrounds or surrounding elements move naturally. Manage Performance and Communication • Serve as the primary point of contact between Rudderr and the creative production team. • Translate creative requests into clear assignments for junior editors. • Track production volume, revision rates, approval rates, turnaround time, and editor performance. • Provide regular updates on project status, staffing, bottlenecks, and tool requirements. • Recommend workflow, staffing, and software improvements based on measurable results. • Manage software access and ensure company assets, trained models, and workflows remain organized and secure. The operational model including manager ownership of recruiting, onboarding, training, performance management, production continuity, and final quality is central to this position. Required Experience • At least 1 years of experience managing a creative, multimedia, design, post-production, or digital content team. • Strong understanding of e-commerce product photography and lifestyle content. • Advanced ability to review and correct AI-generated images. • Strong attention to product accuracy, branding, visual realism, and fine details. • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop • Strong written and spoken English. • Reliable high-speed internet and a computer capable of managing professional image and video workflows. • Ability to work independently, make decisions, and communicate problems before they affect deadlines. Preferred Technical Experience Strong candidates should have hands-on experience with several AI generating tool and programs Helpful Additional Experience • Outdoor, survival, camping, water-sports, home-improvement, or consumer-product brands • Managing freelance or offshore production teams • Creating content for multiple brands at the same time • Developing recurring virtual models or AI-generated brand ambassadors • Capacity planning and creative production budgeting What Success Looks Like Within the first 30–60 days, the successful candidate will have: • Recruited and evaluated a dependable group of junior editors. • Established clear production and quality-control SOPs. • Created a dependable workflow for receiving, producing, reviewing, revising, and delivering assets. • Reduced preventable revisions caused by product distortion or overlooked AI defects. • Built a consistent pipeline for realistic product lifestyle imagery. • Established measurable expectations for turnaround time, asset quality, and editor performance. • Begun expanding the operation into video and UGC-style content. Two-Week Paid Pilot Canidates will begin with a paid two-week project. During the pilot, the candidate will be asked to: • Source and evaluate two to three potential junior editors. • Provide clear creative assignments using several test product photographs. • Direct the editors in creating distinct lifestyle-image concepts. • Develop a short-form video concept for each test product. • Review AI-generated images and identify product, lighting, anatomy, perspective, and realism problems. • Demonstrate how they would organize the workflow, manage revisions, and approve final assets. • Present a proposed team structure, production process, and quality-control checklist. The purpose of the pilot is not to determine whether the manager can personally create every asset. It is intended to evaluate the candidate’s ability to find talent, communicate standards, build systems, manage production, and prevent defective work from reaching the client. Junior editor expenses approved for the pilot or ongoing operation will be managed under a separate company-funded production budget and will not be deducted from the manager’s compensation. How to Apply Please submit the following: 1. Your resume and LinkedIn profile to ---------- A brief description of the largest creative or production team you have managed. 3. Examples of e-commerce images, videos, AI workflows, or creative projects you personally managed or quality-checked. 4. A list of the AI image, video, editing, and project-management tools you have used professionally. 5. A short explanation of how you would place a real product into an AI-generated environment without changing its logo, shape, proportions, or important features. 6. Your current employment or client commitments. 7. Your earliest available start date. 8. Your expected full-time monthly compensation. Please begin your application with the words “PRODUCT FIDELITY” so we know you carefully reviewed the position. Generic applications that do not address the management, technical, and quality-control requirements will not be considered.

title: Email Marketing
description: The Mission: We are a fast-growing Direct Response E-Commerce brand. We don’t care about “brand awareness” or fluffy newsletters. We care about one thing: Conversion. Your sole mission is to maximize our Average Order Value (AOV) and recover lost revenue by crafting high-converting, direct-response email campaigns. You will own our backend monetization: Post-Purchase Upsell Flows, Abandoned Checkout Sequences, and VIP Customer Promotions. The Role & System Rules: Direct Response Copywriting: You write punchy, benefit-driven copy at or below a 6th-grade reading level. No complex jargon, no long paragraphs. Upsell Architecture: You understand that e-commerce upsells require minimal copy. You focus on a strong headline, an attractive product hero image, short high-impact copy (focusing on value/discount), and a bold, frictionless CTA. Visual Design Execution: You have the basic design skills to assemble these email s. You know how to pair your copy with striking, native-looking product images or GIFs that command attention and drive clicks. Speed & Iteration: You test subject lines, angles, and CTAs systematically. You cut losers quickly and double down on winners. What We Expect From You: You understand the psychology of buying (Desire, Belief, Urgency, Scarcity, Risk Reversal). You know how to frame an upsell as the "next logical step" (e.g., selling a complimentary product that solves the next phase of the customer's problem). You don't need a manager to tell you what to do. You are an operator who looks at the data (Revenue, Click-Through-Rate, EPC) and optimizes relentlessly. ???? MANDATORY APPLICATION TEST (Do NOT apply without answering this) We hire based on performance, not resumes. To be considered for this position, you must complete this quick, 5-minute test at the top of your application. If you fail to include this, your application will be instantly deleted. The Scenario: A customer just purchased our flagship "EMS Foot Massager" (Front-End Product) designed to relieve foot pain and neuropathy. We need a Post-Purchase Upsell Email sent 10 minutes after their purchase to sell them our "Detoxifying Herbal Foot Patches" (Complimentary Upsell Product / Consumable). Your Task (Provide this in your application): Subject Line: Write 1 curiosity-driven or benefit-driven subject line. Headline: Write the main email headline (max 8 words). The Copy: Write 2-3 short, punchy sentences selling the foot patches as the ultimate complimentary addition to their massager. Focus on impulse-buy psychology, the "next logical step" to draw out toxins/relieve pain, and a limited-time discount. Visual Directive: Describe in 1-2 sentences what the Hero Image of this email should look like to maximize clicks. CTA: What exactly does the button say?

The Quantity Surveyor will work closely with our architects, engineers, site managers, procurement team, and subcontractors to ensure projects are delivered within budget while maintaining quality and compliance standards. Cost Planning & Estimating •   Prepare detailed construction cost estimates for new developments. •   Develop cost plans at planning, pre-construction, and construction stages. •   Analyse construction costs and identify cost-saving opportunities. •   Maintain up-to-date cost databases and benchmarking information. •   Prepare budget forecasts for current and future projects. •   Review design proposals and assess their financial impact. Procurement & Tendering •   Prepare tender documentation and pricing schedules. •   Obtain and evaluate quotations  from suppliers and subcontractors. •   Prepare tender comparisons and recommendation reports. •   Assist with procurement strategies  for materials and subcontract packages. •   Develop material procurement  schedules aligned with project programmes. •   Negotiate supplier and subcontractor pricing where required. Commercial Management •   Monitor project costs against approved budgets. •   Prepare monthly cost reports and commercial updates. •   Track variations and assess their financial impact. •   Review subcontractor applications and valuations. •   Assist in the preparation of interim and final accounts. •   Identify commercial risks and recommend mitigation measures. Material & Procurement Scheduling •   Produce detailed material schedules for each house type. •   Calculate procurement  requirements for entire developments. •   Prepare container loading schedules for imported materials where required. •   Assist with forecasting material requirements across multiple projects. •   Monitor material usage and wastage trends. Reporting & Administration •   Prepare detailed measurement reports and cost analyses. •   Maintain accurate project records  and commercial documentation. •   Produce regular progress and budget reports for management. •   Ensure all commercial information is stored and maintained accurately. Requirements Essential •   Degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Economics, or related discipline. •   Experience preparing detailed take-offs and bills of quantities. •   Excellent numerical and analytical skills. •   Advanced  proficiency in Microsoft Excel. •   Ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings. •   Strong organisational and communication skills. •   Ability to work independently in a remote environment. What Success Looks Like The successful Quantity Surveyor will be capable of independently producing accurate quantity take-offs, bills of quantities, cost plans,  and procurement  schedules for residential developments. They will provide reliable cost information that enables the company to budget accurately, control costs effectively, and maximise profitability across multiple housing projects. description: I run a personal-branding / content-strategy Instagram account where I post talking-head videos (me talking to camera). If your edits make a simple talking-head video feel polished and easy to watch, you're exactly who I'm after. THE STYLE I'M GOING FOR: - Clean and simple above all. Less is more. WHAT YOU'LL DO (per video): - Cut my raw talking-head footage tightly — remove dead air, filler, mistakes and long pauses so it flows. - Add accurate, well-styled captions timed to my speech. - Add simple, clean on-screen graphics where they add value — keyword highlights, a clean heading/title, subtle callouts, occasional b-roll or screen-recording cutaways. - Light colour correction for a consistent, premium look. - Add subtle background music low in the mix (never overpowering my voice). - Export at 1080p, 60fps, vertical 9:16 for Instagram Reels. - Keep the look consistent with previous videos (I'll share a style reference). YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU: - Have a strong portfolio of clean, simple talking-head / short-form edits (please send examples). - Understand short-form pacing and what keeps people watching. - Have great taste — you know when to add a graphic and, more importantly, when NOT to. - Are detail-oriented with caption timing, framing and consistency. - Communicate clearly, hit deadlines, and take feedback well. TOOLS: CapCut Pro and/or Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve — whatever you're fastest and cleanest in. A machine that handles 1080p/60fps smoothly and reliable internet for Google Drive transfers. HOW WE'LL START: Paid test edit — I'll send one raw video and a style reference so I can see your taste and quality. Dispatch Coordination Communicate efficiently with the call center and Call-by-Call team to maintain proper job flow. Ensure all departments are aligned on scheduling changes, priority calls, and technician movement. Help maintain daily operational efficiency and customer experience standards. Performance Expectations Maintain accurate and organized dispatch boards daily. Ensure timely customer communication and updates. Reduce scheduling errors and improve job readiness. Support efficient technician routing and scheduling flow. Maintain high standards of accuracy in call review and debrief processes. title: Chief of Staff (Executive Assistant to CEO) — Electrical Contractor
job_title: Chief of Staff (Executive Assistant to CEO) — Electrical Contractor
description: Chief of Staff (Executive Assistant to CEO) — Electrical Contractor, USA Company: Coharbor Electric LLC — Cape Coral / Fort Myers, Florida (USA) Schedule: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (you must work USA business hours) Location: 100% Remote — Philippines-based Compensation: Depending on experience. Paid via Wise. Long-term, full-time role with room to grow as we double. Start: As soon as we find the right person. Who We Are Coharbor Electric is a veteran-owned, Christian-owned residential and commercial electrical contractor serving Southwest Florida since 2010. We were founded by our CEO, Jacob Anderson — a Major in the U.S. Air Force — and we are a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business. We do service work, panel and service changes, generator and EV-charger installs, new construction, and larger commercial projects including fire stations. Our mission is simple and we mean it: "To provide high quality electrical work, on time, with integrity. Our purpose is to empower and lift up our employees, customers, partners, and fellow community members." We treat our customers the way we'd treat our own family, we use honest flat-rate pricing with no upsell scripts, and we live by a verse we keep in front of us: "Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord" (Colossians 3:23). We say we're "bringing light to a dark world," and we mean that about more than wiring. That value — to empower and lift up our employees — is why this role exists. We are a team of about 20, and we intend to double. The thing slowing us down isn't demand; it's that too much runs through one desk. We're hiring a Chief of Staff to change that. Of our team of 20, we do have 5 employees in PH already. This is not a "send me tasks and I'll do them" job. This is a build-and-own job. We have a list of programs we've wanted to launch for a while and haven't had the bandwidth to build. Your job is to take them off the CEO's plate, build them, run them, and keep them running — and to organize the back office so leadership can stop living in the inbox. If you want to be told exactly what to do every hour, this is the wrong role. If you see a mess and instinctively build the system that fixes it — and you want to work for a company whose word actually means something — keep reading. What You'll Own 1. Inbox & Communication (the CEO should rarely touch email ) Take full ownership of the CEO's email inbox: triage, organize, label/folder, and clear it out. Build a daily system: what needs the CEO, what you've handled, what's FYI. Over your first 60–90 days, earn the trust to draft and then send routine replies on the CEO's behalf, reporting back in a single daily summary. The goal is simple: the CEO stops checking email . 2. Microsoft Teams — Organize It Restructure Microsoft Teams: channels, files, naming conventions, and folder logic so the whole company can find what it needs. Keep it organized as we grow. 3. Launch & Run Operational Programs (the core of this role) You will build these from the ground up, document them, and then run them: Installer Bonus Program — design and administer a performance bonus structure for our install crews. Weekly Sales Tech Commissions — calculate and run sales technician commissions every week, accurately and on time. Commercial Service Program — help stand up a recurring commercial service offering: the process, the workflow, the follow-up system. 4. Own the Hiring, Onboarding & Offboarding Process We are doubling — you keep hiring organized and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. The CEO and our Technical Managers scan resumes and run the interviews; you own everything around that: Post the jobs — write and publish job postings for open roles. Schedule interviews — coordinate calendars and set up interviews between candidates and the CEO / Technical Managers. Onboarding — once a candidate is hired, ensure 100% of onboarding paperwork is completed correctly and on time, and run them through the onboarding process. Offboarding — when an employee parts ways, complete the offboarding paperwork and process accurately and discreetly. Build and maintain the checklists and document templates that make onboarding and offboarding repeatable every single time. 5. Build Our Operating System (SOPs & Documentation) Create SOPs, process documentation, templates, and operational systems — and do it for an electrical contracting business, where the details matter. Turn "how we do things" out of the CEO's head and into written, repeatable systems. 6. Personal Assistant Support for the CEO This role also supports the CEO personally. You will: Book personal and business appointments and manage the CEO's calendar. Set up and coordinate returns to retailers (initiate returns, schedule pickups, track refunds). Categorize personal and family expenses and help maintain the family budget. Handle other personal-assistant tasks as they come up — this person is a trusted right hand in both business and personal logistics. What We Need From You Required 3+ years supporting a CEO, founder, or executive as a Chief of Staff or high-level Executive Assistant — not a general/entry-level VA role. Proven track record building systems, SOPs, and processes from scratch — please be ready to show examples of operational systems you have built. Strong, professional written and spoken English. You will communicate on the CEO's behalf. Comfort with numbers: you will run weekly commissions and a bonus program. Accuracy is non-negotiable. Highly organized, proactive, and able to make sound decisions without being told. Trustworthy and discreet — you will handle sensitive financial and personnel information. Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional remote setup. Able and willing to work USA Eastern business hours, full-time. A Strong Plus (not required) Experience with ServiceTitan and/or QuickBooks. Experience supporting a trades, construction, electrical, HVAC, or home-services company. HR, recruiting coordination, or employee onboarding/offboarding experience. Comfort using AI tools to work faster. How We Work We are direct, we move fast, and we value people who take ownership and tell us the truth — including when we're wrong. As a faith-driven, veteran-owned company, integrity matters more to us than anything on your resume. You will handle sensitive financial and personnel information and represent the CEO in writing, so trustworthiness isn't a nice-to-have here — it's the whole job. We measure this role on outcomes: programs launched, inbox controlled, systems built. Do that well and this role grows with the company as we double. How to Apply To prove you actually read this posting, start your application with the phrase: "Built to last." Applications without it will not be read. Please send: A short introduction telling us about a system, SOP, or program you personally built for a previous employer — what was broken, what you built, and the result. Your resume. Your desired monthly rate in USD. Your earliest available start date. One sentence on why a remote role on US Eastern hours works for you long-term. We review every complete application. We look forward to meeting you.
